# Assessment and Discussion API (MVP)

All routes require a bearer JWT. `courseId`, `questionId`, and `quizId` are numeric IDs. Swagger UI at `/swagger-ui.html` lists the request and response schemas.

## Question bank and quizzes

Assigned lecturers (course creator or a row in `course_lecturers`) and admins can manage questions and quizzes.

| Method | Route | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/courses/{courseId}/questions` | List questions with answer keys |
| POST | `/api/courses/{courseId}/questions` | Create a question and its options |
| PUT | `/api/courses/{courseId}/questions/{questionId}` | Replace an unused question and its options |
| DELETE | `/api/courses/{courseId}/questions/{questionId}` | Delete an unused question |
| POST | `/api/courses/{courseId}/quizzes` | Create a draft quiz |
| POST | `/api/courses/{courseId}/quizzes/{quizId}/publish` | Publish a draft quiz |
| GET | `/api/courses/{courseId}/quizzes` | List quizzes |
| GET | `/api/courses/{courseId}/quizzes/{quizId}` | View a quiz |

An actively enrolled student can list and view published quizzes. The `correct` option field is omitted from student responses. A question already linked to a quiz cannot be edited or deleted, preserving the quiz's answer key.

Example question:

```json
{"content":"2 + 2?","type":"SINGLE_CHOICE","options":[{"content":"4","correct":true},{"content":"5","correct":false}]}
```

Types: `SINGLE_CHOICE`, `MULTIPLE_CHOICE`, `TRUE_FALSE`, `SHORT_ANSWER`. Objective questions require at least two options and a valid correct option count. `SHORT_ANSWER` has no options.

Example draft quiz:

```json
{"title":"Week 1 quiz","maxAttempts":1,"durationMinutes":30,"questions":[{"questionId":123,"points":2}]}
```

`startTime` and `endTime` are optional ISO local date times. A quiz must use unique question IDs from its own course. Attempts and grading are outside this MVP's API surface.

## Course discussion

Active students enrolled in the course, assigned lecturers, and admins can read and post comments. Setting `parentId` creates a reply; omitting it creates a top-level question. Authors may edit or delete their own comments; assigned lecturers and admins may moderate them.

| Method | Route | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/courses/{courseId}/discussions` | List comments and replies in creation order |
| POST | `/api/courses/{courseId}/discussions` | Post a question or reply |
| PUT | `/api/courses/{courseId}/discussions/{id}` | Edit a comment |
| DELETE | `/api/courses/{courseId}/discussions/{id}` | Soft delete a comment |

Example reply:

```json
{"content":"Here is the answer.","parentId":456}
```

Deleting a comment preserves its row and replies, and displays `[deleted]` in place of the content. Replies must point to an active comment in the same course.

package com.smartcampus.backend.analytics.controller;

import com.smartcampus.backend.analytics.dto.CourseAnalyticsResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.analytics.service.CourseAnalyticsService;
import com.smartcampus.backend.common.config.OpenApiConfig;
import com.smartcampus.backend.common.response.ApiResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.security.CurrentUserResolver;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Parameter;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.security.SecurityRequirement;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
import com.smartcampus.backend.analytics.dto.CourseRiskSummaryResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.analytics.dto.StudentRiskResponse;

import java.util.List;

@Tag(name = "Analytics", description = "Course statistics for lecturers and administrators")
@SecurityRequirement(name = OpenApiConfig.BEARER_AUTH)
@RestController
public class CourseAnalyticsController {

    private final CourseAnalyticsService analyticsService;
    private final CurrentUserResolver currentUserResolver;

    public CourseAnalyticsController(CourseAnalyticsService analyticsService, CurrentUserResolver currentUserResolver) {
        this.analyticsService = analyticsService;
        this.currentUserResolver = currentUserResolver;
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Statistics of one course",
            description = """
                    Enrollment counts (active, withdrawn, removed, total, new in 7 days) and completion
                    (students completed / in progress / not started, completion rate, average progress).
                    Only the course's lecturer or an administrator (BR-ANL-006).

                    Errors: 404 COURSE_NOT_FOUND, 403 NOT_COURSE_STAFF.
                    """)
    @GetMapping("/api/analytics/courses/{courseId}/summary")
    public ApiResponse<CourseAnalyticsResponse> getCourseSummary(
            @Parameter(example = "9101", required = true) @PathVariable("courseId") Long courseId) {
        Long actorId = currentUserResolver.getCurrentUserId();
        return ApiResponse.ok(analyticsService.getCourseSummary(actorId, courseId));
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Statistics of every course I manage",
            description = "Lecturer: courses he created or is assigned to. Admin: every course. Student: 403 NOT_COURSE_STAFF.")
    @GetMapping("/api/analytics/courses")
    public ApiResponse<List<CourseAnalyticsResponse>> getMyCoursesSummary() {
        Long actorId = currentUserResolver.getCurrentUserId();
        return ApiResponse.ok(analyticsService.getMyCoursesSummary(actorId));
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Statistics of risk scores for a course",
            description = "Tráº£ vá» Ä‘iá»ƒm rá»§i ro trung bÃ¬nh vÃ  sá»‘ lÆ°á»£ng sinh viÃªn theo tá»«ng cáº¥p Ä‘á»™ rá»§i ro (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW).")
    @GetMapping("/api/analytics/courses/{courseId}/risk-summary")
    public ApiResponse<CourseRiskSummaryResponse> getCourseRiskSummary(
            @Parameter(example = "9101", required = true) @PathVariable("courseId") Long courseId) {

        // Láº¥y ID cá»§a ngÆ°á»i dÃ¹ng Ä‘ang Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p tá»« JWT
        Long actorId = currentUserResolver.getCurrentUserId();

        // Gá»i service vÃ  bá»c káº¿t quáº£ vÃ o ApiResponse.ok()
        return ApiResponse.ok(analyticsService.getCourseRiskSummary(actorId, courseId));
    }

    @Operation(summary = "List risk scores of individual students in a course",
            description = "Tráº£ vá» danh sÃ¡ch chi tiáº¿t Ä‘iá»ƒm rá»§i ro cá»§a tá»«ng sinh viÃªn Ä‘ang há»c trong lá»›p. Chá»‰ giáº£ng viÃªn quáº£n lÃ½ lá»›p hoáº·c Admin má»›i xem Ä‘Æ°á»£c.")
    @GetMapping("/api/analytics/courses/{courseId}/students/risk")
    public ApiResponse<List<StudentRiskResponse>> getStudentRisks(
            @Parameter(example = "9101", required = true) @PathVariable("courseId") Long courseId) {
        Long actorId = currentUserResolver.getCurrentUserId();
        return ApiResponse.ok(analyticsService.getStudentRisks(actorId, courseId));
    }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.analytics.dto;

/** Course-level statistics (FR-ANL-009): enrollments and completion. */
@Schema(description = "Enrollment and completion statistics of one course")
public record CourseAnalyticsResponse(
        @Schema(example = "9101") Long courseId,
        @Schema(example = "Introduction to Spring Boot") String courseTitle,
        @Schema(example = "PUBLISHED") String publicationState,
        @Schema(example = "true") boolean enrollmentOpen,

        @Schema(description = "Students currently enrolled (ACTIVE)", example = "40") long activeEnrollments,
        @Schema(description = "Students who left by themselves", example = "3") long withdrawnEnrollments,
        @Schema(description = "Students removed by staff", example = "1") long removedEnrollments,
        @Schema(description = "Every enrollment ever made (all statuses)", example = "44") long totalEnrollments,
        @Schema(description = "Enrollments created in the last 7 days", example = "5") long newEnrollmentsLast7Days,

        @Schema(description = "Lessons in the course", example = "12") long totalLessons,
        @Schema(description = "ACTIVE students who completed every lesson", example = "10") long studentsCompleted,
        @Schema(example = "25") long studentsInProgress,
        @Schema(example = "5") long studentsNotStarted,
        @Schema(description = "studentsCompleted / activeEnrollments x 100", example = "25.0") double completionRate,
        @Schema(description = "Average progress percent of ACTIVE students", example = "58.3") double averageProgressPercent
) {
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.analytics.repository;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;
import com.smartcampus.backend.analytics.dto.CourseRiskSummaryResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.analytics.dto.StudentRiskResponse;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

/** Aggregate queries for course-level analytics (FR-ANL-009). Read-only. */
@Repository
public class CourseAnalyticsRepository {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;

    public CourseAnalyticsRepository(JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate) {
        this.jdbcTemplate = jdbcTemplate;
    }

    public Optional<CourseEnrollmentStats> findEnrollmentStats(Long courseId) {
        List<CourseEnrollmentStats> rows = jdbcTemplate.query("""
                SELECT c.id                 AS course_id,
                       c.title              AS course_title,
                       c.publication_state  AS publication_state,
                       c.is_enrollment_open AS enrollment_open,
                       COUNT(CASE WHEN e.status = 'ACTIVE'    THEN 1 END) AS active_count,
                       COUNT(CASE WHEN e.status = 'WITHDRAWN' THEN 1 END) AS withdrawn_count,
                       COUNT(CASE WHEN e.status = 'REMOVED'   THEN 1 END) AS removed_count,
                       COUNT(e.id)                                        AS total_count,
                       COUNT(CASE WHEN e.enrolled_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 7 DAY THEN 1 END) AS new_7d_count
                FROM courses c
                LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON e.course_id = c.id
                WHERE c.id = ?
                GROUP BY c.id, c.title, c.publication_state, c.is_enrollment_open
                """,
                (rs, i) -> new CourseEnrollmentStats(
                        rs.getLong("course_id"),
                        rs.getString("course_title"),
                        rs.getString("publication_state"),
                        rs.getBoolean("enrollment_open"),
                        rs.getLong("active_count"),
                        rs.getLong("withdrawn_count"),
                        rs.getLong("removed_count"),
                        rs.getLong("total_count"),
                        rs.getLong("new_7d_count")),
                courseId);
        return rows.stream().findFirst();
    }

    public Optional<CourseRiskSummaryResponse> findRiskSummary(Long courseId) {
        List<CourseRiskSummaryResponse> rows = jdbcTemplate.query("""
            SELECT 
                course_id,
                AVG(risk_score) AS avg_score,
                COUNT(CASE WHEN risk_level = 'HIGH' THEN 1 END) AS high_count,
                COUNT(CASE WHEN risk_level = 'MEDIUM' THEN 1 END) AS medium_count,
                COUNT(CASE WHEN risk_level = 'LOW' THEN 1 END) AS low_count
            FROM risk_assessments
            WHERE course_id = ?
            GROUP BY course_id
            """,
                (rs, i) -> new CourseRiskSummaryResponse(
                        rs.getLong("course_id"),
                        rs.getDouble("avg_score") != 0 ? Math.round(rs.getDouble("avg_score") * 10.0) / 10.0 : 0.0,
                        rs.getInt("high_count"),
                        rs.getInt("medium_count"),
                        rs.getInt("low_count")
                ),
                courseId);
        return rows.stream().findFirst();
    }

    public List<StudentRiskResponse> findStudentRisksByCourse(Long courseId) {
        return jdbcTemplate.query("""
            SELECT 
                u.id AS student_id,
                u.username,
                u.full_name,
                u.email,
                ra.risk_score,
                ra.risk_level,
                ra.assessed_at
            FROM enrollments e
            JOIN users u ON u.id = e.student_id
            LEFT JOIN risk_assessments ra ON ra.student_id = u.id AND ra.course_id = e.course_id
            WHERE e.course_id = ? AND e.status = 'ACTIVE'
            ORDER BY ra.risk_score DESC, u.full_name ASC
            """,
                (rs, i) -> new StudentRiskResponse(
                        rs.getLong("student_id"),
                        rs.getString("username"),
                        rs.getString("full_name"),
                        rs.getString("email"),
                        rs.getObject("risk_score") != null ? rs.getDouble("risk_score") : 0.0,
                        rs.getString("risk_level") != null ? rs.getString("risk_level") : "LOW",
                        rs.getTimestamp("assessed_at") != null ? rs.getTimestamp("assessed_at").toLocalDateTime() : null
                ),
                courseId);
    }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.analytics.service;

import com.smartcampus.backend.analytics.dto.CourseAnalyticsResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.analytics.repository.CourseAnalyticsRepository;
import com.smartcampus.backend.analytics.repository.CourseEnrollmentStats;
import com.smartcampus.backend.common.exception.ApiException;
import com.smartcampus.backend.common.security.CourseAccessGuard;
import com.smartcampus.backend.common.security.UserAccount;
import com.smartcampus.backend.progress.dto.ProgressStatus;
import com.smartcampus.backend.progress.repository.LearningProgressRepository;
import com.smartcampus.backend.progress.repository.projection.StudentProgressView;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import com.smartcampus.backend.analytics.dto.CourseRiskSummaryResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.analytics.dto.StudentRiskResponse;

import java.util.List;

/**
 * Basic course analytics: enrollment counts and completion rate (FR-ANL-009).
 * Visible only to the course's lecturer and administrators (BR-ANL-006).
 */
@Service
public class CourseAnalyticsService {

    private final CourseAnalyticsRepository analyticsRepository;
    private final LearningProgressRepository progressRepository;
    private final CourseAccessGuard courseAccessGuard;

    public CourseAnalyticsService(CourseAnalyticsRepository analyticsRepository,
                                  LearningProgressRepository progressRepository,
                                  CourseAccessGuard courseAccessGuard) {
        this.analyticsRepository = analyticsRepository;
        this.progressRepository = progressRepository;
        this.courseAccessGuard = courseAccessGuard;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public CourseAnalyticsResponse getCourseSummary(Long actorId, Long courseId) {
        UserAccount actor = courseAccessGuard.requireUser(actorId);
        courseAccessGuard.requireCourseManager(actor, courseId);
        return summarize(courseId);
    }

    /** Summaries of every course the caller manages (admin: all courses). */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<CourseAnalyticsResponse> getMyCoursesSummary(Long actorId) {
        UserAccount actor = courseAccessGuard.requireUser(actorId);
        if (!actor.isAdmin() && !actor.isLecturer()) {
            throw ApiException.forbidden("NOT_COURSE_STAFF", "Analytics are available to lecturers and administrators");
        }
        return courseAccessGuard.managedCourseIds(actor).stream()
                .map(this::summarize)
                .toList();
    }

    CourseAnalyticsResponse summarize(Long courseId) {
        CourseEnrollmentStats stats = analyticsRepository.findEnrollmentStats(courseId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> ApiException.notFound("COURSE_NOT_FOUND", "Course " + courseId + " does not exist"));
        long totalLessons = progressRepository.countLessonsOfCourse(courseId);
        List<StudentProgressView> students = progressRepository.findClassProgress(courseId);

        long completed = 0;
        long notStarted = 0;
        double percentSum = 0;
        for (StudentProgressView s : students) {
            long done = s.getCompletedLessons() == null ? 0 : s.getCompletedLessons();
            ProgressStatus status = ProgressStatus.of(done, totalLessons, s.getLastAccessedAt() != null);
            if (status == ProgressStatus.COMPLETED) {
                completed++;
            } else if (status == ProgressStatus.NOT_STARTED) {
                notStarted++;
            }
            percentSum += ProgressStatus.percent(done, totalLessons);
        }
        int active = students.size();
        long inProgress = active - completed - notStarted;

        return new CourseAnalyticsResponse(
                stats.courseId(), stats.courseTitle(), stats.publicationState(), stats.enrollmentOpen(),
                stats.activeEnrollments(), stats.withdrawnEnrollments(), stats.removedEnrollments(),
                stats.totalEnrollments(), stats.newEnrollmentsLast7Days(),
                totalLessons, completed, inProgress, notStarted,
                active == 0 ? 0.0 : round1(completed * 100.0 / active),
                active == 0 ? 0.0 : round1(percentSum / active));
    }

    private static double round1(double value) {
        return Math.round(value * 10.0) / 10.0;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public CourseRiskSummaryResponse getCourseRiskSummary(Long actorId, Long courseId) {
        // Kiá»ƒm tra user há»£p lá»‡ vÃ  cÃ³ quyá»n quáº£n lÃ½ khÃ³a há»c nÃ y khÃ´ng
        UserAccount actor = courseAccessGuard.requireUser(actorId);
        courseAccessGuard.requireCourseManager(actor, courseId);

        // Gá»i repository Ä‘á»ƒ láº¥y dá»¯ liá»‡u, náº¿u chÆ°a cÃ³ data thÃ¬ tráº£ vá» cÃ¡c giÃ¡ trá»‹ 0
        return analyticsRepository.findRiskSummary(courseId)
                .orElse(new CourseRiskSummaryResponse(courseId, 0.0, 0, 0, 0));
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<StudentRiskResponse> getStudentRisks(Long actorId, Long courseId) {
        UserAccount actor = courseAccessGuard.requireUser(actorId);
        courseAccessGuard.requireCourseManager(actor, courseId);

        return analyticsRepository.findStudentRisksByCourse(courseId);
    }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.assessment;

import com.smartcampus.backend.assessment.AssessmentModels.*;
import com.smartcampus.backend.common.config.OpenApiConfig;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.security.SecurityRequirement;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Positive;
import java.net.URI;
import java.util.List;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.validation.annotation.Validated;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/courses/{courseId}")
@Tag(name = "Assessment", description = "Course question bank and quiz configuration")
@SecurityRequirement(name = OpenApiConfig.BEARER_AUTH)
@Validated
public class AssessmentController {
    private final AssessmentService service;

    public AssessmentController(AssessmentService service) { this.service = service; }

    @Operation(summary = "List course question bank (assigned lecturer or admin)")
    @GetMapping("/questions")
    public List<QuestionView> questions(@PathVariable @Positive Long courseId) {
        return service.questions(courseId);
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Create a question with options")
    @PostMapping("/questions")
    public ResponseEntity<QuestionView> createQuestion(@PathVariable @Positive Long courseId,
                                                        @Valid @RequestBody QuestionInput input) {
        QuestionView result = service.createQuestion(courseId, input);
        return ResponseEntity.created(URI.create("/api/courses/" + courseId + "/questions/" + result.id())).body(result);
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Replace a question and its options; blocked once used by a quiz")
    @PutMapping("/questions/{questionId}")
    public QuestionView updateQuestion(@PathVariable @Positive Long courseId,
                                       @PathVariable @Positive Long questionId,
                                       @Valid @RequestBody QuestionInput input) {
        return service.updateQuestion(courseId, questionId, input);
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Delete an unused question")
    @DeleteMapping("/questions/{questionId}")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> deleteQuestion(@PathVariable @Positive Long courseId,
                                               @PathVariable @Positive Long questionId) {
        service.deleteQuestion(courseId, questionId);
        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Create a draft quiz from course question IDs")
    @PostMapping("/quizzes")
    public ResponseEntity<QuizView> createQuiz(@PathVariable @Positive Long courseId,
                                                @Valid @RequestBody QuizInput input) {
        QuizView result = service.createQuiz(courseId, input);
        return ResponseEntity.created(URI.create("/api/courses/" + courseId + "/quizzes/" + result.quiz().id()))
                .body(result);
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Publish a draft quiz")
    @PostMapping("/quizzes/{quizId}/publish")
    public QuizView publish(@PathVariable @Positive Long courseId, @PathVariable @Positive Long quizId) {
        return service.publish(courseId, quizId);
    }

    @Operation(summary = "List course quizzes; students see published quizzes only")
    @GetMapping("/quizzes")
    public List<QuizSummary> quizzes(@PathVariable @Positive Long courseId) {
        return service.quizzes(courseId);
    }

    @Operation(summary = "View quiz; correct option flags are hidden from students")
    @GetMapping("/quizzes/{quizId}")
    public QuizView quiz(@PathVariable @Positive Long courseId, @PathVariable @Positive Long quizId) {
        return service.getQuiz(courseId, quizId);
    }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.assessment;

import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotEmpty;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotNull;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Positive;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Size;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.List;

public final class AssessmentModels {
    private AssessmentModels() {}

    public record OptionInput(@NotBlank String content, boolean correct) {}
    public record QuestionInput(@NotBlank String content, @NotBlank String type,
                                List<@NotNull @Valid OptionInput> options) {}
    public record OptionView(Long id, String content, Boolean correct, int orderIndex) {}
    public record QuestionView(Long id, Long courseId, String content, String type,
                               List<OptionView> options) {}
    public record QuizQuestionInput(@NotNull @Positive Long questionId,
                                    @NotNull @Positive BigDecimal points) {}
    public record QuizInput(@NotBlank @Size(max = 255) String title,
                            LocalDateTime startTime, LocalDateTime endTime,
                            @Positive Integer durationMinutes, @NotNull @Positive Integer maxAttempts,
                            @NotEmpty List<@NotNull @Valid QuizQuestionInput> questions) {}
    public record QuizSummary(Long id, Long courseId, String title, String status,
                              LocalDateTime startTime, LocalDateTime endTime,
                              Integer durationMinutes, int maxAttempts) {}
    public record QuizQuestionView(QuestionView question, int orderIndex, BigDecimal points) {}
    public record QuizView(QuizSummary quiz, List<QuizQuestionView> questions) {}
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.assessment;

import com.smartcampus.backend.assessment.AssessmentModels.*;
import com.smartcampus.backend.common.security.CourseAccess;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.Statement;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.jdbc.support.GeneratedKeyHolder;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

@Service
public class AssessmentService {
    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final CourseAccess access;

    public AssessmentService(JdbcTemplate jdbc, CourseAccess access) {
        this.jdbc = jdbc;
        this.access = access;
    }

    @Transactional
    public QuestionView createQuestion(Long courseId, QuestionInput input) {
        access.requireStaff(courseId);
        validateQuestion(input);
        Long id = insert("INSERT INTO question_bank (course_id, content, question_type) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                courseId, input.content().trim(), input.type());
        insertOptions(id, input.options());
        return question(id, true);
    }

    @Transactional
    public QuestionView updateQuestion(Long courseId, Long questionId, QuestionInput input) {
        access.requireStaff(courseId);
        requireQuestionCourse(courseId, questionId);
        Integer uses = jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assessment_questions WHERE question_id = ?",
                Integer.class, questionId);
        if (uses != null && uses > 0) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                "Question is already used by a quiz");
        validateQuestion(input);
        jdbc.update("UPDATE question_bank SET content = ?, question_type = ? WHERE id = ?",
                input.content().trim(), input.type(), questionId);
        jdbc.update("DELETE FROM question_options WHERE question_id = ?", questionId);
        insertOptions(questionId, input.options());
        return question(questionId, true);
    }

    @Transactional
    public void deleteQuestion(Long courseId, Long questionId) {
        access.requireStaff(courseId);
        requireQuestionCourse(courseId, questionId);
        Integer uses = jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assessment_questions WHERE question_id = ?",
                Integer.class, questionId);
        if (uses != null && uses > 0) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                "Question is already used by a quiz");
        jdbc.update("DELETE FROM question_bank WHERE id = ?", questionId);
    }

    public List<QuestionView> questions(Long courseId) {
        access.requireStaff(courseId);
        return jdbc.query("SELECT id FROM question_bank WHERE course_id = ? ORDER BY id", (rs, row) ->
                question(rs.getLong(1), true), courseId);
    }

    @Transactional
    public QuizView createQuiz(Long courseId, QuizInput input) {
        access.requireStaff(courseId);
        if (input.startTime() != null && input.endTime() != null
                && !input.endTime().isAfter(input.startTime())) badRequest("End time must be after start time");
        Set<Long> ids = new HashSet<>();
        for (QuizQuestionInput item : input.questions()) {
            if (!ids.add(item.questionId())) badRequest("Duplicate question in quiz");
            requireQuestionCourse(courseId, item.questionId());
        }
        Long id = insert("""
                INSERT INTO assessments (course_id, title, status, start_time, end_time, duration_minutes, max_attempts)
                VALUES (?, ?, 'DRAFT', ?, ?, ?, ?)
                """, courseId, input.title().trim(), input.startTime(), input.endTime(),
                input.durationMinutes(), input.maxAttempts());
        for (int i = 0; i < input.questions().size(); i++) {
            QuizQuestionInput item = input.questions().get(i);
            jdbc.update("""
                    INSERT INTO assessment_questions (assessment_id, question_id, order_index, points)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
                    """, id, item.questionId(), i, item.points());
        }
        return quiz(id, true);
    }

    @Transactional
    public QuizView publish(Long courseId, Long quizId) {
        access.requireStaff(courseId);
        QuizSummary summary = summary(courseId, quizId);
        if (!"DRAFT".equals(summary.status())) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                "Only draft quizzes can be published");
        jdbc.update("UPDATE assessments SET status = 'PUBLISHED' WHERE id = ?", quizId);
        return quiz(quizId, true);
    }

    public List<QuizSummary> quizzes(Long courseId) {
        access.requireParticipant(courseId);
        boolean student = access.hasRole("STUDENT");
        return jdbc.query("""
                SELECT id, course_id, title, status, start_time, end_time, duration_minutes, max_attempts
                FROM assessments WHERE course_id = ? AND (? = FALSE OR status = 'PUBLISHED') ORDER BY id DESC
                """, (rs, row) -> new QuizSummary(rs.getLong("id"), rs.getLong("course_id"),
                rs.getString("title"), rs.getString("status"),
                rs.getTimestamp("start_time") == null ? null : rs.getTimestamp("start_time").toLocalDateTime(),
                rs.getTimestamp("end_time") == null ? null : rs.getTimestamp("end_time").toLocalDateTime(),
                (Integer) rs.getObject("duration_minutes"), rs.getInt("max_attempts")), courseId, student);
    }

    /**
     * Staff see the quiz with its answer key at any time.
     * A student sees the questions (without answers) only inside the availability window
     * (BR-ASSESSMENT-001); the list endpoint still shows the summary with its start/end times.
     */
    public QuizView getQuiz(Long courseId, Long quizId) {
        access.requireParticipant(courseId);
        QuizSummary summary = summary(courseId, quizId);
        boolean student = access.hasRole("STUDENT");
        if (student && !"PUBLISHED".equals(summary.status()))
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Quiz not found");
        if (student) requireOpen(summary);
        return quiz(quizId, !student);
    }

    private static void requireOpen(QuizSummary summary) {
        LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();
        if (summary.startTime() != null && now.isBefore(summary.startTime()))
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN, "Quiz is not open yet");
        if (summary.endTime() != null && now.isAfter(summary.endTime()))
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN, "Quiz is closed");
    }

    private QuizView quiz(Long quizId, boolean includeAnswers) {
        QuizSummary summary = jdbc.queryForObject("""
                SELECT id, course_id, title, status, start_time, end_time, duration_minutes, max_attempts
                FROM assessments WHERE id = ?
                """, (rs, row) -> new QuizSummary(rs.getLong("id"), rs.getLong("course_id"),
                rs.getString("title"), rs.getString("status"),
                rs.getTimestamp("start_time") == null ? null : rs.getTimestamp("start_time").toLocalDateTime(),
                rs.getTimestamp("end_time") == null ? null : rs.getTimestamp("end_time").toLocalDateTime(),
                (Integer) rs.getObject("duration_minutes"), rs.getInt("max_attempts")), quizId);
        List<QuizQuestionView> items = jdbc.query("""
                SELECT question_id, order_index, points FROM assessment_questions
                WHERE assessment_id = ? ORDER BY order_index
                """, (rs, row) -> new QuizQuestionView(question(rs.getLong("question_id"), includeAnswers),
                rs.getInt("order_index"), rs.getBigDecimal("points")), quizId);
        return new QuizView(summary, items);
    }

    private QuizSummary summary(Long courseId, Long quizId) {
        return quizzes(courseId).stream().filter(q -> q.id().equals(quizId)).findFirst()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Quiz not found"));
    }

    private QuestionView question(Long id, boolean includeAnswers) {
        QuestionView base = jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT id, course_id, content, question_type FROM question_bank WHERE id = ?",
                (rs, row) -> new QuestionView(rs.getLong("id"), rs.getLong("course_id"),
                        rs.getString("content"), rs.getString("question_type"), List.of()), id);
        List<OptionView> options = jdbc.query("""
                SELECT id, content, is_correct, order_index FROM question_options
                WHERE question_id = ? ORDER BY order_index
                """, (rs, row) -> new OptionView(rs.getLong("id"), rs.getString("content"),
                includeAnswers ? rs.getBoolean("is_correct") : null, rs.getInt("order_index")), id);
        return new QuestionView(base.id(), base.courseId(), base.content(), base.type(), options);
    }

    private void requireQuestionCourse(Long courseId, Long questionId) {
        Integer count = jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM question_bank WHERE id = ? AND course_id = ?",
                Integer.class, questionId, courseId);
        if (count == null || count == 0) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                "Question not found in course");
    }

    private void validateQuestion(QuestionInput input) {
        if (!Set.of("SINGLE_CHOICE", "MULTIPLE_CHOICE", "TRUE_FALSE", "SHORT_ANSWER").contains(input.type()))
            badRequest("Unsupported question type");
        List<OptionInput> options = input.options() == null ? List.of() : input.options();
        if ("SHORT_ANSWER".equals(input.type())) {
            if (!options.isEmpty()) badRequest("Short answers cannot have options");
            return;
        }
        if (options.size() < 2) badRequest("At least two options are required");
        long correct = options.stream().filter(OptionInput::correct).count();
        if (correct == 0 || (!"MULTIPLE_CHOICE".equals(input.type()) && correct != 1))
            badRequest("Invalid number of correct options");
        if ("TRUE_FALSE".equals(input.type()) && options.size() != 2)
            badRequest("True/false questions require exactly two options");
        for (OptionInput option : options) if (option == null || option.content() == null
                || option.content().isBlank()) badRequest("Option content is required");
    }

    private void insertOptions(Long questionId, List<OptionInput> options) {
        if (options == null) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < options.size(); i++) {
            OptionInput option = options.get(i);
            jdbc.update("INSERT INTO question_options (question_id, content, is_correct, order_index) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                    questionId, option.content().trim(), option.correct(), i);
        }
    }

    private Long insert(String sql, Object... values) {
        GeneratedKeyHolder holder = new GeneratedKeyHolder();
        jdbc.update(connection -> {
            PreparedStatement statement = connection.prepareStatement(sql, Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS);
            for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) statement.setObject(i + 1, values[i]);
            return statement;
        }, holder);
        return holder.getKey().longValue();
    }

    private static void badRequest(String message) {
        throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, message);
    }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.auth.controller;

import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.security.core.AuthenticationException;
import org.springframework.web.bind.MethodArgumentNotValidException;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;
import org.springframework.dao.DataIntegrityViolationException;

import java.util.Map;

@RestControllerAdvice
public class GlobalExceptionHandler {

    /**
     * Má»i lá»—i Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p (sai máº­t kháº©u, tÃ i khoáº£n INACTIVE/DisabledException, bá»‹ khoÃ¡...)

import java.util.List;

public class CustomUserDetails implements UserDetails {

    private final User user;

    public CustomUserDetails(User user) {
        this.user = user;
    }

    public Long getId() {
        return user.getId();
    }

    @Override
    public String getUsername() {
        return user.getUsername();
    }

    @Override
    public String getPassword() {
        return user.getPasswordHash();
    }

    @Override
    public Collection<? extends GrantedAuthority> getAuthorities() {
        return List.of(
                new SimpleGrantedAuthority("ROLE_" + user.getRole().name())
        );
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isEnabled() {
        return user.getStatus() == UserStatus.ACTIVE;
    }

    public UserRole getRole() {
        return user.getRole();
    }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.auth.security;

import io.jsonwebtoken.JwtException;
import jakarta.servlet.FilterChain;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;

import org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContext;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetails;
import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UsernameNotFoundException;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter;

import java.io.IOException;

@Component
public class JwtAuthenticationFilter extends OncePerRequestFilter {

    private final JwtService jwtService;
    private final CustomUserDetailsService userDetailsService;

    public JwtAuthenticationFilter(
            JwtService jwtService,
            CustomUserDetailsService userDetailsService
    ) {
        this.jwtService = jwtService;
        this.userDetailsService = userDetailsService;
    }

    @Override
    protected void doFilterInternal(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            FilterChain filterChain
    ) throws ServletException, IOException {

        String authHeader = request.getHeader("Authorization");

        if (authHeader == null || !authHeader.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
            filterChain.doFilter(request, response);
            return;
        }

        String jwt = authHeader.substring(7);

        try {
            String username = jwtService.extractUsername(jwt);

            if (username != null
                    && SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication() == null) {

                UserDetails userDetails =
                        userDetailsService.loadUserByUsername(username);

                if (userDetails instanceof CustomUserDetails customUserDetails
                        && jwtService.isTokenValid(jwt, customUserDetails)) {

                    UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken authentication =
                            new UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(
                                    customUserDetails,
                                    null,
                                    customUserDetails.getAuthorities()
                            );

                    authentication.setDetails(
                            new org.springframework.security.web.authentication
                                    .WebAuthenticationDetailsSource()
                                    .buildDetails(request)
                    );

                    SecurityContext context =
                            SecurityContextHolder.createEmptyContext();

                    context.setAuthentication(authentication);
                    SecurityContextHolder.setContext(context);
                }
            }

        } catch (JwtException | IllegalArgumentException
                 | UsernameNotFoundException ex) {
            SecurityContextHolder.clearContext();
        }

        filterChain.doFilter(request, response);
    }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.auth.security;

import io.jsonwebtoken.Claims;
import io.jsonwebtoken.Jwts;
import io.jsonwebtoken.JwtException;
import io.jsonwebtoken.io.Decoders;
import io.jsonwebtoken.security.Keys;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import javax.crypto.SecretKey;
import java.util.Date;

@Service
public class JwtService {

    private final SecretKey signingKey;
    private final long expirationMs;

    public JwtService(
            @Value("${app.jwt.secret}") String secret,
            @Value("${app.jwt.expiration-ms}") long expirationMs
    ) {
        byte[] keyBytes = Decoders.BASE64.decode(secret);

        this.signingKey = Keys.hmacShaKeyFor(keyBytes);
        this.expirationMs = expirationMs;
    }

    public String generateToken(CustomUserDetails userDetails) {

        Date now = new Date();
        Date expiration = new Date(now.getTime() + expirationMs);

        return Jwts.builder()
                .subject(userDetails.getUsername())
                .issuedAt(now)
                .expiration(expiration)
                .signWith(signingKey, Jwts.SIG.HS256)
                .compact();
    }

    public String extractUsername(String token) {
        return extractClaims(token).getSubject();
    }

    public boolean isTokenValid(
            String token,
            CustomUserDetails userDetails
    ) {
        try {
            Claims claims = extractClaims(token);

            return claims.getSubject().equals(userDetails.getUsername())
                    && claims.getExpiration().after(new Date())
                    && userDetails.isEnabled();

        } catch (JwtException | IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private Claims extractClaims(String token) {

        return Jwts.parser()
                .verifyWith(signingKey)
                .build()
                .parseSignedClaims(token)
                .getPayload();
    }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.auth.service;

import com.smartcampus.backend.auth.dto.AuthResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.auth.dto.CurrentUserResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.auth.dto.LoginRequest;
import com.smartcampus.backend.auth.dto.RegisterRequest;
import com.smartcampus.backend.user.entity.User;
import com.smartcampus.backend.user.entity.UserRole;
import com.smartcampus.backend.user.entity.UserStatus;
import com.smartcampus.backend.user.repository.UserRepository;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UsernameNotFoundException;
import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;
import com.smartcampus.backend.auth.security.CustomUserDetails;
import com.smartcampus.backend.auth.security.JwtService;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.AuthenticationManager;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken;
import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class AuthService {

    private final AuthenticationManager authenticationManager;
    private final JwtService jwtService;
    private final long expirationMs;
    private final UserRepository userRepository;
    private final PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder;

    public AuthService(
            AuthenticationManager authenticationManager,
            JwtService jwtService,
            UserRepository userRepository,
            PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder,
            @Value("${app.jwt.expiration-ms}") long expirationMs
    ) {
        this.authenticationManager = authenticationManager;
        this.jwtService = jwtService;
        this.userRepository = userRepository;
        this.passwordEncoder = passwordEncoder;
        this.expirationMs = expirationMs;
    }

    public AuthResponse login(LoginRequest request) {

        Authentication authentication =
                authenticationManager.authenticate(
                        new UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(
                                request.username(),
                                request.password()
                        )
                );

        CustomUserDetails userDetails =
                (CustomUserDetails) authentication.getPrincipal();

        String accessToken = jwtService.generateToken(userDetails);

        return new AuthResponse(
                accessToken,
                "Bearer",
                expirationMs / 1000,
                userDetails.getId(),
                userDetails.getUsername()
        );
    }
    @Transactional
    public void register(RegisterRequest request) {
        String username = request.username().trim();
        String email = request.email().trim().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
        String fullName = request.fullName().trim();

        if (userRepository.existsByUsername(username)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Username Ä‘Ã£ tá»“n táº¡i");
        }
        if (userRepository.existsByEmail(email)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Email Ä‘Ã£ tá»“n táº¡i");
        }

        User user = new User(username, passwordEncoder.encode(request.password()),
                fullName, email, UserRole.STUDENT, UserStatus.ACTIVE);
        userRepository.save(user);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public CurrentUserResponse getCurrentUser(
            CustomUserDetails currentUser) {

        User user = userRepository.findById(currentUser.getId())
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new UsernameNotFoundException("User not found"));

        return CurrentUserResponse.from(user);
    }


}

package com.smartcampus.backend.common.config;

import io.swagger.v3.oas.models.Components;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.models.OpenAPI;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.models.info.Info;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.models.security.SecurityScheme;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;

/**
 * Swagger / OpenAPI setup shared by every module.
 *
 *   Swagger UI : http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui.html
 *   JSON spec  : http://localhost:8080/v3/api-docs
 *
 * Declares the "bearerAuth" scheme so the "Authorize" button in Swagger UI
 * can send the JWT. Controllers that need a JWT add
 * {@code @SecurityRequirement(name = OpenApiConfig.BEARER_AUTH)}.
 */
@Configuration
public class OpenApiConfig {

    public static final String BEARER_AUTH = "bearerAuth";

    @Bean
    public OpenAPI smartCampusOpenApi() {
        return new OpenAPI()
                .info(new Info()
                        .title("Smart Campus API")
                        .version("v1")
                        .description("""
                                Backend API of the Smart Campus online learning platform (CO3103).
                                Every response uses the envelope {success, data, error_code, error_message}.
                                Log in with POST /api/auth/login, then click "Authorize" and paste the access token.
                                """))
                .components(new Components()
                        .addSecuritySchemes(BEARER_AUTH, new SecurityScheme()
                                .type(SecurityScheme.Type.HTTP)
                                .scheme("bearer")
                                .bearerFormat("JWT")
                                .description("JWT returned by POST /api/auth/login (paste the token only, without 'Bearer ')")));
    }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.common.exception;

import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;

/**
 * Business error with an HTTP status and a machine-readable code.
 * Converted to {success:false, error_code, error_message} by ApiExceptionHandler.
 */
public class ApiException extends RuntimeException {

    private final HttpStatus status;
    private final String code;

    public ApiException(HttpStatus status, String code, String message) {
        super(message);
        this.status = status;
        this.code = code;
    }

    public static ApiException badRequest(String code, String message) {
        return new ApiException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, code, message);
    }

    public static ApiException unauthorized(String message) {
        return new ApiException(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, "UNAUTHORIZED", message);
    }

    public static ApiException forbidden(String code, String message) {
        return new ApiException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN, code, message);
    }

    public static ApiException notFound(String code, String message) {
        return new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, code, message);
    }

    public static ApiException conflict(String code, String message) {
        return new ApiException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, code, message);
    }

    public HttpStatus getStatus() {
        return status;
    }

    public String getCode() {
        return code;
    }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.common.exception;

import com.smartcampus.backend.common.response.ApiResponse;
import org.springframework.core.Ordered;
import org.springframework.core.annotation.Order;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.http.converter.HttpMessageNotReadableException;
import org.springframework.validation.FieldError;
import org.springframework.web.bind.MethodArgumentNotValidException;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice;
import org.springframework.web.method.annotation.MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException;

import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * Error envelope for the Enrollment, Learning Progress, Analytics and Notification modules.
 * Scoped to those packages so it never changes how other modules report errors;
 * HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE so the global handler does not answer first for these packages.
 * Replaces enrollment/exception/EnrollmentExceptionHandler.
 */
@Order(Ordered.HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE)
@RestControllerAdvice(basePackages = {
        "com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment",
        "com.smartcampus.backend.progress",
        "com.smartcampus.backend.analytics",
        "com.smartcampus.backend.notification"
})
public class ApiExceptionHandler {

    @ExceptionHandler(ApiException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Void>> handleApiException(ApiException ex) {
        return ResponseEntity.status(ex.getStatus())
                .body(ApiResponse.error(ex.getCode(), ex.getMessage()));
    }

    /** e.g. POST /api/courses/abc/enroll */
    @ExceptionHandler(MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Void>> handleTypeMismatch(MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException ex) {
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST)
                .body(ApiResponse.error("INVALID_PARAMETER", "Invalid value for '" + ex.getName() + "'"));
    }

    /** @Valid request body failed, e.g. missing studentId */
    @ExceptionHandler(MethodArgumentNotValidException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Void>> handleValidation(MethodArgumentNotValidException ex) {
        String message = ex.getBindingResult().getFieldErrors().stream()
                .map(FieldError::getField)
                .distinct()
                .collect(Collectors.joining(", ", "Invalid field(s): ", ""));
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST)
                .body(ApiResponse.error("VALIDATION_ERROR", message));
    }

    /** Body is not valid JSON or has a wrong type */
    @ExceptionHandler(HttpMessageNotReadableException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Void>> handleUnreadableBody(HttpMessageNotReadableException ex) {
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST)
                .body(ApiResponse.error("INVALID_BODY", "Request body is missing or malformed"));
    }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.common.response;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonInclude;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonProperty;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema;

@Schema(description = "Envelope of every response: data on success, error_code + error_message on error")
@JsonInclude(JsonInclude.Include.NON_NULL)
public record ApiResponse<T>(
        @Schema(description = "true on success, false on error", example = "false")
        boolean success,

        @Schema(description = "Payload; omitted on errors", nullable = true)
        T data,

        @Schema(description = "Machine-readable error code; omitted on success", example = "ALREADY_ENROLLED", nullable = true)
        @JsonProperty("error_code")
        String errorCode,

        @Schema(description = "Human-readable error message; omitted on success",
                example = "You are already enrolled in course 9101", nullable = true)
        @JsonProperty("error_message")
        String errorMessage
) {

    public static <T> ApiResponse<T> ok(T data) {
        return new ApiResponse<>(true, data, null, null);
    }

    public static <T> ApiResponse<T> error(String errorCode, String errorMessage) {
        return new ApiResponse<>(false, null, errorCode, errorMessage);
    }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.common.security;

import com.smartcampus.backend.auth.security.CustomUserDetails;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

@Component
public class CourseAccess {
    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    public CourseAccess(JdbcTemplate jdbc) { this.jdbc = jdbc; }

    public Long userId() {
        Authentication auth = SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication();
        if (auth == null || !(auth.getPrincipal() instanceof CustomUserDetails user)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, "Authentication required");
        }
        return user.getId();
    }

    public boolean hasRole(String role) {
        Authentication auth = SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication();
        return auth != null && auth.getAuthorities().stream()
                .anyMatch(a -> a.getAuthority().equals("ROLE_" + role));
    }

    public void requireStaff(Long courseId) {
        requireCourse(courseId);
        if (hasRole("ADMIN")) return;
        if (!hasRole("LECTURER")) forbidden();
        Integer count = jdbc.queryForObject("""
                SELECT COUNT(*) FROM courses c LEFT JOIN course_lecturers cl ON cl.course_id = c.id
                WHERE c.id = ? AND (c.created_by = ? OR cl.lecturer_id = ?)
                """, Integer.class, courseId, userId(), userId());
        if (count == null || count == 0) forbidden();
    }

    public void requireParticipant(Long courseId) {
        requireCourse(courseId);
        if (hasRole("ADMIN") || hasRole("LECTURER") && isStaff(courseId)) return;
        Integer count = jdbc.queryForObject("""
                SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollments WHERE course_id = ? AND student_id = ? AND status = 'ACTIVE'
                """, Integer.class, courseId, userId());
        if (!hasRole("STUDENT") || count == null || count == 0) forbidden();
    }

    private boolean isStaff(Long courseId) {
        Integer count = jdbc.queryForObject("""
                SELECT COUNT(*) FROM courses c LEFT JOIN course_lecturers cl ON cl.course_id = c.id
                WHERE c.id = ? AND (c.created_by = ? OR cl.lecturer_id = ?)
                """, Integer.class, courseId, userId(), userId());
        return count != null && count > 0;
    }

    public void requireCourse(Long courseId) {
        Integer count = jdbc.queryForObject("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM courses WHERE id = ?", Integer.class, courseId);
        if (count == null || count == 0) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Course not found");
    }

    public static void forbidden() { throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN, "Course access denied"); }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.common.security;

import com.smartcampus.backend.common.exception.ApiException;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

/**
 * Shared authorization checks (BR-ENROLL-004, BR-ANL-006):
 *   - an Administrator manages every course
 *   - a Lecturer manages a course he created (courses.created_by)
 *     or is assigned to (course_lecturers)
 *   - a Student never manages a course
 *
 * Uses JdbcTemplate on the V1 tables so it does not depend on other modules' entities.
 */
@Component
public class CourseAccessGuard {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;

    public CourseAccessGuard(JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate) {
        this.jdbcTemplate = jdbcTemplate;
    }

    public Optional<UserAccount> findUser(Long userId) {
        List<UserAccount> rows = jdbcTemplate.query(
                "SELECT id, role, status, full_name FROM users WHERE id = ?",
                (rs, i) -> new UserAccount(rs.getLong("id"), rs.getString("role"),
                        rs.getString("status"), rs.getString("full_name")),
                userId);
        return rows.stream().findFirst();
    }

    /** The logged-in user; 401 if the account no longer exists. */
    public UserAccount requireUser(Long userId) {
        return findUser(userId).orElseThrow(() -> ApiException.unauthorized("User " + userId + " does not exist"));
    }

    public boolean courseExists(Long courseId) {
        Integer count = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM courses WHERE id = ?", Integer.class, courseId);
        return count != null && count > 0;
    }

    public boolean canManageCourse(UserAccount user, Long courseId) {
        if (user.isAdmin()) {
            return true;
        }
        if (!user.isLecturer()) {
            return false;
        }
        Integer count = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject("""
                SELECT COUNT(*) FROM courses c
                WHERE c.id = ?
                  AND (c.created_by = ?
                       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM course_lecturers cl
                                  WHERE cl.course_id = c.id AND cl.lecturer_id = ?))
                """, Integer.class, courseId, user.id(), user.id());
        return count != null && count > 0;
    }

    /** 404 if the course does not exist, 403 if the user may not manage it. */
    public void requireCourseManager(UserAccount user, Long courseId) {
        if (!courseExists(courseId)) {
            throw ApiException.notFound("COURSE_NOT_FOUND", "Course " + courseId + " does not exist");
        }
        if (!canManageCourse(user, courseId)) {
            throw ApiException.forbidden("NOT_COURSE_STAFF",
                    "Only an assigned lecturer or an administrator can manage course " + courseId);
        }
    }

    /** Ids of the courses this user manages: all courses for an admin, own/assigned for a lecturer. */
    public List<Long> managedCourseIds(UserAccount user) {
        if (user.isAdmin()) {
            return jdbcTemplate.queryForList("SELECT id FROM courses ORDER BY id", Long.class);
        }
        if (!user.isLecturer()) {
            return List.of();
        }
        return jdbcTemplate.queryForList("""
                SELECT c.id FROM courses c
                WHERE c.created_by = ?
                   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM course_lecturers cl
                              WHERE cl.course_id = c.id AND cl.lecturer_id = ?)
                ORDER BY c.id
                """, Long.class, user.id(), user.id());
    }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.common.security;

/** id, role and account status of a user, read from the users table. */
public record UserAccount(Long id, String role, String status, String fullName) {

    public static final String STUDENT = "STUDENT";
    public static final String LECTURER = "LECTURER";
    public static final String ADMIN = "ADMIN";

    public boolean isStudent() {
        return STUDENT.equals(role);
    }

    public boolean isLecturer() {
        return LECTURER.equals(role);
    }

    public boolean isAdmin() {
        return ADMIN.equals(role);
    }

    public boolean isActive() {
        return "ACTIVE".equals(status);
    }
}

import java.util.List;
import org.springframework.web.cors.CorsConfiguration;
import org.springframework.web.cors.CorsConfigurationSource;

import com.smartcampus.backend.auth.security.CustomUserDetailsService;

import org.springframework.boot.web.servlet.FilterRegistrationBean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.AuthenticationManager;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.ProviderManager;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.dao.DaoAuthenticationProvider;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.method.configuration.EnableMethodSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.config.Customizer;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.config.http.SessionCreationPolicy;
import org.springframework.security.crypto.bcrypt.BCryptPasswordEncoder;
import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder;
import org.springframework.security.web.SecurityFilterChain;
import org.springframework.security.web.authentication.HttpStatusEntryPoint;
import org.springframework.security.web.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter;

@Configuration
@EnableMethodSecurity
public class SecurityConfig {

    @Bean
    public SecurityFilterChain securityFilterChain(
            HttpSecurity http,
            JwtAuthenticationFilter jwtAuthenticationFilter
    ) throws Exception {

        http
                .csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable())
                .cors(Customizer.withDefaults())

                .sessionManagement(session ->
                        session.sessionCreationPolicy(
                                SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS
                        )
                )

                .exceptionHandling(ex -> ex
                        .authenticationEntryPoint(
                                new HttpStatusEntryPoint(
                                        HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED
                                )
                        )
                )

                .authorizeHttpRequests(auth -> auth

                        // Public endpoints
                        .requestMatchers(
                                "/api/health",
                                "/api/auth/login",
                                "/api/auth/register",
                                "/error"
                        ).permitAll()

                        // Swagger
                        .requestMatchers(
                                "/swagger-ui.html",
                                "/swagger-ui/**",
                                "/v3/api-docs/**"
                        ).permitAll()

                        // Chá»‰ ADMIN Ä‘Æ°á»£c truy cáº­p
                        .requestMatchers("/api/admin/**")
                        .hasRole("ADMIN")

                        // CÃ¡c API khÃ¡c yÃªu cáº§u JWT
                        .anyRequest().authenticated()
                )

                .addFilterBefore(
                        jwtAuthenticationFilter,
                        UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter.class
                );

        return http.build();
    }

    @Bean
    public CorsConfigurationSource corsConfigurationSource() {
        CorsConfiguration config = new CorsConfiguration();

        config.setAllowedOrigins(List.of(
                "http://localhost:5173",
                "https://dath-17-frontend.vercel.app"
        ));

        config.setAllowedMethods(List.of(
                "GET",
                "POST",
                "PUT",
                "PATCH",
                "DELETE",
                "OPTIONS"
        ));

        config.setAllowedHeaders(List.of(
                "Authorization",
                "Content-Type"
        ));

        UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource source =
                new UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource();

        source.registerCorsConfiguration("/**", config);

        return source;
    }

    @Bean
    public PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder() {
        return new BCryptPasswordEncoder();
    }

    @Bean
    public AuthenticationManager authenticationManager(
            CustomUserDetailsService userDetailsService,
            PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder
    ) {
        DaoAuthenticationProvider provider = new DaoAuthenticationProvider(userDetailsService);
        provider.setPasswordEncoder(passwordEncoder);
        return new ProviderManager(provider);
    }

    @Bean
    public FilterRegistrationBean<JwtAuthenticationFilter> jwtFilterRegistration(
            JwtAuthenticationFilter jwtAuthenticationFilter
    ) {
        FilterRegistrationBean<JwtAuthenticationFilter> registration =
                new FilterRegistrationBean<>(jwtAuthenticationFilter);
        registration.setEnabled(false);
        return registration;
    }
}

import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/courses")
@Validated
public class CourseController {
    private final CourseService service;

    public CourseController(CourseService service) {
        this.service = service;
    }

    /** Students only see PUBLISHED courses (filtered in CourseService). */
    @GetMapping
    public List<CourseResponse> findAll() {
        return service.findAll();
    }

    /** A student gets 404 for a course that is not PUBLISHED. */
    @GetMapping("/{id}")
    public CourseResponse findById(@PathVariable @Positive Long id) {
        return service.findById(id);
    }

    /** Only lecturers and admins create courses; the creator is the logged-in user. */
    @PostMapping
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('LECTURER', 'ADMIN')")
    public ResponseEntity<CourseResponse> create(@Valid @RequestBody CreateCourseRequest request) {
        CourseResponse response = service.create(request);
        return ResponseEntity.created(URI.create("/api/courses/" + response.id())).body(response);
    }

    /** Only the course's lecturer (created_by or course_lecturers) or an admin (checked in CourseService). */
    @PutMapping("/{id}")
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('LECTURER', 'ADMIN')")
    public CourseResponse update(@PathVariable @Positive Long id,
                                 @Valid @RequestBody UpdateCourseRequest request) {
        return service.update(id, request);
    }

    @GetMapping("/me")
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('STUDENT', 'LECTURER')")
    public ApiResponse<List<MyCourseResponse>> getMyCourses(
            @AuthenticationPrincipal CustomUserDetails currentUser) {

        return ApiResponse.ok(
                service.getMyCourses(currentUser)
        );
    }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.course.entity;

import jakarta.persistence.Column;
import jakarta.persistence.Entity;
import jakarta.persistence.EnumType;
import jakarta.persistence.Enumerated;
import jakarta.persistence.GeneratedValue;
import jakarta.persistence.GenerationType;
import jakarta.persistence.Id;
import jakarta.persistence.Table;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import org.hibernate.annotations.Generated;
import org.hibernate.generator.EventType;

@Entity
@Table(name = "courses")
public class Course {
    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long id;

    @Column(nullable = false, length = 255)
    private String title;

    @Column(columnDefinition = "TEXT")
    private String description;

    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(name = "publication_state", nullable = false, length = 30)
    private PublicationState publicationState;

    @Column(name = "is_enrollment_open", nullable = false)
    private boolean enrollmentOpen;

    @Column(name = "created_by", nullable = false, updatable = false)
    private Long createdBy;

    @Column(name = "created_at", nullable = false, insertable = false, updatable = false)
    @Generated(event = EventType.INSERT)
    private LocalDateTime createdAt;

    @Column(name = "updated_at", nullable = false, insertable = false, updatable = false)
    @Generated(event = {EventType.INSERT, EventType.UPDATE})
    private LocalDateTime updatedAt;

    protected Course() {}

    public Course(String title, String description, PublicationState publicationState,
                  boolean enrollmentOpen, Long createdBy) {
        this.title = title;
        this.description = description;
        this.publicationState = publicationState;
        this.enrollmentOpen = enrollmentOpen;
        this.createdBy = createdBy;
    }

    public Long getId() { return id; }
    public String getTitle() { return title; }
    public String getDescription() { return description; }
    public PublicationState getPublicationState() { return publicationState; }
    public boolean isEnrollmentOpen() { return enrollmentOpen; }
    public Long getCreatedBy() { return createdBy; }
    public LocalDateTime getCreatedAt() { return createdAt; }
    public LocalDateTime getUpdatedAt() { return updatedAt; }

    public void update(String title, String description, PublicationState publicationState,
                       boolean enrollmentOpen) {
        this.title = title;
        this.description = description;
        this.publicationState = publicationState;
        this.enrollmentOpen = enrollmentOpen;
    }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.course.service;

import com.smartcampus.backend.auth.security.CustomUserDetails;
import com.smartcampus.backend.common.security.CourseAccess;
import com.smartcampus.backend.course.dto.CourseResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.course.dto.CreateCourseRequest;
import com.smartcampus.backend.course.dto.MyCourseResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.course.dto.UpdateCourseRequest;
import com.smartcampus.backend.course.entity.Course;
import com.smartcampus.backend.course.entity.PublicationState;
import com.smartcampus.backend.course.exception.CourseNotFoundException;
import com.smartcampus.backend.course.repository.CourseRepository;
import java.util.List;

import com.smartcampus.backend.user.entity.User;
import com.smartcampus.backend.user.entity.UserRole;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;
import org.springframework.security.access.AccessDeniedException;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import com.smartcampus.backend.user.repository.UserRepository;
import com.smartcampus.backend.progress.repository.LearningProgressRepository;
import com.smartcampus.backend.progress.repository.projection.MyCourseProgressView;

@Service
public class CourseService {
    private static final Sort BY_ID = Sort.by("id");

    private final CourseRepository repository;
    private final LearningProgressRepository learningProgressRepository;
    private final UserRepository userRepository;
    private final CourseAccess access;

    public CourseService(
            CourseRepository repository,
            LearningProgressRepository learningProgressRepository,
            UserRepository userRepository,
            CourseAccess access
    ) {
        this.repository = repository;
        this.learningProgressRepository = learningProgressRepository;
        this.userRepository = userRepository;
        this.access = access;
    }

    /** Students only see the PUBLISHED catalog; lecturers and admins see every course. */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<CourseResponse> findAll() {
        List<Course> courses = access.hasRole("STUDENT")
                ? repository.findByPublicationState(PublicationState.PUBLISHED, BY_ID)
                : repository.findAll(BY_ID);
        return courses.stream().map(CourseResponse::from).toList();
    }

    /** A DRAFT or ARCHIVED course does not exist for a student (404, not 403, so nothing leaks). */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public CourseResponse findById(Long id) {
        Course course = requireCourse(id);
        if (access.hasRole("STUDENT") && course.getPublicationState() != PublicationState.PUBLISHED) {
            throw new CourseNotFoundException(id);
        }
        return CourseResponse.from(course);
    }

    /** The creator is always the logged-in user (role checked by @PreAuthorize on the controller). */
    @Transactional
    public CourseResponse create(CreateCourseRequest request) {
        Long creatorId = access.userId();
        Course course = new Course(request.title().trim(), request.description(),
                request.publicationState() == null ? PublicationState.DRAFT : request.publicationState(),
                Boolean.TRUE.equals(request.enrollmentOpen()), creatorId);
        return CourseResponse.from(repository.saveAndFlush(course));
    }

    /** 404 if the course does not exist, 403 unless admin or the course's lecturer (created_by / course_lecturers). */
    @Transactional
    public CourseResponse update(Long id, UpdateCourseRequest request) {
        access.requireStaff(id);
        Course course = requireCourse(id);
        course.update(request.title().trim(), request.description(), request.publicationState(),
                request.enrollmentOpen());
        return CourseResponse.from(repository.saveAndFlush(course));
    }

    private Course requireCourse(Long id) {
        return repository.findById(id).orElseThrow(() -> new CourseNotFoundException(id));
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<MyCourseResponse> getMyCourses(
            CustomUserDetails currentUser) {

        Long userId = currentUser.getId();

        if (currentUser.getRole() == UserRole.STUDENT) {
            return getStudentCourses(userId);
        }

        if (currentUser.getRole() == UserRole.LECTURER) {
            return getLecturerCourses(userId);
        }

        throw new AccessDeniedException("Access denied");
    }

    private List<MyCourseResponse> getStudentCourses(Long studentId) {

        List<MyCourseProgressView> courses =
                learningProgressRepository.findMyCourseProgress(studentId);

        return courses.stream()
                .map(course -> {

                    long totalLesson = course.getTotalLessons();
                    long completeLesson = course.getCompletedLessons();

                    double progressPercent = totalLesson == 0
                            ? 0.0
                            : Math.min(
                            100.0,
                            completeLesson * 100.0 / totalLesson
                    );

                    return new MyCourseResponse(
                            course.getCourseId(),
                            course.getCourseTitle(),
                            course.getInstructorName(),
                            progressPercent,
                            totalLesson,
                            completeLesson
                    );
                })
                .toList();
    }

    private List<MyCourseResponse> getLecturerCourses(Long lecturerId) {

        List<Course> courses = repository.findByCreatedBy(lecturerId);

        String instructorName = userRepository.findById(lecturerId)
                .map(User::getFullName)
                .orElse("Unknown");

        return courses.stream()
                .map(course -> {

                    long totalLesson =
                            learningProgressRepository.countLessonsOfCourse(
                                    course.getId()
                            );

                    return new MyCourseResponse(
                            course.getId(),
                            course.getTitle(),
                            instructorName,
                            null,
                            totalLesson,
                            null
                    );
                })
                .toList();
    }
}
