package com.smartcampus.backend.discussion;

import com.smartcampus.backend.common.config.OpenApiConfig;
import com.smartcampus.backend.discussion.DiscussionModels.*;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.security.SecurityRequirement;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Positive;
import java.net.URI;
import java.util.List;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.validation.annotation.Validated;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/courses/{courseId}/discussions")
@Tag(name = "Discussion", description = "Course comments and replies")
@SecurityRequirement(name = OpenApiConfig.BEARER_AUTH)
@Validated
public class DiscussionController {
    private final DiscussionService service;

    public DiscussionController(DiscussionService service) { this.service = service; }

    @Operation(summary = "List comments and replies for course participants")
    @GetMapping
    public List<CommentView> list(@PathVariable @Positive Long courseId) { return service.list(courseId); }

    @Operation(summary = "Post a question or reply using parentId")
    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<CommentView> create(@PathVariable @Positive Long courseId,
                                               @Valid @RequestBody CommentInput input) {
        CommentView result = service.create(courseId, input);
        return ResponseEntity.created(URI.create("/api/courses/" + courseId + "/discussions/" + result.id()))
                .body(result);
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Edit own comment; course lecturer or admin can moderate")
    @PutMapping("/{id}")
    public CommentView edit(@PathVariable @Positive Long courseId, @PathVariable @Positive Long id,
                            @Valid @RequestBody EditInput input) {
        return service.edit(courseId, id, input);
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Soft delete a comment while preserving its replies")
    @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> delete(@PathVariable @Positive Long courseId, @PathVariable @Positive Long id) {
        service.delete(courseId, id);
        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();
    }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.discussion;

import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Positive;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Size;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;

public final class DiscussionModels {
    private DiscussionModels() {}

    public record CommentInput(@NotBlank @Size(max = 5000) String content, @Positive Long parentId) {}
    public record EditInput(@NotBlank @Size(max = 5000) String content) {}
    public record CommentView(Long id, Long courseId, Long authorId, String authorName,
                              Long parentId, String content, boolean deleted,
                              LocalDateTime createdAt, LocalDateTime updatedAt) {}

package com.smartcampus.backend.discussion;

import com.smartcampus.backend.common.security.CourseAccess;
import com.smartcampus.backend.discussion.DiscussionModels.*;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.Statement;
import java.util.List;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.jdbc.support.GeneratedKeyHolder;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

@Service
public class DiscussionService {
    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final CourseAccess access;

    public DiscussionService(JdbcTemplate jdbc, CourseAccess access) {
        this.jdbc = jdbc;
        this.access = access;
    }

    public List<CommentView> list(Long courseId) {
        access.requireParticipant(courseId);
        return jdbc.query("""
                SELECT d.id, d.course_id, d.author_id, u.full_name, d.parent_id, d.content,
                       d.is_deleted, d.created_at, d.updated_at
                FROM course_discussions d JOIN users u ON u.id = d.author_id
                WHERE d.course_id = ? ORDER BY d.created_at, d.id
                """, (rs, row) -> new CommentView(rs.getLong("id"), rs.getLong("course_id"),
                rs.getLong("author_id"), rs.getString("full_name"),
                (Long) rs.getObject("parent_id"), rs.getString("content"),
                rs.getBoolean("is_deleted"), rs.getTimestamp("created_at").toLocalDateTime(),
                rs.getTimestamp("updated_at").toLocalDateTime()), courseId);
    }

    @Transactional
    public CommentView create(Long courseId, CommentInput input) {
        access.requireParticipant(courseId);
        if (input.parentId() != null) {
            Integer count = jdbc.queryForObject("""
                    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_discussions
                    WHERE id = ? AND course_id = ? AND is_deleted = FALSE
                    """, Integer.class, input.parentId(), courseId);
            if (count == null || count == 0) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                    "Parent comment not found in course");
        }
        GeneratedKeyHolder holder = new GeneratedKeyHolder();
        jdbc.update(connection -> {
            PreparedStatement statement = connection.prepareStatement("""
                    INSERT INTO course_discussions (course_id, author_id, parent_id, content)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
                    """, Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS);
            statement.setLong(1, courseId);
            statement.setLong(2, access.userId());
            statement.setObject(3, input.parentId());
            statement.setString(4, input.content().trim());
            return statement;
        }, holder);
        return find(courseId, holder.getKey().longValue());
    }

    /** Only the author edits a comment; moderators (lecturer/admin) can delete it but not rewrite it. */
    @Transactional
    public CommentView edit(Long courseId, Long id, EditInput input) {
        access.requireParticipant(courseId);
        requireOwner(courseId, id);
        int updated = jdbc.update("""
                UPDATE course_discussions SET content = ?
                WHERE id = ? AND course_id = ? AND is_deleted = FALSE
                """, input.content().trim(), id, courseId);
        if (updated == 0) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Comment not found");
        return find(courseId, id);
    }

    @Transactional
    public void delete(Long courseId, Long id) {
        access.requireParticipant(courseId);
        requireOwnerOrStaff(courseId, id);
        jdbc.update("""
                UPDATE course_discussions SET content = '[deleted]', is_deleted = TRUE
                WHERE id = ? AND course_id = ? AND is_deleted = FALSE
                """, id, courseId);
    }

    private Long requireAuthor(Long courseId, Long id) {
        Long authorId = jdbc.query("SELECT author_id FROM course_discussions WHERE id = ? AND course_id = ?",
                rs -> rs.next() ? rs.getLong(1) : null, id, courseId);
        if (authorId == null) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Comment not found");
        return authorId;
    }

    private void requireOwner(Long courseId, Long id) {
        if (!requireAuthor(courseId, id).equals(access.userId())) CourseAccess.forbidden();
    }

    private void requireOwnerOrStaff(Long courseId, Long id) {
        Long authorId = requireAuthor(courseId, id);
        if (authorId.equals(access.userId()) || access.hasRole("ADMIN")) return;
        if (access.hasRole("LECTURER")) { access.requireStaff(courseId); return; }
        CourseAccess.forbidden();
    }

    private CommentView find(Long courseId, Long id) {
        return list(courseId).stream().filter(c -> c.id().equals(id)).findFirst()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Comment not found"));
    }
}

/**

 * Lives in the enrollment module, not in CourseController, so modules never edit the same file.

@Tag(name = "Enrollment management", description = "Roster, enroll and remove students (assigned lecturer or admin)")
@SecurityRequirement(name = OpenApiConfig.BEARER_AUTH)
@RestController
public class CourseEnrollmentController {

    private final CurrentUserResolver currentUserResolver;

                                      CurrentUserResolver currentUserResolver) {

        this.currentUserResolver = currentUserResolver;
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Course roster",
            description = """
                    ACTIVE enrollments by default. includeInactive=true also lists WITHDRAWN and REMOVED.
                    Each row shows the enrollment status, the latest status change and the student's account status.

                    Errors: 404 COURSE_NOT_FOUND, 403 NOT_COURSE_STAFF.
                    """)
    @GetMapping("/api/courses/{courseId}/enrollments")
    public ApiResponse<List<RosterEntryResponse>> getRoster(
            @Parameter(example = "9101", required = true) @PathVariable("courseId") Long courseId,
            @Parameter(example = "false") @RequestParam(name = "includeInactive", defaultValue = "false")
            boolean includeInactive) {
        Long actorId = currentUserResolver.getCurrentUserId();
        return ApiResponse.ok(managementService.getRoster(actorId, courseId, includeInactive));
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Enroll or reinstate a student",
            description = """
                    Creates an ACTIVE enrollment, or reinstates a WITHDRAWN/REMOVED one (same record).
                    The enrollment window must be open. When it is closed, only an ADMIN may set
                    adminOverride=true with a reason; the override is written to enrollment_histories and audit_logs.
                    The student receives an ENROLLED_BY_STAFF notification.

                    Errors: 404 COURSE_NOT_FOUND / STUDENT_NOT_FOUND, 403 NOT_COURSE_STAFF / OVERRIDE_NOT_ALLOWED,
                    400 NOT_A_STUDENT / STUDENT_INACTIVE / ENROLLMENT_CLOSED / OVERRIDE_REASON_REQUIRED / VALIDATION_ERROR,
                    409 ALREADY_ENROLLED.
                    """)
    @PostMapping("/api/courses/{courseId}/enrollments")
    public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<EnrollmentResponse>> enrollStudent(
            @Parameter(example = "9101", required = true) @PathVariable("courseId") Long courseId,
            @Valid @RequestBody EnrollStudentRequest request) {
        Long actorId = currentUserResolver.getCurrentUserId();
        EnrollmentResponse response = managementService.enrollStudent(actorId, courseId, request);
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(ApiResponse.ok(response));
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Remove a student from a course",
            description = """
                    ACTIVE -> REMOVED. Writes enrollment_histories and audit_logs, and sends the student
                    a REMOVED_FROM_COURSE notification. Learning data is kept. Body is optional: {"reason": "..."}.

                    Errors: 404 COURSE_NOT_FOUND / NOT_ENROLLED, 403 NOT_COURSE_STAFF, 409 ENROLLMENT_NOT_ACTIVE.
                    """)
    @PostMapping("/api/courses/{courseId}/enrollments/{studentId}/remove")
    public ApiResponse<EnrollmentStatusResponse> removeStudent(

            @Parameter(example = "9001", required = true) @PathVariable("studentId") Long studentId,
            @Valid @RequestBody(required = false) ReasonRequest body) {
        Long actorId = currentUserResolver.getCurrentUserId();
        return ApiResponse.ok(managementService.removeStudent(actorId, courseId, studentId,
                body == null ? null : body.reason()));
    }
}

            description = """
                    Only an ACTIVE user with role STUDENT may call this. The student is taken
                    from the JWT, never from the request.

                    Rules:
                    - the course exists
                    - the course is PUBLISHED
                    - the course is open for enrollment (is_enrollment_open = true)
                    - one enrollment per student and course (also enforced by a DB unique key)

                    No enrollment yet -> a new ACTIVE enrollment is created.
                    A WITHDRAWN enrollment is reactivated (same record, history kept).
                    A REMOVED student gets 403 ENROLLMENT_REMOVED: only the lecturer/admin can reinstate him.
                    """)

                            examples = @ExampleObject(name = "Created", value = EnrollmentApiExamples.ENROLL_CREATED))),
            @io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "400", description = "Course not published, enrollment closed, or invalid course id",
                    content = @Content(mediaType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE,
                            schema = @Schema(implementation = ApiResponse.class),
                            examples = {
                                    @ExampleObject(name = "COURSE_NOT_PUBLISHED", value = EnrollmentApiExamples.COURSE_NOT_PUBLISHED),
                                    @ExampleObject(name = "ENROLLMENT_CLOSED", value = EnrollmentApiExamples.ENROLLMENT_CLOSED),
                                    @ExampleObject(name = "INVALID_PARAMETER", value = EnrollmentApiExamples.INVALID_PARAMETER)
                            })),
            @io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "401", description = "Missing, invalid or expired JWT",
                    content = @Content),
            @io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "403", description = "The user is not a STUDENT, the account is INACTIVE, or the student was REMOVED from this course (ENROLLMENT_REMOVED)",
                    content = @Content(mediaType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE,
                            schema = @Schema(implementation = ApiResponse.class),
                            examples = {
                                    @ExampleObject(name = "NOT_A_STUDENT", value = EnrollmentApiExamples.NOT_A_STUDENT),
                                    @ExampleObject(name = "ACCOUNT_INACTIVE", value = EnrollmentApiExamples.ACCOUNT_INACTIVE)

        return ApiResponse.ok(enrollmentService.withdraw(studentId, courseId, body == null ? null : body.reason()));
    }

            summary = "Status history of an enrollment",
            description = """
                    Append-only list of status changes, oldest first. Visible to the student who owns
                    the enrollment and to the course's lecturer/admin.

                    Errors: 404 ENROLLMENT_NOT_FOUND, 403 NOT_ALLOWED.
                    """)
    @GetMapping("/api/enrollments/{enrollmentId}/history")
    public ApiResponse<List<EnrollmentHistoryResponse>> getHistory(
            @Parameter(example = "1", required = true) @PathVariable("enrollmentId") Long enrollmentId) {
        Long userId = currentUserResolver.getCurrentUserId();
        return ApiResponse.ok(enrollmentService.getHistory(userId, enrollmentId));
    }
}

import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotNull;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Positive;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;

@Entity
@Table(name = "enrollments")
public class Enrollment {
    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long id;

    @Column(name = "student_id", nullable = false, updatable = false)
    private Long studentId;

    @Column(name = "course_id", nullable = false, updatable = false)

    private EnrollmentStatus status;

    @Generated

    private LocalDateTime enrolledAt;

    @Generated(event = {EventType.INSERT, EventType.UPDATE})
    @Column(name = "updated_at", insertable = false, updatable = false)
    private LocalDateTime updatedAt;

    protected Enrollment() {
        // for JPA
    }

    public Enrollment(Long studentId, Long courseId) {
        this.studentId = studentId;
        this.courseId = courseId;
        this.status = EnrollmentStatus.ACTIVE;
    }

        return id;

        return studentId;

        return courseId;

package com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.entity;

import jakarta.persistence.Column;
import jakarta.persistence.Entity;
import jakarta.persistence.EnumType;
import jakarta.persistence.Enumerated;
import jakarta.persistence.GeneratedValue;
import jakarta.persistence.GenerationType;
import jakarta.persistence.Id;
import jakarta.persistence.Table;
import org.hibernate.annotations.Generated;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;

@Entity
@Table(name = "enrollment_histories")
public class EnrollmentHistory {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long id;

    @Column(name = "enrollment_id", nullable = false, updatable = false)
    private Long enrollmentId;

    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(name = "previous_status", length = 30, columnDefinition = "VARCHAR(30)", updatable = false)
    private EnrollmentStatus previousStatus;

    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(name = "new_status", nullable = false, length = 30, columnDefinition = "VARCHAR(30)", updatable = false)
    private EnrollmentStatus newStatus;

    @Column(name = "changed_by", nullable = false, updatable = false)
    private Long changedBy;

    @Column(name = "reason", columnDefinition = "TEXT", updatable = false)
    private String reason;

    @Generated
    @Column(name = "created_at", insertable = false, updatable = false)
    private LocalDateTime createdAt;

    protected EnrollmentHistory() {
        // for JPA
    }

    public EnrollmentHistory(Long enrollmentId, EnrollmentStatus previousStatus, EnrollmentStatus newStatus, Long changedBy, String reason) {
        this.enrollmentId = enrollmentId;
        this.previousStatus = previousStatus;
        this.newStatus = newStatus;
        this.changedBy = changedBy;
        this.reason = reason;
    }

        return  newStatus;
    }

    public Long getChangedBy() {
        return changedBy;
    }

    public String getReason() {
        return reason;
    }

    public LocalDateTime getCreatedAt() {

/**
 * docs/01-requirements/03-enrollment.md Â§3.1 (DB check added by V2__enrollment_status_withdrawn_removed.sql).

        return new EnrollmentException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, code, message);

        return new EnrollmentException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, code, message);

package com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.repository;

import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.entity.Enrollment;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.entity.EnrollmentStatus;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.repository.projection.CourseEnrollmentInfo;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.repository.projection.MyEnrollmentView;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.repository.projection.RosterEntryView;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.repository.projection.UserAccountInfo;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Modifying;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query;
import org.springframework.data.repository.query.Param;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

public interface EnrollmentRepository extends JpaRepository<Enrollment, Long> {

    boolean existsByStudentIdAndCourseId(Long studentId, Long courseId);

    Optional<Enrollment> findByStudentIdAndCourseId(Long studentId, Long courseId);

    /**
     * Conditional status change (FR-ENROLL-003: never check-then-insert/update).
     * Returns 0 when another request already changed the status.
     */
    @Modifying(clearAutomatically = true, flushAutomatically = true)
    @Query("UPDATE Enrollment e SET e.status = :toStatus WHERE e.id = :id AND e.status = :fromStatus")
    int transitionStatus(@Param("id") Long id,
                         @Param("fromStatus") EnrollmentStatus from,
                         @Param("toStatus") EnrollmentStatus to);

    @Query(value = """
            SELECT c.id                AS id,
                   c.title             AS title,
                   c.publication_state AS publicationState,
                   CASE WHEN c.is_enrollment_open THEN 'OPEN' ELSE 'CLOSED' END AS enrollmentWindow
            FROM courses c
            WHERE c.id = :courseId
            """, nativeQuery = true)
    Optional<CourseEnrollmentInfo> findCourseEnrollmentInfo(@Param("courseId") Long courseId);

    @Query(value = """
            SELECT u.id     AS id,
                   u.role   AS role,
                   u.status AS status
            FROM users u
            WHERE u.id = :userId
            """, nativeQuery = true)
    Optional<UserAccountInfo> findUserAccountInfo(@Param("userId") Long userId);

    @Query(value = """
            SELECT u.id
            FROM users u
            WHERE u.username = :login OR u.email = :login
            """, nativeQuery = true)
    Optional<Long> findUserIdByLogin(@Param("login") String login);

    @Query(value = """
            SELECT e.id                AS enrollmentId,
                   e.status            AS status,
                   e.enrolled_at       AS enrolledAt,
                   c.id                AS courseId,
                   c.title             AS courseTitle,
                   c.description       AS courseDescription,
                   c.publication_state AS publicationState
            FROM enrollments e
            JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id
            WHERE e.student_id = :studentId
              AND e.status = 'ACTIVE'
            ORDER BY e.enrolled_at DESC, e.id DESC
            """, nativeQuery = true)
    List<MyEnrollmentView> findActiveEnrollmentsOfStudent(@Param("studentId") Long studentId);

    /** Roster of a course; includeInactive = true also returns WITHDRAWN and REMOVED. */
    @Query(value = """
            SELECT e.id          AS enrollmentId,
                   u.id          AS studentId,
                   u.username    AS username,
                   u.full_name   AS fullName,
                   u.email       AS email,
                   u.status      AS accountStatus,
                   e.status      AS status,
                   e.enrolled_at AS enrolledAt,
                   e.updated_at  AS statusChangedAt
            FROM enrollments e
            JOIN users u ON u.id = e.student_id
            WHERE e.course_id = :courseId
              AND (:includeInactive = TRUE OR e.status = 'ACTIVE')
            ORDER BY CASE e.status WHEN 'ACTIVE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, u.full_name, u.id
            """, nativeQuery = true)
    List<RosterEntryView> findRoster(@Param("courseId") Long courseId,
                                     @Param("includeInactive") boolean includeInactive);

    /** Administrative audit log (FR-ACCESS: enrollment override, removal of a Student). */
    @Modifying
    @Query(value = """
            INSERT INTO audit_logs (acting_user_id, target_user_id, action, reason)
            VALUES (:actorId, :targetUserId, :action, :reason)
            """, nativeQuery = true)
    int insertAuditLog(@Param("actorId") Long actorId,
                       @Param("targetUserId") Long targetUserId,
                       @Param("action") String action,
                       @Param("reason") String reason);

    List<Enrollment> findByStudentIdAndStatus(Long studentId, EnrollmentStatus enrollmentStatus);
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.security;

import com.smartcampus.backend.auth.security.CustomUserDetails;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.exception.EnrollmentException;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.repository.EnrollmentRepository;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.AnonymousAuthenticationToken;
import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class CurrentUserResolver {

    private final EnrollmentRepository enrollmentRepository;

    public CurrentUserResolver(EnrollmentRepository enrollmentRepository) {
        this.enrollmentRepository = enrollmentRepository;
    }

    public Long getCurrentUserId() {
        Authentication auth = SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication();
        if (auth == null || !auth.isAuthenticated() || auth instanceof AnonymousAuthenticationToken) {
            throw EnrollmentException.unauthorized("Please log in");
        }

        Object principal = auth.getPrincipal();

        if (principal instanceof CustomUserDetails user) {
            return user.getId();
        }

        if (principal instanceof Long userId) {
            return userId;
        }

        return enrollmentRepository.findUserIdByLogin(auth.getName())
                .orElseThrow(() -> EnrollmentException.unauthorized("Logged-in user not found"));
    }
}

FILE: C:\Users\Dat\IdeaProjects\DATH_17\backend\src\main\java\com\smartcampus\backend\enrollment\service\EnrollmentManagementService.java
========================================
package com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.service;

import com.smartcampus.backend.common.security.CourseAccessGuard;
import com.smartcampus.backend.common.security.UserAccount;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.dto.EnrollStudentRequest;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.dto.EnrollmentResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.dto.EnrollmentStatusResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.dto.RosterEntryResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.entity.Enrollment;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.entity.EnrollmentHistory;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.entity.EnrollmentStatus;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.exception.EnrollmentException;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.repository.EnrollmentHistoryRepository;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.repository.EnrollmentRepository;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.repository.projection.CourseEnrollmentInfo;
import com.smartcampus.backend.notification.entity.NotificationType;
import com.smartcampus.backend.notification.service.NotificationService;
import org.springframework.dao.DataIntegrityViolationException;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

/**
 * Staff side of Enrollment (assigned Lecturer or Administrator):
 * UC-ENROLL-002 enroll a student (with Administrator override),
 * UC-ENROLL-003 roster, UC-ENROLL-006 remove a student.
 */
@Service
public class EnrollmentManagementService {

    static final String AUDIT_OVERRIDE = "ENROLLMENT_OVERRIDE";
    static final String AUDIT_REMOVE = "ENROLLMENT_REMOVED";
    static final String STAFF_ENROLL_REASON = "Enrolled by staff";
    static final String STAFF_REMOVE_REASON = "Removed by staff";

    private final EnrollmentRepository enrollmentRepository;
    private final EnrollmentHistoryRepository enrollmentHistoryRepository;
    private final CourseAccessGuard courseAccessGuard;
    private final NotificationService notificationService;

    public EnrollmentManagementService(EnrollmentRepository enrollmentRepository,
                                       EnrollmentHistoryRepository enrollmentHistoryRepository,
                                       CourseAccessGuard courseAccessGuard,
                                       NotificationService notificationService) {
        this.enrollmentRepository = enrollmentRepository;
        this.enrollmentHistoryRepository = enrollmentHistoryRepository;
        this.courseAccessGuard = courseAccessGuard;
        this.notificationService = notificationService;
    }

    /** UC-ENROLL-003: ACTIVE students by default; includeInactive adds WITHDRAWN and REMOVED. */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<RosterEntryResponse> getRoster(Long actorId, Long courseId, boolean includeInactive) {
        UserAccount actor = courseAccessGuard.requireUser(actorId);
        courseAccessGuard.requireCourseManager(actor, courseId);
        return enrollmentRepository.findRoster(courseId, includeInactive)
                .stream()
                .map(RosterEntryResponse::of)
                .toList();
    }

    /**
     * UC-ENROLL-002.
     *  - new student                        -> ACTIVE enrollment
     *  - WITHDRAWN or REMOVED               -> reinstated to ACTIVE (same record)
     *  - already ACTIVE                     -> 409 ALREADY_ENROLLED
     *  - window closed                      -> 400 ENROLLMENT_CLOSED, unless an Administrator
     *                                          sets adminOverride with a reason (A3): history + audit log
     */
    @Transactional
    public EnrollmentResponse enrollStudent(Long actorId, Long courseId, EnrollStudentRequest request) {
        UserAccount actor = courseAccessGuard.requireUser(actorId);
        courseAccessGuard.requireCourseManager(actor, courseId);
        CourseEnrollmentInfo course = enrollmentRepository.findCourseEnrollmentInfo(courseId).orElseThrow();

        Long studentId = request.studentId();
        UserAccount student = courseAccessGuard.findUser(studentId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> EnrollmentException.notFound("STUDENT_NOT_FOUND",
                        "User " + studentId + " does not exist"));
        if (!student.isStudent()) {
            throw EnrollmentException.badRequest("NOT_A_STUDENT", "User " + studentId + " is not a student");
        }
        if (!student.isActive()) {
            throw EnrollmentException.badRequest("STUDENT_INACTIVE", "Student " + studentId + " is inactive");
        }

        boolean override = checkEnrollmentWindow(actor, course, request);
        String reason = EnrollmentService.reasonOr(request.reason(), STAFF_ENROLL_REASON);

        Enrollment enrollment;
        Optional<Enrollment> existing = enrollmentRepository.findByStudentIdAndCourseId(studentId, courseId);
        if (existing.isPresent()) {
            enrollment = reinstate(existing.get(), actorId, reason);
        } else {
            enrollment = create(studentId, courseId, actorId, reason);
        }

        if (override) {
            enrollmentRepository.insertAuditLog(actorId, studentId, AUDIT_OVERRIDE,
                    "Course " + courseId + ": " + request.reason().trim());
        }
        notificationService.notify(studentId, NotificationType.ENROLLED_BY_STAFF,
                "Added to a course",
                "You were enrolled in \"" + course.getTitle() + "\".",
                "/courses/" + courseId);
        return EnrollmentResponse.of(enrollment, course);
    }

    /** UC-ENROLL-006: ACTIVE -> REMOVED, with history, audit log and a notification to the student. */
    @Transactional
    public EnrollmentStatusResponse removeStudent(Long actorId, Long courseId, Long studentId, String reason) {
        UserAccount actor = courseAccessGuard.requireUser(actorId);
        courseAccessGuard.requireCourseManager(actor, courseId);

        Enrollment enrollment = enrollmentRepository.findByStudentIdAndCourseId(studentId, courseId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> EnrollmentException.notFound("NOT_ENROLLED",
                        "Student " + studentId + " is not enrolled in course " + courseId));
        if (enrollment.getStatus() != EnrollmentStatus.ACTIVE
                || enrollmentRepository.transitionStatus(enrollment.getId(),
                EnrollmentStatus.ACTIVE, EnrollmentStatus.REMOVED) == 0) {
            throw EnrollmentException.conflict("ENROLLMENT_NOT_ACTIVE",
                    "Student " + studentId + " has no ACTIVE enrollment in course " + courseId);
        }
        String finalReason = EnrollmentService.reasonOr(reason, STAFF_REMOVE_REASON);
        enrollmentHistoryRepository.save(new EnrollmentHistory(enrollment.getId(), EnrollmentStatus.ACTIVE,
                EnrollmentStatus.REMOVED, actorId, finalReason));
        enrollmentRepository.insertAuditLog(actorId, studentId, AUDIT_REMOVE,
                "Course " + courseId + ": " + finalReason);

        String courseTitle = enrollmentRepository.findCourseEnrollmentInfo(courseId)
                .map(CourseEnrollmentInfo::getTitle).orElse("course " + courseId);
        notificationService.notify(studentId, NotificationType.REMOVED_FROM_COURSE,
                "Removed from a course",
                "You were removed from \"" + courseTitle + "\". Reason: " + finalReason,
                "/courses/" + courseId);
        return EnrollmentStatusResponse.of(enrollmentRepository.findById(enrollment.getId()).orElseThrow());
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers

    /** @return true when an Administrator override is used */
    private boolean checkEnrollmentWindow(UserAccount actor, CourseEnrollmentInfo course, EnrollStudentRequest request) {
        if (EnrollmentService.ENROLLMENT_WINDOW_OPEN.equals(course.getEnrollmentWindow())) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!Boolean.TRUE.equals(request.adminOverride())) {
            throw EnrollmentException.badRequest("ENROLLMENT_CLOSED",
                    "Course " + course.getId() + " is not accepting new enrollments");
        }
        if (!actor.isAdmin()) {
            throw EnrollmentException.forbidden("OVERRIDE_NOT_ALLOWED",
                    "Only an administrator can override a closed enrollment window");
        }
        if (request.reason() == null || request.reason().isBlank()) {
            throw EnrollmentException.badRequest("OVERRIDE_REASON_REQUIRED",
                    "A reason is required to override a closed enrollment window");
        }
        return true;
    }

    private Enrollment reinstate(Enrollment existing, Long actorId, String reason) {
        EnrollmentStatus from = existing.getStatus();
        if (from == EnrollmentStatus.ACTIVE
                || enrollmentRepository.transitionStatus(existing.getId(), from, EnrollmentStatus.ACTIVE) == 0) {
            throw EnrollmentException.conflict("ALREADY_ENROLLED",
                    "Student " + existing.getStudentId() + " is already enrolled in course " + existing.getCourseId());
        }
        enrollmentHistoryRepository.save(new EnrollmentHistory(existing.getId(), from,
                EnrollmentStatus.ACTIVE, actorId, reason));
        return enrollmentRepository.findById(existing.getId()).orElseThrow();
    }

    private Enrollment create(Long studentId, Long courseId, Long actorId, String reason) {
        Enrollment enrollment;
        try {
            enrollment = enrollmentRepository.saveAndFlush(new Enrollment(studentId, courseId));
        } catch (DataIntegrityViolationException ex) {
            throw EnrollmentException.conflict("ALREADY_ENROLLED",
                    "Student " + studentId + " is already enrolled in course " + courseId);
        }
        enrollmentHistoryRepository.save(EnrollmentHistory.initial(enrollment.getId(), actorId, reason));
        return enrollment;
    }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.service;

import com.smartcampus.backend.common.security.CourseAccessGuard;
import com.smartcampus.backend.common.security.UserAccount;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.dto.EnrollmentHistoryResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.dto.EnrollmentResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.dto.EnrollmentStatusResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.dto.MyEnrollmentResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.entity.Enrollment;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.entity.EnrollmentHistory;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.entity.EnrollmentStatus;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.exception.EnrollmentException;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.repository.EnrollmentHistoryRepository;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.repository.EnrollmentRepository;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.repository.projection.CourseEnrollmentInfo;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.repository.projection.UserAccountInfo;
import org.springframework.dao.DataIntegrityViolationException;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

/**
 * Student self-service: enroll / re-enroll, withdraw, my courses, history.
 * Staff actions (roster, enroll a student, remove) are in EnrollmentManagementService.
 */
@Service
public class EnrollmentService {

    static final String ROLE_STUDENT = "STUDENT";
    static final String ACCOUNT_ACTIVE = "ACTIVE";
    static final String COURSE_PUBLISHED = "PUBLISHED";
    static final String ENROLLMENT_WINDOW_OPEN = "OPEN";
    static final String SELF_ENROLL_REASON = "Student self-enrollment";
    static final String RE_ENROLL_REASON = "Student re-enrollment";
    static final String WITHDRAW_REASON = "Student withdrawal";

    private final EnrollmentRepository enrollmentRepository;
    private final EnrollmentHistoryRepository enrollmentHistoryRepository;
    private final CourseAccessGuard courseAccessGuard;

    public EnrollmentService(EnrollmentRepository enrollmentRepository,
                             EnrollmentHistoryRepository enrollmentHistoryRepository,
                             CourseAccessGuard courseAccessGuard) {
        this.enrollmentRepository = enrollmentRepository;
        this.enrollmentHistoryRepository = enrollmentHistoryRepository;
        this.courseAccessGuard = courseAccessGuard;
    }

    /**
     * UC-ENROLL-001: the current Student enrolls in a course.
     *
     *  - the caller is an ACTIVE user with role STUDENT
     *  - the course exists, is PUBLISHED and its enrollment window is open
     *  - no enrollment yet          -> create ACTIVE (unique key guards concurrent requests)
     *  - WITHDRAWN enrollment       -> reactivate the same record (A1, BR-ENROLL-006)
     *  - ACTIVE enrollment          -> 409 ALREADY_ENROLLED (E2)
     *  - REMOVED enrollment         -> 403 ENROLLMENT_REMOVED, only staff can reinstate (E4)
     */
    @Transactional
    public EnrollmentResponse enroll(Long studentId, Long courseId) {
        // Cháº·n hoÃ n toÃ n tÃ­nh nÄƒng tá»± Ä‘Äƒng kÃ½ tá»« phÃ­a sinh viÃªn
        throw EnrollmentException.forbidden(
                "SELF_ENROLL_DISABLED",
                "Students are not allowed to self-enroll in courses. Please contact your instructor or system administrator."
        );

    /* CÃ³ thá»ƒ xÃ³a hoáº·c comment láº¡i toÃ n bá»™ logic cÅ© á»Ÿ dÆ°á»›i:
    requireActiveStudent(studentId);
    CourseEnrollmentInfo course = requireEnrollableCourse(courseId);

    Optional<Enrollment> existing = enrollmentRepository.findByStudentIdAndCourseId(studentId, courseId);
    if (existing.isPresent()) {
        return reactivateWithdrawn(existing.get(), studentId, course);
    }

    Enrollment enrollment;
    try {
        enrollment = enrollmentRepository.saveAndFlush(new Enrollment(studentId, courseId));
    } catch (DataIntegrityViolationException ex) {
        throw alreadyEnrolled(courseId);
    }
    enrollmentHistoryRepository.save(
            EnrollmentHistory.initial(enrollment.getId(), studentId, SELF_ENROLL_REASON));
    return EnrollmentResponse.of(enrollment, course);
    */
    }

    /** UC-ENROLL-005: the Student ends his own ACTIVE enrollment (ACTIVE -> WITHDRAWN). */
    @Transactional
    public EnrollmentStatusResponse withdraw(Long studentId, Long courseId, String reason) {
        requireStudentRole(studentId);
        Enrollment enrollment = enrollmentRepository.findByStudentIdAndCourseId(studentId, courseId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> notEnrolled(courseId));
        if (enrollment.getStatus() != EnrollmentStatus.ACTIVE
                || enrollmentRepository.transitionStatus(enrollment.getId(),
                EnrollmentStatus.ACTIVE, EnrollmentStatus.WITHDRAWN) == 0) {
            throw EnrollmentException.conflict("ENROLLMENT_NOT_ACTIVE",
                    "You have no ACTIVE enrollment in course " + courseId);
        }
        enrollmentHistoryRepository.save(new EnrollmentHistory(enrollment.getId(), EnrollmentStatus.ACTIVE,
                EnrollmentStatus.WITHDRAWN, studentId, reasonOr(reason, WITHDRAW_REASON)));
        return EnrollmentStatusResponse.of(reload(enrollment.getId()));
    }

    /** UC-ENROLL-004: courses the Student currently participates in (ACTIVE only). */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<MyEnrollmentResponse> getMyEnrollments(Long studentId) {
        return enrollmentRepository.findActiveEnrollmentsOfStudent(studentId)
                .stream()
                .map(MyEnrollmentResponse::of)
                .toList();
    }

    /** FR-ENROLL-007: status history, visible to the student himself and to the course staff. */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<EnrollmentHistoryResponse> getHistory(Long userId, Long enrollmentId) {
        Enrollment enrollment = enrollmentRepository.findById(enrollmentId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> EnrollmentException.notFound("ENROLLMENT_NOT_FOUND",
                        "Enrollment " + enrollmentId + " does not exist"));
        if (!enrollment.getStudentId().equals(userId)) {
            UserAccount user = courseAccessGuard.requireUser(userId);
            if (!courseAccessGuard.canManageCourse(user, enrollment.getCourseId())) {
                throw EnrollmentException.forbidden("NOT_ALLOWED",
                        "You cannot view the history of this enrollment");
            }
        }
        return enrollmentHistoryRepository.findByEnrollmentIdOrderByCreatedAtAscIdAsc(enrollmentId)
                .stream()
                .map(EnrollmentHistoryResponse::of)
                .toList();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers

    private EnrollmentResponse reactivateWithdrawn(Enrollment existing, Long studentId, CourseEnrollmentInfo course) {
        Long courseId = course.getId();
        switch (existing.getStatus()) {
            case ACTIVE -> throw alreadyEnrolled(courseId);
            case REMOVED -> throw EnrollmentException.forbidden("ENROLLMENT_REMOVED",
                    "You were removed from course " + courseId + "; ask the lecturer to reinstate you");
            case WITHDRAWN -> {
                // conditional update: a concurrent request that won first makes this return 0
                int updated = enrollmentRepository.transitionStatus(existing.getId(),
                        EnrollmentStatus.WITHDRAWN, EnrollmentStatus.ACTIVE);
                if (updated == 0) {
                    throw alreadyEnrolled(courseId);
                }
                enrollmentHistoryRepository.save(new EnrollmentHistory(existing.getId(),
                        EnrollmentStatus.WITHDRAWN, EnrollmentStatus.ACTIVE, studentId, RE_ENROLL_REASON));
                return EnrollmentResponse.of(reload(existing.getId()), course);
            }
            default -> throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown status " + existing.getStatus());
        }
    }

    private CourseEnrollmentInfo requireEnrollableCourse(Long courseId) {
        CourseEnrollmentInfo course = enrollmentRepository.findCourseEnrollmentInfo(courseId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> EnrollmentException.notFound(
                        "COURSE_NOT_FOUND", "Course " + courseId + " does not exist"));
        if (!COURSE_PUBLISHED.equals(course.getPublicationState())) {
            throw EnrollmentException.badRequest(
                    "COURSE_NOT_PUBLISHED", "Course " + courseId + " is not published");
        }
        if (!ENROLLMENT_WINDOW_OPEN.equals(course.getEnrollmentWindow())) {
            throw EnrollmentException.badRequest(
                    "ENROLLMENT_CLOSED", "Course " + courseId + " is not accepting new enrollments");
        }
        return course;
    }

    private void requireActiveStudent(Long userId) {
        UserAccountInfo user = requireStudentRole(userId);
        if (!ACCOUNT_ACTIVE.equals(user.getStatus())) {
            throw EnrollmentException.forbidden("ACCOUNT_INACTIVE", "Your account is inactive");
        }
    }

    private UserAccountInfo requireStudentRole(Long userId) {
        UserAccountInfo user = enrollmentRepository.findUserAccountInfo(userId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> EnrollmentException.unauthorized("User " + userId + " does not exist"));
        if (!ROLE_STUDENT.equals(user.getRole())) {
            throw EnrollmentException.forbidden("NOT_A_STUDENT", "Only students can do this");
        }
        return user;
    }

    private Enrollment reload(Long enrollmentId) {
        return enrollmentRepository.findById(enrollmentId).orElseThrow();
    }

    static String reasonOr(String reason, String fallback) {
        return reason == null || reason.isBlank() ? fallback : reason.trim();
    }

    private static EnrollmentException alreadyEnrolled(Long courseId) {
        return EnrollmentException.conflict(
                "ALREADY_ENROLLED", "You are already enrolled in course " + courseId);
    }

    private static EnrollmentException notEnrolled(Long courseId) {
        return EnrollmentException.notFound("NOT_ENROLLED", "You are not enrolled in course " + courseId);
    }
}

import java.util.List;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/courses/{courseId}/chapters")
public class ChapterController {

    private final ChapterService chapterService;

    public ChapterController(ChapterService chapterService) {
        this.chapterService = chapterService;
    }

    @GetMapping
    public List<ChapterResponse> getChapters(
            @PathVariable Long courseId,
            @AuthenticationPrincipal CustomUserDetails currentUser
    ) {
        return chapterService.getChaptersByCourse(courseId, currentUser);
    }

    @PostMapping
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN', 'LECTURER')")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
    public ChapterResponse createChapter(
            @PathVariable Long courseId,
            @Valid @RequestBody CreateChapterRequest request,
            @AuthenticationPrincipal CustomUserDetails currentUser
    ) {
        return chapterService.createChapter(
                courseId,
                request,
                currentUser
        );
    }

    @PutMapping("/{chapterId}")
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN', 'LECTURER')")
    public ChapterResponse updateChapter(
            @PathVariable Long courseId,
            @PathVariable Long chapterId,
            @Valid @RequestBody UpdateChapterRequest request,
            @AuthenticationPrincipal CustomUserDetails currentUser
    ) {
        return chapterService.updateChapter(
                courseId, chapterId, request, currentUser
        );
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/{chapterId}")
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN', 'LECTURER')")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
    public void deleteChapter(
            @PathVariable Long courseId,

                courseId, chapterId, currentUser
        );

package com.smartcampus.backend.learningcontent.entity;

import jakarta.persistence.*;

@Entity
@Table(name = "chapters")
public class Chapter {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long id;

    @Column(name = "course_id", nullable = false)
    private Long courseId;

    @Column(nullable = false, length = 255)
    private String title;

    @Column(name = "order_index", nullable = false)
    private int orderIndex;

    protected Chapter() {}

    public Chapter(Long courseId, String title, int orderIndex) {
        this.courseId = courseId;
        this.title = title;
        this.orderIndex = orderIndex;
    }

    public Long getId() {
        return id;
    }

    public Long getCourseId() {
        return courseId;
    }

    public String getTitle() {
        return title;
    }

    public int getOrderIndex() {
        return orderIndex;
    }

    public void update(String title, int orderIndex) {
        this.title = title;
        this.orderIndex = orderIndex;
    }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.learningcontent.entity;

import jakarta.persistence.*;

@Entity
@Table(name = "learning_materials")

package com.smartcampus.backend.learningcontent.service;

import com.smartcampus.backend.auth.security.CustomUserDetails;
import com.smartcampus.backend.course.repository.CourseRepository;
import com.smartcampus.backend.learningcontent.dto.ChapterResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.learningcontent.dto.CreateChapterRequest;
import com.smartcampus.backend.learningcontent.dto.UpdateChapterRequest;
import com.smartcampus.backend.learningcontent.entity.Chapter;
import com.smartcampus.backend.learningcontent.repository.ChapterRepository;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.List;

@Service
public class ChapterService {

    private final ChapterRepository chapterRepository;
    private final CourseRepository courseRepository;
    private final CourseAccessService courseAccessService;

    public ChapterService(
            ChapterRepository chapterRepository,
            CourseRepository courseRepository,
            CourseAccessService courseAccessService
    ) {
        this.chapterRepository = chapterRepository;
        this.courseRepository = courseRepository;
        this.courseAccessService = courseAccessService;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<ChapterResponse> getChaptersByCourse(Long courseId, CustomUserDetails currentUser) {

        // Chá»‰ staff cá»§a khoÃ¡ hoáº·c student cÃ³ enrollment ACTIVE trong khoÃ¡ PUBLISHED
        courseAccessService.requireViewPermission(courseId, currentUser);

        if (!courseRepository.existsById(courseId)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                    "Course not found"
            );
        }

        return chapterRepository
                .findByCourseIdOrderByOrderIndexAsc(courseId)
                .stream()
                .map(this::toResponse)
                .toList();
    }

    private ChapterResponse toResponse(Chapter chapter) {
        return new ChapterResponse(
                chapter.getId(),
                chapter.getCourseId(),
                chapter.getTitle(),
                chapter.getOrderIndex()
        );
    }


    @Transactional
    public ChapterResponse createChapter(
            Long courseId,
            CreateChapterRequest request,
            CustomUserDetails currentUser
    ) {
        // 1. Kiá»ƒm tra quyá»n quáº£n lÃ½ Course
        courseAccessService.requireManagePermission(
                courseId, currentUser
        );

        // 2. Kiá»ƒm tra trÃ¹ng orderIndex
        if (chapterRepository.existsByCourseIdAndOrderIndex(
                courseId, request.orderIndex())) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Chapter order already exists"
            );
        }

        // 3. Táº¡o Chapter
        Chapter chapter = new Chapter(
                courseId,
                request.title().trim(),
                request.orderIndex()
        );

        // 4. LÆ°u database
        Chapter saved = chapterRepository.save(chapter);

        return toResponse(saved);
    }

    @Transactional
    public ChapterResponse updateChapter(
            Long courseId,
            Long chapterId,
            UpdateChapterRequest request,
            CustomUserDetails currentUser
    ) {
        courseAccessService.requireManagePermission(courseId, currentUser);
        Chapter chapter = chapterRepository.findById(chapterId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                        "Chapter not found"
                ));
        if (!chapter.getCourseId().equals(courseId)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                    "Chapter not found in this course"
            );
        }
        boolean orderExists =
                chapterRepository.existsByCourseIdAndOrderIndexAndIdNot(
                        courseId,
                        request.orderIndex(),
                        chapterId
                );

        if (orderExists) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Chapter order already exists"
            );
        }
        chapter.update(
                request.title().trim(),
                request.orderIndex()
        );
        return toResponse(chapter);
    }


    @Transactional
    public void deleteChapter(Long courseId, Long chapterId, CustomUserDetails currentUser)
    {
        courseAccessService.requireManagePermission(courseId, currentUser);
        Chapter chapter = chapterRepository.findById(chapterId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                        "Chapter not found"
                ));

        if (!chapter.getCourseId().equals(courseId)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                    "Chapter not found in this course"
            );
        }

        chapterRepository.delete(chapter);
    }

}

package com.smartcampus.backend.learningcontent.service;

import com.smartcampus.backend.auth.security.CustomUserDetails;
import com.smartcampus.backend.course.entity.Course;
import com.smartcampus.backend.course.entity.PublicationState;
import com.smartcampus.backend.course.repository.CourseRepository;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

/**
 * Authorization for Learning Content (BR-CONTENT-002, BR-CONTENT-005, BR-ENROLL-003).
 *
 *  manage (create/update/delete): admin, the course creator, or a lecturer assigned in course_lecturers
 *  view   (read chapters/lessons/materials): everyone who can manage, plus a student with an
 *          ACTIVE enrollment in a PUBLISHED course
 */
@Service
public class CourseAccessService {

    private final CourseRepository courseRepository;
    private final JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;

    public CourseAccessService(CourseRepository courseRepository, JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate) {
        this.courseRepository = courseRepository;
        this.jdbcTemplate = jdbcTemplate;
    }

    /** 404 if the course does not exist, 403 if the user may not manage its content. */
    public void requireManagePermission(Long courseId, CustomUserDetails currentUser) {
        Course course = requireCourse(courseId);
        if (!canManage(course, courseId, currentUser)) {
            throw forbidden("You cannot manage this course");
        }
    }

    /** 404 if the course does not exist, 403 if the user may not read its content. */
    public void requireViewPermission(Long courseId, CustomUserDetails currentUser) {
        Course course = requireCourse(courseId);
        if (canManage(course, courseId, currentUser)) {
            return;
        }
        if (hasRole(currentUser, "STUDENT")
                && course.getPublicationState() == PublicationState.PUBLISHED
                && hasActiveEnrollment(courseId, currentUser.getId())) {
            return;
        }
        throw forbidden("You cannot view the content of this course");
    }

    private boolean canManage(Course course, Long courseId, CustomUserDetails user) {
        if (hasRole(user, "ADMIN")) {
            return true;
        }
        if (!hasRole(user, "LECTURER")) {
            return false;
        }
        return course.getCreatedBy().equals(user.getId())
                || isAssignedLecturer(courseId, user.getId());
    }

    private boolean isAssignedLecturer(Long courseId, Long lecturerId) {
        Integer count = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_lecturers WHERE course_id = ? AND lecturer_id = ?",
                Integer.class, courseId, lecturerId);
        return count != null && count > 0;
    }

    private boolean hasActiveEnrollment(Long courseId, Long studentId) {
        Integer count = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollments WHERE course_id = ? AND student_id = ? AND status = 'ACTIVE'",
                Integer.class, courseId, studentId);
        return count != null && count > 0;
    }

    private Course requireCourse(Long courseId) {
        return courseRepository.findById(courseId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Course not found"));
    }

    private static boolean hasRole(CustomUserDetails user, String role) {
        return user.getAuthorities().stream()
                .anyMatch(authority -> authority.getAuthority().equals("ROLE_" + role));
    }

    private static ResponseStatusException forbidden(String message) {
        return new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN, message);
    }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.learningcontent.service;

import com.smartcampus.backend.auth.security.CustomUserDetails;
import com.smartcampus.backend.learningcontent.dto.*;
import com.smartcampus.backend.learningcontent.entity.*;
import com.smartcampus.backend.learningcontent.repository.*;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.List;

@Service
public class LearningMaterialService {

    private final LearningMaterialRepository materialRepository;
    private final LessonRepository lessonRepository;
    private final ChapterRepository chapterRepository;
    private final CourseAccessService courseAccessService;

    public LearningMaterialService(
            LearningMaterialRepository materialRepository,
            LessonRepository lessonRepository,
            ChapterRepository chapterRepository,
            CourseAccessService courseAccessService
    ) {
        this.materialRepository = materialRepository;
        this.lessonRepository = lessonRepository;
        this.chapterRepository = chapterRepository;
        this.courseAccessService = courseAccessService;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<LearningMaterialResponse> getMaterials(
            Long courseId,
            Long chapterId,
            Long lessonId,
            CustomUserDetails currentUser
    ) {
        courseAccessService.requireViewPermission(courseId, currentUser);
        requireLesson(courseId, chapterId, lessonId);

        return materialRepository
                .findByLessonIdOrderByIdAsc(lessonId)
                .stream()
                .map(this::toResponse)
                .toList();
    }

    @Transactional
    public LearningMaterialResponse createMaterial(
            Long courseId,
            Long chapterId,
            Long lessonId,
            CreateLearningMaterialRequest request,
            CustomUserDetails currentUser
    ) {
        courseAccessService.requireManagePermission(
                courseId, currentUser
        );

        requireLesson(courseId, chapterId, lessonId);

        LearningMaterial material = new LearningMaterial(
                lessonId,
                request.title().trim(),
                request.fileUrl().trim(),
                request.fileType().trim()
        );

        return toResponse(materialRepository.save(material));
    }

    @Transactional
    public LearningMaterialResponse updateMaterial(
            Long courseId,
            Long chapterId,
            Long lessonId,
            Long materialId,
            UpdateLearningMaterialRequest request,
            CustomUserDetails currentUser
    ) {
        courseAccessService.requireManagePermission(
                courseId, currentUser
        );

        requireLesson(courseId, chapterId, lessonId);

        LearningMaterial material =
                requireMaterial(lessonId, materialId);

        material.update(
                request.title().trim(),
                request.fileUrl().trim(),
                request.fileType().trim()
        );

        return toResponse(material);
    }

    @Transactional
    public void deleteMaterial(
            Long courseId,
            Long chapterId,
            Long lessonId,
            Long materialId,
            CustomUserDetails currentUser
    ) {
        courseAccessService.requireManagePermission(
                courseId, currentUser
        );

        requireLesson(courseId, chapterId, lessonId);

        LearningMaterial material =
                requireMaterial(lessonId, materialId);

        materialRepository.delete(material);
    }

    private Lesson requireLesson(
            Long courseId,
            Long chapterId,
            Long lessonId
    ) {
        Chapter chapter = chapterRepository.findById(chapterId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                        "Chapter not found"
                ));

        if (!chapter.getCourseId().equals(courseId)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                    "Chapter not found in this course"
            );
        }

        Lesson lesson = lessonRepository.findById(lessonId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                        "Lesson not found"
                ));

        if (!lesson.getChapterId().equals(chapterId)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                    "Lesson not found in this chapter"
            );
        }

        return lesson;
    }

    private LearningMaterial requireMaterial(
            Long lessonId,
            Long materialId
    ) {
        LearningMaterial material =
                materialRepository.findById(materialId)
                        .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(
                                HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                                "Learning material not found"
                        ));

        if (!material.getLessonId().equals(lessonId)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                    "Material not found in this lesson"
            );
        }

        return material;
    }

    private LearningMaterialResponse toResponse(
            LearningMaterial material
    ) {
        return new LearningMaterialResponse(
                material.getId(),
                material.getLessonId(),
                material.getTitle(),
                material.getFileUrl(),
                material.getFileType()
        );
    }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.learningcontent.service;

import com.smartcampus.backend.auth.security.CustomUserDetails;
import com.smartcampus.backend.learningcontent.dto.*;
import com.smartcampus.backend.learningcontent.entity.Chapter;
import com.smartcampus.backend.learningcontent.entity.Lesson;
import com.smartcampus.backend.learningcontent.repository.ChapterRepository;
import com.smartcampus.backend.learningcontent.repository.LessonRepository;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Set;

@Service
public class LessonService {

    /** Loáº¡i bÃ i cÃ³ Ä‘á»™ dÃ i Ä‘o Ä‘Æ°á»£c: VIDEO (giÃ¢y), PDF (trang). TEXT khÃ´ng cÃ³ totalLength. */
    static final Set<String> MEASURABLE_TYPES = Set.of("VIDEO", "PDF");

    private final LessonRepository lessonRepository;
    private final ChapterRepository chapterRepository;
    private final CourseAccessService courseAccessService;

    public LessonService(
            LessonRepository lessonRepository,
            ChapterRepository chapterRepository,
            CourseAccessService courseAccessService
    ) {
        this.lessonRepository = lessonRepository;
        this.chapterRepository = chapterRepository;
        this.courseAccessService = courseAccessService;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<LessonResponse> getLessons(
            Long courseId, Long chapterId, CustomUserDetails currentUser
    ) {
        courseAccessService.requireViewPermission(courseId, currentUser);
        requireChapter(courseId, chapterId);

        return lessonRepository
                .findByChapterIdOrderByOrderIndexAsc(chapterId)
                .stream()
                .map(this::toResponse)
                .toList();
    }

    @Transactional
    public LessonResponse createLesson(
            Long courseId,
            Long chapterId,
            CreateLessonRequest request,
            CustomUserDetails currentUser
    ) {
        courseAccessService.requireManagePermission(
                courseId, currentUser
        );

        requireChapter(courseId, chapterId);

        if (lessonRepository.existsByChapterIdAndOrderIndex(
                chapterId, request.orderIndex())) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Lesson order already exists"
            );
        }

        Lesson lesson = new Lesson(
                chapterId,
                request.title().trim(),
                request.orderIndex(),
                validTotalLength(request.contentType(), request.totalLength())
        );

        return toResponse(lessonRepository.save(lesson));
    }

    @Transactional
    public LessonResponse updateLesson(
            Long courseId,
            Long chapterId,
            Long lessonId,
            UpdateLessonRequest request,
            CustomUserDetails currentUser
    ) {
        courseAccessService.requireManagePermission(
                courseId, currentUser
        );

        requireChapter(courseId, chapterId);
        Lesson lesson = requireLesson(chapterId, lessonId);

        if (lessonRepository
                .existsByChapterIdAndOrderIndexAndIdNot(
                        chapterId,
                        request.orderIndex(),
                        lessonId
                )) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Lesson order already exists"
            );
        }

        lesson.update(
                request.title().trim(),
                request.orderIndex(),
                validTotalLength(request.contentType(), request.totalLength())
        );

        return toResponse(lesson);
    }

    @Transactional
    public void deleteLesson(
            Long courseId,
            Long chapterId,
            Long lessonId,
            CustomUserDetails currentUser
    ) {
        courseAccessService.requireManagePermission(
                courseId, currentUser
        );

        requireChapter(courseId, chapterId);
        Lesson lesson = requireLesson(chapterId, lessonId);

        lessonRepository.delete(lesson);
    }

    private Chapter requireChapter(
            Long courseId, Long chapterId
    ) {
        Chapter chapter = chapterRepository.findById(chapterId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                        "Chapter not found"
                ));

        if (!chapter.getCourseId().equals(courseId)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                    "Chapter not found in this course"
            );
        }

        return chapter;
    }

    private Lesson requireLesson(
            Long chapterId, Long lessonId
    ) {
        Lesson lesson = lessonRepository.findById(lessonId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                        "Lesson not found"
                ));

        if (!lesson.getChapterId().equals(chapterId)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                    "Lesson not found in this chapter"
            );
        }

        return lesson;
    }

    /** totalLength chá»‰ cÃ³ nghÄ©a vá»›i VIDEO/PDF; gá»­i kÃ¨m bÃ i TEXT lÃ  sai dá»¯ liá»‡u (400). */
    static Integer validTotalLength(String contentType, Integer totalLength) {
        if (totalLength == null) {
            return null;
        }
        String type = contentType.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if (!MEASURABLE_TYPES.contains(type)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "totalLength chá»‰ dÃ¹ng cho bÃ i VIDEO (sá»‘ giÃ¢y) hoáº·c PDF (sá»‘ trang)"
            );
        }
        return totalLength;
    }

    private LessonResponse toResponse(Lesson lesson) {
        return new LessonResponse(
                lesson.getId(),
                lesson.getChapterId(),
                lesson.getTitle(),
                lesson.getOrderIndex(),
                lesson.getTotalLength()
        );
    }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.notification.controller;

import com.smartcampus.backend.common.config.OpenApiConfig;
import com.smartcampus.backend.common.response.ApiResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.security.CurrentUserResolver;
import com.smartcampus.backend.notification.dto.MarkAllReadResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.notification.dto.NotificationResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.notification.dto.UnreadCountResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.notification.service.NotificationService;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Parameter;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.security.SecurityRequirement;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PatchMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

import java.util.List;

@Tag(name = "Notification", description = "In-app notifications of the logged-in user")
@SecurityRequirement(name = OpenApiConfig.BEARER_AUTH)
@RestController
public class NotificationController {

    private final NotificationService notificationService;
    private final CurrentUserResolver currentUserResolver;

    public NotificationController(NotificationService notificationService, CurrentUserResolver currentUserResolver) {
        this.notificationService = notificationService;
        this.currentUserResolver = currentUserResolver;
    }

    @Operation(summary = "List my notifications, newest first",
            description = "Any logged-in user. `unreadOnly=true` returns only unread ones. `limit` defaults to 20, max 100.")
    @GetMapping("/api/notifications/me")
    public ApiResponse<List<NotificationResponse>> getMyNotifications(
            @Parameter(example = "false") @RequestParam(name = "unreadOnly", defaultValue = "false") boolean unreadOnly,
            @Parameter(example = "20") @RequestParam(name = "limit", required = false) Integer limit) {
        Long userId = currentUserResolver.getCurrentUserId();
        return ApiResponse.ok(notificationService.getMyNotifications(userId, unreadOnly, limit));
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Number of unread notifications (for the bell badge)")
    @GetMapping("/api/notifications/me/unread-count")
    public ApiResponse<UnreadCountResponse> countUnread() {
        return ApiResponse.ok(notificationService.countUnread(currentUserResolver.getCurrentUserId()));
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Mark one of my notifications as read",
            description = "404 NOTIFICATION_NOT_FOUND if it does not exist or belongs to another user.")
    @PatchMapping("/api/notifications/{notificationId}/read")
    public ApiResponse<NotificationResponse> markRead(
            @Parameter(example = "12") @PathVariable("notificationId") Long notificationId) {

package com.smartcampus.backend.notification.entity;

import jakarta.persistence.Column;
import jakarta.persistence.Entity;
import jakarta.persistence.EnumType;
import jakarta.persistence.Enumerated;
import jakarta.persistence.GeneratedValue;
import jakarta.persistence.GenerationType;
import jakarta.persistence.Id;
import jakarta.persistence.Table;
import org.hibernate.annotations.Generated;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;

/** Maps table notifications (V3__create_notifications.sql). */
@Entity
@Table(name = "notifications")
public class Notification {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long id;

    @Column(name = "recipient_id", nullable = false, updatable = false)
    private Long recipientId;

    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(name = "type", nullable = false, length = 50, columnDefinition = "VARCHAR(50)", updatable = false)
    private NotificationType type;

    @Column(name = "title", nullable = false, length = 255, updatable = false)
    private String title;

    @Column(name = "message", nullable = false, columnDefinition = "TEXT", updatable = false)
    private String message;

    @Column(name = "link", length = 500, updatable = false)
    private String link;

    // read state is changed only through NotificationRepository.markRead/markAllRead
    @Column(name = "is_read", nullable = false, insertable = false, updatable = false)
    private boolean read;

    @Generated
    @Column(name = "created_at", insertable = false, updatable = false)
    private LocalDateTime createdAt;

    @Column(name = "read_at", insertable = false, updatable = false)
    private LocalDateTime readAt;

    protected Notification() {
        // for JPA
    }

    public Notification(Long recipientId, NotificationType type, String title, String message, String link) {
        this.recipientId = recipientId;
        this.type = type;
        this.title = title;
        this.message = message;
        this.link = link;
    }

    public Long getId() { return id; }
    public Long getRecipientId() { return recipientId; }
    public NotificationType getType() { return type; }
    public String getTitle() { return title; }
    public String getMessage() { return message; }
    public String getLink() { return link; }
    public boolean isRead() { return read; }
    public LocalDateTime getCreatedAt() { return createdAt; }
    public LocalDateTime getReadAt() { return readAt; }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.notification.entity;

/**
 * Notification vocabulary (BR-INT-001). Stored as VARCHAR(50) in notifications.type,
 * so a module can add a value here without a migration.
 */
public enum NotificationType {
    /** Enrollment: a lecturer/admin enrolled or reinstated the student. */
    ENROLLED_BY_STAFF,
    /** Enrollment: a lecturer/admin removed the student from a course. */
    REMOVED_FROM_COURSE,
    /** Learning Progress: the student completed every lesson of a course. */
    COURSE_COMPLETED,
    /** Learning Content: new lesson/material published. */
    NEW_CONTENT,
    /** Assessment: a deadline is approaching. */
    DEADLINE_REMINDER,
    /** Assessment: a submission has been graded. */
    GRADED,
    /** Discussion: someone replied in a thread the user follows. */
    FORUM_REPLY,
    /** Moderation action on the user's content. */
    MODERATION,
    /** Learning Analytics: lecturer intervention message. */
    INTERVENTION,
    /** Anything else. */
    SYSTEM
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.notification.repository;

import com.smartcampus.backend.notification.entity.Notification;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Modifying;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query;
import org.springframework.data.repository.query.Param;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

public interface NotificationRepository extends JpaRepository<Notification, Long> {

    List<Notification> findByRecipientIdOrderByCreatedAtDescIdDesc(Long recipientId, Pageable pageable);

    List<Notification> findByRecipientIdAndReadFalseOrderByCreatedAtDescIdDesc(Long recipientId, Pageable pageable);

    long countByRecipientIdAndReadFalse(Long recipientId);

    Optional<Notification> findByIdAndRecipientId(Long id, Long recipientId);

    /** Marks one notification of this recipient as read; read_at is set by the database. */
    @Modifying(clearAutomatically = true, flushAutomatically = true)
    @Query(value = """
            UPDATE notifications
            SET is_read = TRUE, read_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            WHERE id = :id AND recipient_id = :recipientId AND is_read = FALSE
            """, nativeQuery = true)
    int markRead(@Param("id") Long id, @Param("recipientId") Long recipientId);

    @Modifying(clearAutomatically = true, flushAutomatically = true)
    @Query(value = """
            UPDATE notifications
            SET is_read = TRUE, read_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            WHERE recipient_id = :recipientId AND is_read = FALSE
            """, nativeQuery = true)
    int markAllRead(@Param("recipientId") Long recipientId);
}
