package com.smartcampus.backend.notification.service;

import com.smartcampus.backend.common.exception.ApiException;
import com.smartcampus.backend.notification.dto.MarkAllReadResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.notification.dto.NotificationResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.notification.dto.UnreadCountResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.notification.entity.Notification;
import com.smartcampus.backend.notification.entity.NotificationType;
import com.smartcampus.backend.notification.repository.NotificationRepository;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.util.List;

/**
 * In-app notifications (FR-INT-005/006/008).
 *
 * Other modules send a notification with:
 * <pre>
 *   notificationService.notify(userId, NotificationType.NEW_CONTENT,
 *           "New lesson", "Lesson 3 was published", "/courses/9101/lessons/3");
 * </pre>
 * The notification is saved in the caller's transaction, so it disappears if that transaction rolls back.
 */
@Service
public class NotificationService {

    static final int DEFAULT_LIMIT = 20;
    static final int MAX_LIMIT = 100;

    private final NotificationRepository notificationRepository;

    public NotificationService(NotificationRepository notificationRepository) {
        this.notificationRepository = notificationRepository;
    }

    @Transactional
    public Notification notify(Long recipientId, NotificationType type, String title, String message, String link) {
        return notificationRepository.save(new Notification(recipientId, type, title, message, link));
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<NotificationResponse> getMyNotifications(Long userId, boolean unreadOnly, Integer limit) {
        PageRequest page = PageRequest.of(0, normalizeLimit(limit));
        List<Notification> rows = unreadOnly
                ? notificationRepository.findByRecipientIdAndReadFalseOrderByCreatedAtDescIdDesc(userId, page)
                : notificationRepository.findByRecipientIdOrderByCreatedAtDescIdDesc(userId, page);
        return rows.stream().map(NotificationResponse::of).toList();
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public UnreadCountResponse countUnread(Long userId) {
        return new UnreadCountResponse(notificationRepository.countByRecipientIdAndReadFalse(userId));
    }

    /** Idempotent: marking an already-read notification returns it unchanged. */
    @Transactional
    public NotificationResponse markRead(Long userId, Long notificationId) {
        notificationRepository.findByIdAndRecipientId(notificationId, userId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> ApiException.notFound("NOTIFICATION_NOT_FOUND",
                        "Notification " + notificationId + " does not exist"));
        notificationRepository.markRead(notificationId, userId);
        return notificationRepository.findByIdAndRecipientId(notificationId, userId)
                .map(NotificationResponse::of)
                .orElseThrow();
    }

    @Transactional
    public MarkAllReadResponse markAllRead(Long userId) {
        return new MarkAllReadResponse(notificationRepository.markAllRead(userId));
    }

    static int normalizeLimit(Integer limit) {
        if (limit == null || limit <= 0) {
            return DEFAULT_LIMIT;
        }
        return Math.min(limit, MAX_LIMIT);
    }
}

                    """)

                    A lesson without total_length only saves the position and is never auto-completed.

package com.smartcampus.backend.progress.dto;

/** Grouping for "My Courses" (FR-PROG-004). */
public enum ProgressStatus {
    NOT_STARTED,
    IN_PROGRESS,
    COMPLETED;

    public static ProgressStatus of(long completedLessons, long totalLessons, boolean everAccessed) {
        if (totalLessons > 0 && completedLessons >= totalLessons) {
            return COMPLETED;
        }
        if (completedLessons == 0 && !everAccessed) {
            return NOT_STARTED;
        }
        return IN_PROGRESS;
    }

    /** BR-PROG-002: completed / total x 100, one decimal; 0 when the course has no lesson. */
    public static double percent(long completedLessons, long totalLessons) {
        if (totalLessons <= 0) {
            return 0.0;
        }
        return Math.round(completedLessons * 1000.0 / totalLessons) / 10.0;
    }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.progress.entity;

import jakarta.persistence.Column;
import jakarta.persistence.Entity;
import jakarta.persistence.EnumType;
import jakarta.persistence.Enumerated;
import jakarta.persistence.GeneratedValue;
import jakarta.persistence.GenerationType;
import jakarta.persistence.Id;
import jakarta.persistence.Table;
import org.hibernate.annotations.Generated;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;

/** Maps table learning_activities (V1): append-only event log for Learning Analytics (FR-PROG-005). */
@Entity
@Table(name = "learning_activities")
public class LearningActivity {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long id;

    @Column(name = "student_id", nullable = false, updatable = false)
    private Long studentId;

    @Column(name = "lesson_id", updatable = false)
    private Long lessonId;

    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(name = "event_type", nullable = false, length = 50, columnDefinition = "VARCHAR(50)", updatable = false)
    private LearningEventType eventType;

    /** Furthest position reached (seconds or pages), not the current playhead. */
    @Column(name = "current_position", updatable = false)
    private Integer currentPosition;

    @Column(name = "total_length", updatable = false)
    private Integer totalLength;

    @Generated
    @Column(name = "created_at", insertable = false, updatable = false)
    private LocalDateTime createdAt;

    protected LearningActivity() {
        // for JPA
    }

    public LearningActivity(Long studentId, Long lessonId, LearningEventType eventType,
                            Integer currentPosition, Integer totalLength) {
        this.studentId = studentId;
        this.lessonId = lessonId;
        this.eventType = eventType;
        this.currentPosition = currentPosition;
        this.totalLength = totalLength;
    }

    public Long getId() { return id; }
    public Long getStudentId() { return studentId; }
    public Long getLessonId() { return lessonId; }
    public LearningEventType getEventType() { return eventType; }
    public Integer getCurrentPosition() { return currentPosition; }
    public Integer getTotalLength() { return totalLength; }
    public LocalDateTime getCreatedAt() { return createdAt; }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.progress.entity;

import jakarta.persistence.Column;
import jakarta.persistence.Entity;
import jakarta.persistence.GeneratedValue;
import jakarta.persistence.GenerationType;
import jakarta.persistence.Id;
import jakarta.persistence.Table;
import org.hibernate.annotations.Generated;
import org.hibernate.generator.EventType;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;

/**
 * Maps table learning_progress (V1): one row per (student, lesson).
 * Rows are written only by the upsert queries in LearningProgressRepository,
 * which keep the unique key uk_learning_progress_student_lesson safe under concurrency.
 *
 * last_position unit: seconds for video, pages for PDF/slides, 0 for plain text (BR-PROG-003).
 */
@Entity
@Table(name = "learning_progress")
public class LearningProgress {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long id;

    @Column(name = "student_id", nullable = false, updatable = false)
    private Long studentId;

    @Column(name = "lesson_id", nullable = false, updatable = false)
    private Long lessonId;

    @Column(name = "is_completed", nullable = false)
    private boolean completed;

    @Column(name = "last_position", nullable = false)
    private int lastPosition;

    @Generated(event = {EventType.INSERT, EventType.UPDATE})
    @Column(name = "updated_at", insertable = false, updatable = false)
    private LocalDateTime updatedAt;

    protected LearningProgress() {
        // for JPA
    }

    public Long getId() { return id; }
    public Long getStudentId() { return studentId; }
    public Long getLessonId() { return lessonId; }
    public boolean isCompleted() { return completed; }
    public int getLastPosition() { return lastPosition; }
    public LocalDateTime getUpdatedAt() { return updatedAt; }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.progress.repository;

import com.smartcampus.backend.progress.entity.LearningActivity;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query;
import org.springframework.data.repository.query.Param;

public interface LearningActivityRepository extends JpaRepository<LearningActivity, Long> {

    /** BR-PROG-004 throttling: events of this type for this lesson in the last 15 seconds. */
    @Query(value = """
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM learning_activities
            WHERE student_id = :studentId
              AND lesson_id  = :lessonId
              AND event_type = :eventType
              AND created_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 15 SECOND
            """, nativeQuery = true)
    long countRecentEvents(@Param("studentId") Long studentId,
                           @Param("lessonId") Long lessonId,
                           @Param("eventType") String eventType);
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.progress.repository;

import com.smartcampus.backend.progress.entity.LearningProgress;
import com.smartcampus.backend.progress.repository.projection.LessonContextView;
import com.smartcampus.backend.progress.repository.projection.LessonProgressView;
import com.smartcampus.backend.progress.repository.projection.MyCourseProgressView;
import com.smartcampus.backend.progress.repository.projection.StudentProgressView;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Modifying;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query;
import org.springframework.data.repository.query.Param;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

/**
 * Reads lessons/chapters/courses/enrollments with native queries on the V1 schema, so this module
 * does not depend on the Learning Content entities (Chapter/Lesson) that are developed in parallel.
 * Every lesson counts as required (V1 has no "optional lesson" column yet, BR-PROG-002).
 */
public interface LearningProgressRepository extends JpaRepository<LearningProgress, Long> {

    Optional<LearningProgress> findByStudentIdAndLessonId(Long studentId, Long lessonId);

    /** Manual "Mark as done": insert or set is_completed, keep last_position. */
    @Modifying(clearAutomatically = true, flushAutomatically = true)
    @Query(value = """
            INSERT INTO learning_progress (student_id, lesson_id, is_completed, last_position)
            VALUES (:studentId, :lessonId, TRUE, 0)
            ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
                is_completed = TRUE,
                updated_at   = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            """, nativeQuery = true)
    int upsertCompleted(@Param("studentId") Long studentId, @Param("lessonId") Long lessonId);

    /** Save the resume position; completion is sticky (never goes back to false). */
    @Modifying(clearAutomatically = true, flushAutomatically = true)
    @Query(value = """
            INSERT INTO learning_progress (student_id, lesson_id, is_completed, last_position)
            VALUES (:studentId, :lessonId, :completed, :position) AS incoming
            ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
                is_completed  = (learning_progress.is_completed OR incoming.is_completed),
                last_position = incoming.last_position,
                updated_at    = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            """, nativeQuery = true)
    int upsertPosition(@Param("studentId") Long studentId,
                       @Param("lessonId") Long lessonId,
                       @Param("position") int position,
                       @Param("completed") boolean completed);

    @Query(value = """
            SELECT l.id                AS lessonId,
                   l.title             AS lessonTitle,
                   l.content_type      AS contentType,
                   c.id                AS courseId,
                   c.title             AS courseTitle,
                   c.publication_state AS publicationState,
                   l.total_length      AS totalLength
            FROM lessons l
            JOIN chapters ch ON ch.id = l.chapter_id
            JOIN courses c   ON c.id = ch.course_id
            WHERE l.id = :lessonId
            """, nativeQuery = true)
    Optional<LessonContextView> findLessonContext(@Param("lessonId") Long lessonId);

    @Query(value = """
            SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollments
            WHERE student_id = :studentId AND course_id = :courseId AND status = 'ACTIVE'
            """, nativeQuery = true)
    long countActiveEnrollment(@Param("studentId") Long studentId, @Param("courseId") Long courseId);

    @Query(value = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM courses WHERE id = :courseId", nativeQuery = true)
    long countCourse(@Param("courseId") Long courseId);

    @Query(value = "SELECT title FROM courses WHERE id = :courseId", nativeQuery = true)
    Optional<String> findCourseTitle(@Param("courseId") Long courseId);

    @Query(value = """
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM lessons l
            JOIN chapters ch ON ch.id = l.chapter_id
            WHERE ch.course_id = :courseId
            """, nativeQuery = true)
    long countLessonsOfCourse(@Param("courseId") Long courseId);

    @Query(value = """
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM learning_progress lp
            JOIN lessons l   ON l.id = lp.lesson_id
            JOIN chapters ch ON ch.id = l.chapter_id
            WHERE ch.course_id = :courseId
              AND lp.student_id = :studentId
              AND lp.is_completed = TRUE
            """, nativeQuery = true)
    long countCompletedLessons(@Param("studentId") Long studentId, @Param("courseId") Long courseId);

    /** All lessons of a course in display order, with this student's progress. */
    @Query(value = """
            SELECT l.id              AS lessonId,
                   l.title           AS lessonTitle,
                   l.content_type    AS contentType,
                   ch.id             AS chapterId,
                   ch.title          AS chapterTitle,
                   CAST(COALESCE(lp.is_completed, 0) AS SIGNED) AS completed,
                   lp.last_position  AS lastPosition,
                   lp.updated_at     AS lastAccessedAt
            FROM chapters ch
            JOIN lessons l ON l.chapter_id = ch.id
            LEFT JOIN learning_progress lp ON lp.lesson_id = l.id AND lp.student_id = :studentId
            WHERE ch.course_id = :courseId
            ORDER BY ch.order_index, l.order_index, l.id
            """, nativeQuery = true)
    List<LessonProgressView> findLessonsWithProgress(@Param("studentId") Long studentId,
                                                     @Param("courseId") Long courseId);

    /** FR-PROG-003/004: every ACTIVE course of the student, most recently accessed first. */
    @Query(value = """
            SELECT c.id          AS courseId,
                   c.title       AS courseTitle,
                   u.full_name   AS instructorName,
                   e.enrolled_at AS enrolledAt,
                   (SELECT COUNT(*)
                      FROM lessons l JOIN chapters ch ON ch.id = l.chapter_id
                     WHERE ch.course_id = c.id) AS totalLessons,
                   (SELECT COUNT(*)
                      FROM learning_progress lp
                      JOIN lessons l   ON l.id = lp.lesson_id
                      JOIN chapters ch ON ch.id = l.chapter_id
                     WHERE ch.course_id = c.id AND lp.student_id = e.student_id
                       AND lp.is_completed = TRUE) AS completedLessons,
                   (SELECT MAX(lp.updated_at)
                      FROM learning_progress lp
                      JOIN lessons l   ON l.id = lp.lesson_id
                      JOIN chapters ch ON ch.id = l.chapter_id
                     WHERE ch.course_id = c.id AND lp.student_id = e.student_id) AS lastAccessedAt,
                   (SELECT lp.lesson_id
                      FROM learning_progress lp
                      JOIN lessons l   ON l.id = lp.lesson_id
                      JOIN chapters ch ON ch.id = l.chapter_id
                     WHERE ch.course_id = c.id AND lp.student_id = e.student_id
                     ORDER BY lp.updated_at DESC, lp.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastLessonId,
                   (SELECT l.title
                      FROM learning_progress lp
                      JOIN lessons l   ON l.id = lp.lesson_id
                      JOIN chapters ch ON ch.id = l.chapter_id
                     WHERE ch.course_id = c.id AND lp.student_id = e.student_id
                     ORDER BY lp.updated_at DESC, lp.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastLessonTitle
            FROM enrollments e
            JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id
            JOIN users u   ON u.id = c.created_by
            WHERE e.student_id = :studentId
              AND e.status = 'ACTIVE'
            ORDER BY COALESCE(lastAccessedAt, e.enrolled_at) DESC, c.id
            """, nativeQuery = true)
    List<MyCourseProgressView> findMyCourseProgress(@Param("studentId") Long studentId);

    /** FR-PROG-006: every ACTIVE student of a course with completed-lesson counts. */
    @Query(value = """
            SELECT u.id        AS studentId,
                   u.username  AS username,
                   u.full_name AS fullName,
                   (SELECT COUNT(*)
                      FROM learning_progress lp
                      JOIN lessons l   ON l.id = lp.lesson_id
                      JOIN chapters ch ON ch.id = l.chapter_id
                     WHERE ch.course_id = e.course_id AND lp.student_id = e.student_id
                       AND lp.is_completed = TRUE) AS completedLessons,
                   (SELECT MAX(lp.updated_at)
                      FROM learning_progress lp
                      JOIN lessons l   ON l.id = lp.lesson_id
                      JOIN chapters ch ON ch.id = l.chapter_id
                     WHERE ch.course_id = e.course_id AND lp.student_id = e.student_id) AS lastAccessedAt
            FROM enrollments e
            JOIN users u ON u.id = e.student_id
            WHERE e.course_id = :courseId
              AND e.status = 'ACTIVE'
            ORDER BY u.full_name, u.id
            """, nativeQuery = true)
    List<StudentProgressView> findClassProgress(@Param("courseId") Long courseId);
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.progress.service;

import com.smartcampus.backend.common.exception.ApiException;
import com.smartcampus.backend.common.security.CourseAccessGuard;
import com.smartcampus.backend.common.security.UserAccount;
import com.smartcampus.backend.notification.entity.NotificationType;
import com.smartcampus.backend.notification.service.NotificationService;
import com.smartcampus.backend.progress.dto.CourseProgressResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.progress.dto.LessonProgressItem;
import com.smartcampus.backend.progress.dto.LessonProgressResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.progress.dto.MyCourseProgressResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.progress.dto.ProgressStatus;
import com.smartcampus.backend.progress.dto.StudentProgressResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.progress.dto.UpdatePositionRequest;
import com.smartcampus.backend.progress.entity.LearningActivity;
import com.smartcampus.backend.progress.entity.LearningEventType;
import com.smartcampus.backend.progress.entity.LearningProgress;
import com.smartcampus.backend.progress.repository.LearningActivityRepository;
import com.smartcampus.backend.progress.repository.LearningProgressRepository;
import com.smartcampus.backend.progress.repository.projection.LessonContextView;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * Learning Progress (docs/01-requirements/04-learning-progress.md):
 * mark a lesson complete, save the resume position, course progress, "My Courses",
 * lecturer class view, and LearningActivity events for Learning Analytics.
 */
@Service
public class LearningProgressService {

    /** BR-PROG-001: a lesson is complete at 90% of its length. */
    static final int COMPLETION_THRESHOLD_PERCENT = 90;

    /**
     * FR-PROG-001: manual "Mark as done" is only for content without pages/duration.
     * VIDEO and PDF are completed through PUT /api/lessons/{id}/progress (90% threshold).
     * Náº¿u FE chÆ°a lÃ m theo dÃµi sá»‘ trang PDF, cÃ³ thá»ƒ táº¡m thÃªm "PDF" vÃ o Ä‘Ã¢y.
     */
    static final Set<String> MANUAL_COMPLETION_TYPES = Set.of("TEXT");

    private final LearningProgressRepository progressRepository;
    private final LearningActivityRepository activityRepository;
    private final CourseAccessGuard courseAccessGuard;
    private final NotificationService notificationService;

    public LearningProgressService(LearningProgressRepository progressRepository,
                                   LearningActivityRepository activityRepository,
                                   CourseAccessGuard courseAccessGuard,
                                   NotificationService notificationService) {
        this.progressRepository = progressRepository;
        this.activityRepository = activityRepository;
        this.courseAccessGuard = courseAccessGuard;
        this.notificationService = notificationService;
    }

    /** FR-PROG-001: manual "Mark as done" (idempotent), only for TEXT lessons. */
    @Transactional
    public LessonProgressResponse markLessonComplete(Long studentId, Long lessonId) {
        LessonContextView lesson = requireLessonAccess(studentId, lessonId);
        requireManualCompletionAllowed(lesson);
        boolean wasCompleted = isCompleted(studentId, lessonId);

        progressRepository.upsertCompleted(studentId, lessonId);
        if (!wasCompleted) {
            onLessonCompleted(studentId, lesson, null, null);
        }
        return lessonResponse(studentId, lesson);
    }

    /**
     * FR-PROG-002 + BR-PROG-001: save the resume position; the lesson becomes complete
     * automatically once position >= 90% of its total_length.
     * The length comes from the lesson (V5), never from the client: request.totalLength() is ignored,
     * so a client cannot complete a lesson by sending {"position":1,"totalLength":1}.
     * A lesson without total_length only saves the position.
     */
    @Transactional
    public LessonProgressResponse updatePosition(Long studentId, Long lessonId, UpdatePositionRequest request) {
        LessonContextView lesson = requireLessonAccess(studentId, lessonId);
        Integer total = lesson.getTotalLength();
        int position = total == null ? request.position() : Math.min(request.position(), total);
        boolean reachesThreshold = reachesThreshold(position, total);
        boolean wasCompleted = isCompleted(studentId, lessonId);

        progressRepository.upsertPosition(studentId, lessonId, position, reachesThreshold);

        // BR-PROG-004: at most one LESSON_PROGRESS event per lesson every 15 seconds
        if (activityRepository.countRecentEvents(studentId, lessonId, LearningEventType.LESSON_PROGRESS.name()) == 0) {
            activityRepository.save(new LearningActivity(studentId, lessonId,
                    LearningEventType.LESSON_PROGRESS, position, total));
        }
        if (reachesThreshold && !wasCompleted) {
            onLessonCompleted(studentId, lesson, position, total);
        }
        return lessonResponse(studentId, lesson);
    }

    /** FR-PROG-003 + UC-PROG-001: lessons of one course with progress and the resume point. */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public CourseProgressResponse getMyCourseProgress(Long studentId, Long courseId) {
        String courseTitle = progressRepository.findCourseTitle(courseId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> courseNotFound(courseId));
        if (progressRepository.countActiveEnrollment(studentId, courseId) == 0) {
            throw ApiException.forbidden("NOT_ENROLLED", "You have no ACTIVE enrollment in course " + courseId);
        }
        return buildCourseProgress(studentId, courseId, courseTitle);
    }

    /** FR-PROG-006: one student's lesson-by-lesson progress, for the course's lecturer/admin. */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public CourseProgressResponse getStudentCourseProgress(Long actorId, Long courseId, Long studentId) {
        UserAccount actor = courseAccessGuard.requireUser(actorId);
        courseAccessGuard.requireCourseManager(actor, courseId);
        String courseTitle = progressRepository.findCourseTitle(courseId).orElseThrow(() -> courseNotFound(courseId));
        if (progressRepository.countActiveEnrollment(studentId, courseId) == 0) {
            throw ApiException.notFound("NOT_ENROLLED",
                    "Student " + studentId + " has no ACTIVE enrollment in course " + courseId);
        }
        return buildCourseProgress(studentId, courseId, courseTitle);
    }

    /** FR-PROG-004: every ACTIVE course of the student, most recently accessed first. */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<MyCourseProgressResponse> getMyCourses(Long studentId) {
        return progressRepository.findMyCourseProgress(studentId).stream()
                .map(MyCourseProgressResponse::of)
                .toList();
    }

    /** FR-PROG-006: progress of the whole class (assigned lecturer or admin). */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<StudentProgressResponse> getClassProgress(Long actorId, Long courseId) {
        UserAccount actor = courseAccessGuard.requireUser(actorId);
        courseAccessGuard.requireCourseManager(actor, courseId);
        long totalLessons = progressRepository.countLessonsOfCourse(courseId);
        return progressRepository.findClassProgress(courseId).stream()
                .map(v -> StudentProgressResponse.of(v, totalLessons))
                .toList();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers

    /**
     * BR-ENROLL-003: a student works on a lesson only with an ACTIVE enrollment
     * in a PUBLISHED course. Lecturers and admins have read-only access (FR-PROG-006).
     */
    private LessonContextView requireLessonAccess(Long studentId, Long lessonId) {
        UserAccount user = courseAccessGuard.requireUser(studentId);
        if (!user.isStudent()) {
            throw ApiException.forbidden("NOT_A_STUDENT", "Only students record learning progress");
        }
        LessonContextView lesson = progressRepository.findLessonContext(lessonId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> ApiException.notFound("LESSON_NOT_FOUND", "Lesson " + lessonId + " does not exist"));
        if (progressRepository.countActiveEnrollment(studentId, lesson.getCourseId()) == 0) {
            throw ApiException.forbidden("NOT_ENROLLED",
                    "You have no ACTIVE enrollment in course " + lesson.getCourseId());
        }
        if (!"PUBLISHED".equals(lesson.getPublicationState())) {
            throw ApiException.forbidden("COURSE_NOT_PUBLISHED",
                    "Course " + lesson.getCourseId() + " is not published");
        }
        return lesson;
    }

    /** VIDEO/PDF must reach the 90% threshold through PUT /progress instead of a manual click. */
    private static void requireManualCompletionAllowed(LessonContextView lesson) {
        String type = lesson.getContentType() == null ? "" : lesson.getContentType().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if (!MANUAL_COMPLETION_TYPES.contains(type)) {
            throw ApiException.badRequest("MANUAL_COMPLETION_NOT_ALLOWED",
                    "Lesson " + lesson.getLessonId() + " (" + lesson.getContentType()
                            + ") is completed through PUT /api/lessons/" + lesson.getLessonId() + "/progress");
        }
    }

    private boolean isCompleted(Long studentId, Long lessonId) {
        return progressRepository.findByStudentIdAndLessonId(studentId, lessonId)
                .map(LearningProgress::isCompleted)
                .orElse(false);
    }

    static boolean reachesThreshold(int position, Integer totalLength) {
        return totalLength != null && totalLength > 0
                && position * 100L >= (long) totalLength * COMPLETION_THRESHOLD_PERCENT;
    }

    private void onLessonCompleted(Long studentId, LessonContextView lesson, Integer position, Integer total) {
        activityRepository.save(new LearningActivity(studentId, lesson.getLessonId(),
                LearningEventType.LESSON_COMPLETED, position, total));

        long totalLessons = progressRepository.countLessonsOfCourse(lesson.getCourseId());
        long completed = progressRepository.countCompletedLessons(studentId, lesson.getCourseId());
        if (totalLessons > 0 && completed >= totalLessons) {
            notificationService.notify(studentId, NotificationType.COURSE_COMPLETED,
                    "Course completed",
                    "Congratulations! You completed every lesson of \"" + lesson.getCourseTitle() + "\".",
                    "/courses/" + lesson.getCourseId());
        }
    }

    private LessonProgressResponse lessonResponse(Long studentId, LessonContextView lesson) {
        LearningProgress progress = progressRepository.findByStudentIdAndLessonId(studentId, lesson.getLessonId())
                .orElseThrow();
        long total = progressRepository.countLessonsOfCourse(lesson.getCourseId());
        long done = progressRepository.countCompletedLessons(studentId, lesson.getCourseId());
        return new LessonProgressResponse(lesson.getLessonId(), lesson.getCourseId(), progress.isCompleted(),
                progress.getLastPosition(), done, total, ProgressStatus.percent(done, total));
    }

    private CourseProgressResponse buildCourseProgress(Long studentId, Long courseId, String courseTitle) {
        List<LessonProgressItem> lessons = progressRepository.findLessonsWithProgress(studentId, courseId)
                .stream()
                .map(LessonProgressItem::of)
                .toList();
        long total = lessons.size();
        long done = lessons.stream().filter(LessonProgressItem::completed).count();
        boolean everAccessed = lessons.stream().anyMatch(l -> l.lastAccessedAt() != null);

        // resume: the most recently accessed lesson, else the first lesson of the course
        LessonProgressItem resume = lessons.stream()
                .filter(l -> l.lastAccessedAt() != null)
                .max(Comparator.comparing(LessonProgressItem::lastAccessedAt))
                .orElse(lessons.isEmpty() ? null : lessons.getFirst());

        return new CourseProgressResponse(courseId, courseTitle, studentId, total, done,
                ProgressStatus.percent(done, total), ProgressStatus.of(done, total, everAccessed),
                resume == null ? null : resume.lessonId(),
                resume == null ? null : resume.lessonTitle(),
                resume == null ? 0 : resume.lastPosition(),
                lessons);
    }

    private static ApiException courseNotFound(Long courseId) {
        return ApiException.notFound("COURSE_NOT_FOUND", "Course " + courseId + " does not exist");
    }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.user.entity;

import jakarta.persistence.*;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;

@Entity
@Table(name = "users")
public class User {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long id;

    @Column(name = "username", nullable = false, unique = true, length = 100)
    private String username;

    @Column(name = "password_hash", nullable = false, length = 255)
    private String passwordHash;

    @Column(name = "full_name", nullable = false, length = 150)
    private String fullName;

    @Column(name = "email", nullable = false, unique = true, length = 255)
    private String email;

    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(name = "role", nullable = false, length = 30)
    private UserRole role;

    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(name = "status", nullable = false, length = 30)
    private UserStatus status;

    @Column(name = "created_at", nullable = false,
            insertable = false, updatable = false)
    private LocalDateTime createdAt;

    @Column(name = "updated_at", nullable = false,
            insertable = false, updatable = false)
    private LocalDateTime updatedAt;

    protected User() {
    }

    public User(String username, String passwordHash, String fullName,
                String email, UserRole role, UserStatus status) {
        this.username = username;
        this.passwordHash = passwordHash;
        this.fullName = fullName;
        this.email = email;
        this.role = role;
        this.status = status;
    }

    public Long getId() {
        return id;
    }

    public String getUsername() {
        return username;
    }

    public String getPasswordHash() {
        return passwordHash;
    }

    public String getFullName() {
        return fullName;
    }

    public String getEmail() {
        return email;
    }

    public UserRole getRole() {
        return role;
    }

    public void setRole(UserRole role) {
        this.role = role;
    }

    public UserStatus getStatus() {
        return status;
    }

    public LocalDateTime getCreatedAt() {
        return createdAt;
    }

    public LocalDateTime getUpdatedAt() {
        return updatedAt;
    }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.user.service;

import com.smartcampus.backend.user.dto.UserResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.user.dto.UpdateRoleRequest;
import com.smartcampus.backend.user.entity.User;
import com.smartcampus.backend.user.entity.UserRole;
import com.smartcampus.backend.user.repository.UserRepository;

import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.security.access.AccessDeniedException;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

@Service
public class UserService {

    private final UserRepository userRepository;

    public UserService(UserRepository userRepository) {
        this.userRepository = userRepository;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Page<UserResponse> getAllUsers(Pageable pageable) {
        return userRepository.findAll(pageable)
                .map(UserResponse::from);
    }

    @Transactional
    public UserResponse updateRole(
            Long userId,
            UpdateRoleRequest request,
            Long currentAdminId
    ) {
        User user = userRepository.findById(userId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "User not found"
                ));

        // KhÃ´ng cho Admin tá»± sá»­a role cá»§a chÃ­nh mÃ¬nh
        if (user.getId().equals(currentAdminId)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "Cannot change your own role"
            );
        }

        // KhÃ´ng cho sá»­a role cá»§a Admin khÃ¡c
        if (user.getRole() == UserRole.ADMIN) {
            throw new AccessDeniedException(
                    "Cannot change another admin's role"
            );
        }

        user.setRole(request.role());

        return UserResponse.from(user);
    }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.analytics;

import com.smartcampus.backend.analytics.dto.CourseAnalyticsResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.analytics.repository.CourseAnalyticsRepository;
import com.smartcampus.backend.analytics.repository.CourseEnrollmentStats;
import com.smartcampus.backend.analytics.service.CourseAnalyticsService;
import com.smartcampus.backend.common.exception.ApiException;
import com.smartcampus.backend.common.security.CourseAccessGuard;
import com.smartcampus.backend.progress.repository.LearningProgressRepository;
import com.smartcampus.backend.progress.repository.projection.StudentProgressView;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.mockito.InjectMocks;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

import static com.smartcampus.backend.support.TestData.admin;
import static com.smartcampus.backend.support.TestData.lecturer;
import static com.smartcampus.backend.support.TestData.student;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class CourseAnalyticsServiceTest {

    private static final Long COURSE_ID = 10L;

    @Mock private CourseAnalyticsRepository analyticsRepository;
    @Mock private LearningProgressRepository progressRepository;
    @Mock private CourseAccessGuard courseAccessGuard;
    @InjectMocks private CourseAnalyticsService service;

    @Test
    void summary_computesCompletionRateAndAverageProgress() {
        when(courseAccessGuard.requireUser(3L)).thenReturn(lecturer(3L));
        givenStats(COURSE_ID, 4);
        when(progressRepository.countLessonsOfCourse(COURSE_ID)).thenReturn(4L);
        LocalDateTime t = LocalDateTime.of(2026, 10, 18, 8, 0);
        when(progressRepository.findClassProgress(COURSE_ID)).thenReturn(List.of(
                row(4L, t),      // completed (100%)
                row(2L, t),      // in progress (50%)
                row(0L, t),      // opened but nothing completed: in progress (0%)
                row(0L, null))); // not started

        CourseAnalyticsResponse r = service.getCourseSummary(3L, COURSE_ID);

        assertEquals(4, r.activeEnrollments());
        assertEquals(1, r.withdrawnEnrollments());
        assertEquals(4, r.totalLessons());
        assertEquals(1, r.studentsCompleted());
        assertEquals(2, r.studentsInProgress());
        assertEquals(1, r.studentsNotStarted());
        assertEquals(25.0, r.completionRate());
        assertEquals(37.5, r.averageProgressPercent());
    }

    @Test
    void summary_courseWithoutStudents_hasZeroRates() {
        when(courseAccessGuard.requireUser(5L)).thenReturn(admin(5L));
        givenStats(COURSE_ID, 0);
        when(progressRepository.countLessonsOfCourse(COURSE_ID)).thenReturn(0L);
        when(progressRepository.findClassProgress(COURSE_ID)).thenReturn(List.of());

        CourseAnalyticsResponse r = service.getCourseSummary(5L, COURSE_ID);

        assertEquals(0.0, r.completionRate());
        assertEquals(0.0, r.averageProgressPercent());
    }

    @Test
    void myCoursesSummary_student_isRejectedWith403() {
        when(courseAccessGuard.requireUser(1L)).thenReturn(student(1L));

        ApiException ex = assertThrows(ApiException.class, () -> service.getMyCoursesSummary(1L));

        assertEquals("NOT_COURSE_STAFF", ex.getCode());
    }

    @Test
    void myCoursesSummary_lecturer_returnsOneRowPerManagedCourse() {
        when(courseAccessGuard.requireUser(3L)).thenReturn(lecturer(3L));
        when(courseAccessGuard.managedCourseIds(lecturer(3L))).thenReturn(List.of(10L, 11L));
        givenStats(10L, 0);
        givenStats(11L, 0);
        when(progressRepository.countLessonsOfCourse(org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.anyLong())).thenReturn(0L);
        when(progressRepository.findClassProgress(org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.anyLong())).thenReturn(List.of());

        assertEquals(List.of(10L, 11L), service.getMyCoursesSummary(3L).stream().map(CourseAnalyticsResponse::courseId).toList());
    }

    private void givenStats(Long courseId, long active) {
        when(analyticsRepository.findEnrollmentStats(courseId)).thenReturn(Optional.of(
                new CourseEnrollmentStats(courseId, "Course " + courseId, "PUBLISHED", true, active, 1, 0, active + 1, active)));
    }

    private static StudentProgressView row(Long completed, LocalDateTime lastAccessedAt) {
        return new StudentProgressView() {
            @Override public Long getStudentId() { return 1L; }
            @Override public String getUsername() { return "s"; }
            @Override public String getFullName() { return "S"; }
            @Override public Long getCompletedLessons() { return completed; }
            @Override public LocalDateTime getLastAccessedAt() { return lastAccessedAt; }
        };
    }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.assessment;

import com.jayway.jsonpath.JsonPath;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;

import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.*;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result.MockMvcResultMatchers.*;

@SpringBootTest
@ActiveProfiles("test")
@Transactional
@Sql("/sql/assessment-discussion-data.sql")
class AssessmentDiscussionApiTest {
    @Autowired WebApplicationContext context;
    private MockMvc mvc;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() { mvc = MockMvcBuilders.webAppContextSetup(context).apply(springSecurity()).build(); }

    private String token(String username) throws Exception {
        String response = mvc.perform(post("/api/auth/login").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .content("{\"username\":\"" + username + "\",\"password\":\"123456\"}"))
                .andExpect(status().isOk()).andReturn().getResponse().getContentAsString();
        java.util.List<String> tokens = JsonPath.read(response, "$..accessToken");
        return "Bearer " + tokens.getFirst();
    }

    @Test
    void quizLifecycle_hidesAnswerKeyAndBlocksUnenrolledStudent() throws Exception {
        String lecturer = token("assessment_lecturer");
        String student = token("assessment_student");
        String outsider = token("assessment_outsider");
        String question = mvc.perform(post("/api/courses/9911/questions")
                .header("Authorization", lecturer).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .content("""
                        {"content":"2 + 2?","type":"SINGLE_CHOICE","options":[
                          {"content":"4","correct":true},{"content":"5","correct":false}]}
                        """))
                .andExpect(status().isCreated()).andExpect(jsonPath("$.options[0].correct").value(true))
                .andReturn().getResponse().getContentAsString();
        int questionId = JsonPath.read(question, "$.id");

        mvc.perform(post("/api/courses/9911/quizzes").header("Authorization", student)
                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .content("{\"title\":\"Forbidden\",\"maxAttempts\":1,\"questions\":[{\"questionId\":"
                        + questionId + ",\"points\":2}]}"))
                .andExpect(status().isForbidden());

        String quiz = mvc.perform(post("/api/courses/9911/quizzes")
                .header("Authorization", lecturer).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .content("{\"title\":\"Quiz 1\",\"maxAttempts\":1,\"questions\":[{\"questionId\":"
                        + questionId + ",\"points\":2}]}"))
                .andExpect(status().isCreated()).andExpect(jsonPath("$.quiz.status").value("DRAFT"))
                .andReturn().getResponse().getContentAsString();
        int quizId = JsonPath.read(quiz, "$.quiz.id");

        mvc.perform(get("/api/courses/9911/quizzes").header("Authorization", student))
                .andExpect(status().isOk()).andExpect(jsonPath("$.length()").value(0));
        mvc.perform(post("/api/courses/9911/quizzes/{id}/publish", quizId)
                .header("Authorization", lecturer)).andExpect(status().isOk());
        mvc.perform(get("/api/courses/9911/quizzes/{id}", quizId).header("Authorization", student))
                .andExpect(status().isOk()).andExpect(jsonPath("$.questions[0].question.options[0].correct").doesNotExist());
        mvc.perform(get("/api/courses/9911/quizzes/{id}", quizId).header("Authorization", outsider))
                .andExpect(status().isForbidden());
        mvc.perform(put("/api/courses/9911/questions/{id}", questionId).header("Authorization", lecturer)
                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .content("{\"content\":\"Changed\",\"type\":\"SHORT_ANSWER\"}"))
                .andExpect(status().isConflict());
    }

    @Test
    void discussionSupportsRepliesAndPreservesDeletedThread() throws Exception {
        String student = token("assessment_student");
        String lecturer = token("assessment_lecturer");
        String outsider = token("assessment_outsider");
        String root = mvc.perform(post("/api/courses/9911/discussions")
                .header("Authorization", student).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .content("{\"content\":\"Question about lesson\"}"))
                .andExpect(status().isCreated()).andReturn().getResponse().getContentAsString();
        int rootId = JsonPath.read(root, "$.id");

        mvc.perform(post("/api/courses/9912/discussions").header("Authorization", lecturer)
                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .content("{\"content\":\"Cross course\",\"parentId\":" + rootId + "}"))
                .andExpect(status().isNotFound());
        mvc.perform(post("/api/courses/9911/discussions").header("Authorization", lecturer)
                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .content("{\"content\":\"Here is the answer\",\"parentId\":" + rootId + "}"))
                .andExpect(status().isCreated()).andExpect(jsonPath("$.parentId").value(rootId));
        mvc.perform(get("/api/courses/9911/discussions").header("Authorization", outsider))
                .andExpect(status().isForbidden());
        mvc.perform(delete("/api/courses/9911/discussions/{id}", rootId)
                .header("Authorization", student)).andExpect(status().isNoContent());
        mvc.perform(get("/api/courses/9911/discussions").header("Authorization", student))
                .andExpect(status().isOk()).andExpect(jsonPath("$.length()").value(2))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$[0].deleted").value(true))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$[1].content").value("Here is the answer"));
    }
}

import static org.mockito.Mockito.verify;

import com.smartcampus.backend.common.security.CourseAccess;
import com.smartcampus.backend.course.dto.CreateCourseRequest;
import com.smartcampus.backend.course.dto.UpdateCourseRequest;
import com.smartcampus.backend.course.entity.Course;
import com.smartcampus.backend.course.entity.PublicationState;
import com.smartcampus.backend.course.exception.CourseNotFoundException;
import com.smartcampus.backend.course.repository.CourseRepository;
import com.smartcampus.backend.course.service.CourseService;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.mockito.InjectMocks;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;
import org.springframework.test.util.ReflectionTestUtils;

@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class CourseServiceTest {
    @Mock CourseRepository repository;
    @Mock CourseAccess access;
    @InjectMocks CourseService service;

    @Test
    void listsCoursesInIdOrder() {
        Course course = course(1L);
        when(repository.findAll(Sort.by("id"))).thenReturn(List.of(course));

        assertThat(service.findAll()).extracting(response -> response.id()).containsExactly(1L);
    }

    @Test
    void studentSeesOnlyPublishedCourses() {
        when(access.hasRole("STUDENT")).thenReturn(true);
        when(repository.findByPublicationState(PublicationState.PUBLISHED, Sort.by("id"))).thenReturn(List.of());

        assertThat(service.findAll()).isEmpty();
    }

    @Test
    void readsCourseAndReportsMissingCourse() {
        when(repository.findById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(course(1L)));
        when(repository.findById(2L)).thenReturn(Optional.empty());

        assertThat(service.findById(1L).title()).isEqualTo("Intro");
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> service.findById(2L))
                .isInstanceOf(CourseNotFoundException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void studentCannotReadDraftCourse() {
        when(access.hasRole("STUDENT")).thenReturn(true);
        when(repository.findById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(course(1L))); // DRAFT

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> service.findById(1L))
                .isInstanceOf(CourseNotFoundException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void createsDraftWithClosedEnrollmentByDefault_creatorIsLoggedInUser() {
        when(access.userId()).thenReturn(7L);
        when(repository.saveAndFlush(any(Course.class))).thenAnswer(invocation -> {
            Course saved = invocation.getArgument(0);
            ReflectionTestUtils.setField(saved, "id", 3L);
            return saved;
        });

        var response = service.create(new CreateCourseRequest(" Intro ", null, null, null));

        assertThat(response.id()).isEqualTo(3L);
        assertThat(response.title()).isEqualTo("Intro");
        assertThat(response.publicationState()).isEqualTo(PublicationState.DRAFT);
        assertThat(response.enrollmentOpen()).isFalse();
        assertThat(response.createdBy()).isEqualTo(7L);
    }

    @Test
    void updatesCourseWithoutChangingCreator_afterCheckingCourseStaff() {
        Course course = course(1L);
        when(repository.findById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(course));
        when(repository.saveAndFlush(course)).thenReturn(course);

        var response = service.update(1L,
                new UpdateCourseRequest(" Advanced ", "Details", PublicationState.PUBLISHED, true));

        verify(access).requireStaff(1L);
        assertThat(response.title()).isEqualTo("Advanced");
        assertThat(response.description()).isEqualTo("Details");
        assertThat(response.publicationState()).isEqualTo(PublicationState.PUBLISHED);
        assertThat(response.enrollmentOpen()).isTrue();
        assertThat(response.createdBy()).isEqualTo(7L);
        verify(repository).saveAndFlush(course);
    }

    private Course course(Long id) {
        Course course = new Course("Intro", null, PublicationState.DRAFT, false, 7L);
        ReflectionTestUtils.setField(course, "id", id);
        return course;
    }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.security;

import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.exception.EnrollmentException;
import com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment.repository.EnrollmentRepository;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.mockito.InjectMocks;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.AnonymousAuthenticationToken;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken;
import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
import org.springframework.security.core.GrantedAuthority;
import org.springframework.security.core.authority.AuthorityUtils;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.User;
import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetails;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.any;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.never;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verify;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class CurrentUserResolverTest {

    private static final Long STUDENT_A_ID = 9001L;
    private static final List<GrantedAuthority> STUDENT_ROLE = AuthorityUtils.createAuthorityList("ROLE_STUDENT");

    @Mock
    private EnrollmentRepository enrollmentRepository;

    @InjectMocks
    private CurrentUserResolver currentUserResolver;

    @AfterEach
    void clearSecurityContext() {
        SecurityContextHolder.clearContext();
    }

    @Test
    void noAuthentication_isRejectedWith401() {
        EnrollmentException ex = assertThrows(EnrollmentException.class,
                () -> currentUserResolver.getCurrentUserId());

        assertEquals(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, ex.getStatus());
        verify(enrollmentRepository, never()).findUserIdByLogin(any());
    }

    @Test
    void anonymousUser_isRejectedWith401() {
        loginAs(new AnonymousAuthenticationToken(
                "anonymous-key", "anonymousUser", AuthorityUtils.createAuthorityList("ROLE_ANONYMOUS")));

        EnrollmentException ex = assertThrows(EnrollmentException.class,
                () -> currentUserResolver.getCurrentUserId());

        assertEquals(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, ex.getStatus());
        verify(enrollmentRepository, never()).findUserIdByLogin(any());
    }

    @Test
    void notAuthenticatedToken_isRejectedWith401() {
        loginAs(UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken.unauthenticated("student_a", "123456"));

        EnrollmentException ex = assertThrows(EnrollmentException.class,
                () -> currentUserResolver.getCurrentUserId());

        assertEquals(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, ex.getStatus());
    }

    @Test
    void principalIsUserId_returnsItWithoutQueryingTheDatabase() {
        loginAs(UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken.authenticated(STUDENT_A_ID, null, STUDENT_ROLE));

        assertEquals(STUDENT_A_ID, currentUserResolver.getCurrentUserId());
        verify(enrollmentRepository, never()).findUserIdByLogin(any());
    }

    @Test
    void principalIsUserDetails_looksUpTheIdByUsername() {
        UserDetails user = User.withUsername("student_a").password("ignored").roles("STUDENT").build();
        loginAs(UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken.authenticated(user, null, user.getAuthorities()));
        when(enrollmentRepository.findUserIdByLogin("student_a")).thenReturn(Optional.of(STUDENT_A_ID));

        assertEquals(STUDENT_A_ID, currentUserResolver.getCurrentUserId());
    }

    @Test
    void principalIsEmail_looksUpTheIdByEmail() {
        loginAs(UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken.authenticated("student.a@test.local", null, STUDENT_ROLE));
        when(enrollmentRepository.findUserIdByLogin("student.a@test.local")).thenReturn(Optional.of(STUDENT_A_ID));

        assertEquals(STUDENT_A_ID, currentUserResolver.getCurrentUserId());
    }

    @Test
    void loggedInUserMissingFromDatabase_isRejectedWith401() {
        loginAs(UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken.authenticated("deleted_user", null, STUDENT_ROLE));
        when(enrollmentRepository.findUserIdByLogin("deleted_user")).thenReturn(Optional.empty());

        EnrollmentException ex = assertThrows(EnrollmentException.class,
                () -> currentUserResolver.getCurrentUserId());

        assertEquals(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, ex.getStatus());
    }

    private static void loginAs(Authentication authentication) {
        SecurityContextHolder.getContext().setAuthentication(authentication);
    }
}

        EnrollmentException ex = assertThrows(EnrollmentException.class, () -> enrollmentService.enroll(STUDENT_ID, COURSE_ID));

        assertEquals(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, ex.getStatus());
        assertEquals("ALREADY_ENROLLED", ex.getCode());
        verify(enrollmentRepository, never()).saveAndFlush(any());
    }

    @Test
    void enroll_afterWithdrawal_reactivatesTheSameRecord() {
        givenStudent("ACTIVE");
        givenCourse("PUBLISHED", "OPEN");
        givenExisting(EnrollmentStatus.WITHDRAWN);
        when(enrollmentRepository.transitionStatus(ENROLLMENT_ID, EnrollmentStatus.WITHDRAWN, EnrollmentStatus.ACTIVE))
                .thenReturn(1);
        when(enrollmentRepository.findById(ENROLLMENT_ID))
                .thenReturn(Optional.of(enrollment(ENROLLMENT_ID, STUDENT_ID, COURSE_ID, EnrollmentStatus.ACTIVE)));

        EnrollmentResponse response = enrollmentService.enroll(STUDENT_ID, COURSE_ID);

        assertEquals(ENROLLMENT_ID, response.enrollmentId());
        assertEquals(EnrollmentStatus.ACTIVE, response.status());
        EnrollmentHistory history = capturedHistory();
        assertEquals(EnrollmentStatus.WITHDRAWN, history.getPreviousStatus());
        assertEquals(EnrollmentStatus.ACTIVE, history.getNewStatus());
        verify(enrollmentRepository, never()).saveAndFlush(any());
    }

            @Override public Long getEnrollmentId() { return ENROLLMENT_ID; }
            @Override public String getStatus() { return "ACTIVE"; }
            @Override public LocalDateTime getEnrolledAt() { return enrolledAt; }
            @Override public Long getCourseId() { return COURSE_ID; }
            @Override public String getCourseTitle() { return "Spring Boot 101"; }
            @Override public String getCourseDescription() { return "Intro"; }
            @Override public String getPublicationState() { return "PUBLISHED"; }
        }));

        List<MyEnrollmentResponse> result = enrollmentService.getMyEnrollments(STUDENT_ID);

        assertEquals(1, result.size());
        assertEquals(COURSE_ID, result.getFirst().courseId());

        when(enrollmentRepository.findById(ENROLLMENT_ID))
                .thenReturn(Optional.of(enrollment(ENROLLMENT_ID, STUDENT_ID, COURSE_ID, EnrollmentStatus.ACTIVE)));
        when(enrollmentHistoryRepository.findByEnrollmentIdOrderByCreatedAtAscIdAsc(ENROLLMENT_ID))
                .thenReturn(List.of(EnrollmentHistory.initial(ENROLLMENT_ID, STUDENT_ID, "x")));

        List<EnrollmentHistoryResponse> history = enrollmentService.getHistory(STUDENT_ID, ENROLLMENT_ID);

        assertEquals(1, history.size());
        verify(courseAccessGuard, never()).requireUser(any());

        Long otherLecturer = 50L;

                .thenReturn(Optional.of(enrollment(ENROLLMENT_ID, STUDENT_ID, COURSE_ID, EnrollmentStatus.ACTIVE)));

        when(courseAccessGuard.canManageCourse(lecturer(otherLecturer), COURSE_ID)).thenReturn(false);

        EnrollmentException ex = assertThrows(EnrollmentException.class,
                () -> enrollmentService.getHistory(otherLecturer, ENROLLMENT_ID));

        when(enrollmentRepository.findUserAccountInfo(STUDENT_ID)).thenReturn(Optional.of(userInfo(STUDENT_ID, "STUDENT", status)));
    }

        when(enrollmentRepository.findCourseEnrollmentInfo(COURSE_ID))
                .thenReturn(Optional.of(course(COURSE_ID, "Spring Boot 101", publicationState, window)));

        when(enrollmentRepository.findByStudentIdAndCourseId(STUDENT_ID, COURSE_ID))
                .thenReturn(Optional.of(enrollment(ENROLLMENT_ID, STUDENT_ID, COURSE_ID, status)));
    }

    private EnrollmentHistory capturedHistory() {
        ArgumentCaptor<EnrollmentHistory> captor = ArgumentCaptor.forClass(EnrollmentHistory.class);
        verify(enrollmentHistoryRepository).save(captor.capture());
        return captor.getValue();
    }

package com.smartcampus.backend.enrollment;

import com.jayway.jsonpath.JsonPath;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.security.test.context.support.WithMockUser;
import org.springframework.test.context.ActiveProfiles;
import org.springframework.test.context.jdbc.Sql;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.MockMvc;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.setup.MockMvcBuilders;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.context.WebApplicationContext;

import static org.springframework.security.test.web.servlet.setup.SecurityMockMvcConfigurers.springSecurity;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.get;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.post;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result.MockMvcResultMatchers.jsonPath;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result.MockMvcResultMatchers.status;

@SpringBootTest
@ActiveProfiles("test")
@Transactional
@Sql("/sql/enrollment-auth-test-data.sql")
class EnrollmentSecurityIntegrationTest {

    private static final String LOGIN_PATH = "/api/auth/login";
    private static final String LOGIN_BODY = """
            {"username": "student_a", "password": "123456"}
            """;
    private static final String TOKEN_JSON_PATH = "$..access_token";

    private static final String ENROLL_OPEN_COURSE = "/api/courses/9101/enroll";
    private static final String MY_ENROLLMENTS = "/api/enrollments/me";
    private static final int STUDENT_A_ID = 9001;
    private static final int STUDENT_B_ID = 9002;
    private static final int OPEN_COURSE_ID = 9101;

    @Autowired
    private WebApplicationContext context;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;

    private MockMvc mockMvc;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        mockMvc = MockMvcBuilders.webAppContextSetup(context)
                .apply(springSecurity())
                .build();
    }

    @Test
    void enroll_withoutToken_returns401() throws Exception {
        mockMvc.perform(post(ENROLL_OPEN_COURSE))
                .andExpect(status().isUnauthorized());
    }

    @Test
    void myEnrollments_withoutToken_returns401() throws Exception {
        mockMvc.perform(get(MY_ENROLLMENTS))
                .andExpect(status().isUnauthorized());
    }

    @Test
    void enroll_withInvalidToken_returns401() throws Exception {
        mockMvc.perform(post(ENROLL_OPEN_COURSE)
                        .header("Authorization", "Bearer this.is-not.a-valid-jwt"))
                .andExpect(status().isUnauthorized());
    }

    @Test
    void enroll_withOnlyTheOldPhase1Header_returns401() throws Exception {
        mockMvc.perform(post(ENROLL_OPEN_COURSE)
                        .header("X-User-Id", String.valueOf(STUDENT_A_ID)))
                .andExpect(status().isUnauthorized());
    }

    @Test
    @WithMockUser(username = "lecturer_a", roles = "LECTURER")
    void enroll_asLecturer_returns403() throws Exception {
        mockMvc.perform(post(ENROLL_OPEN_COURSE))
                .andExpect(status().isForbidden());
    }

    @Test
    @WithMockUser(username = "student_b", roles = "STUDENT")
    void enroll_asInactiveStudent_returns403() throws Exception {
        mockMvc.perform(post(ENROLL_OPEN_COURSE))
                .andExpect(status().isForbidden())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.error_code").value("ACCOUNT_INACTIVE"));
    }

    @Test
    @WithMockUser(username = "student_a", roles = "STUDENT")
    void enroll_asStudent_returns201_forTheLoggedInStudent() throws Exception {
        mockMvc.perform(post(ENROLL_OPEN_COURSE))
                .andExpect(status().isCreated())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.success").value(true))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.data.studentId").value(STUDENT_A_ID))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.data.courseId").value(OPEN_COURSE_ID))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.data.status").value("ACTIVE"));
    }

    @Test
    @WithMockUser(username = "student_a", roles = "STUDENT")
    void enroll_cannotEnrollSomeoneElseBySpoofingTheOldHeader() throws Exception {
        // Logged in as student_a but pretends to be student_b: the id must come from the login.
        mockMvc.perform(post(ENROLL_OPEN_COURSE)
                        .header("X-User-Id", String.valueOf(STUDENT_B_ID)))
                .andExpect(status().isCreated())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.data.studentId").value(STUDENT_A_ID));
    }

    @Test
    @WithMockUser(username = "student_a", roles = "STUDENT")
    void enroll_twice_returns409() throws Exception {
        mockMvc.perform(post(ENROLL_OPEN_COURSE))
                .andExpect(status().isCreated());

        mockMvc.perform(post(ENROLL_OPEN_COURSE))
                .andExpect(status().isConflict())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.error_code").value("ALREADY_ENROLLED"));
    }

    @Test
    @WithMockUser(username = "student_a", roles = "STUDENT")
    void enrolledCourse_appearsInMyEnrollments() throws Exception {
        mockMvc.perform(post(ENROLL_OPEN_COURSE))
                .andExpect(status().isCreated());

        mockMvc.perform(get(MY_ENROLLMENTS))
                .andExpect(status().isOk())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.success").value(true))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.data.length()").value(1))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.data[0].courseId").value(OPEN_COURSE_ID))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.data[0].status").value("ACTIVE"));
    }

    @Test
    @WithMockUser(username = "student_a", roles = "STUDENT")
    void myEnrollments_doesNotShowOtherStudentsEnrollments() throws Exception {
        jdbcTemplate.update(
                "INSERT INTO enrollments (student_id, course_id, status) VALUES (?, ?, 'ACTIVE')",
                STUDENT_B_ID, OPEN_COURSE_ID);

        mockMvc.perform(get(MY_ENROLLMENTS))
                .andExpect(status().isOk())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.data.length()").value(0));
    }

    @Test
    void realJwt_loginThenEnrollThenListMyCourses() throws Exception {
        String loginResponse = mockMvc.perform(post(LOGIN_PATH)
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content(LOGIN_BODY))
                .andExpect(status().isOk())
                .andReturn()
                .getResponse()
                .getContentAsString();
        java.util.List<String> tokens = JsonPath.read(loginResponse, "$..accessToken");
        if (tokens.isEmpty()) {
            tokens = JsonPath.read(loginResponse, "$..access_token");
        }
        org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse(tokens.isEmpty(),
                "KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y token trong response login: " + loginResponse);
        String bearer = "Bearer " + tokens.getFirst();

        mockMvc.perform(post(ENROLL_OPEN_COURSE).header("Authorization", bearer))
                .andExpect(status().isCreated())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.data.studentId").value(STUDENT_A_ID));

        mockMvc.perform(get(MY_ENROLLMENTS).header("Authorization", bearer))
                .andExpect(status().isOk())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.data.length()").value(1))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.data[0].courseId").value(OPEN_COURSE_ID));
    }
}

package com.smartcampus.backend.learningcontent;

import jakarta.persistence.EntityManager;
import com.jayway.jsonpath.JsonPath;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetailsService;
import org.springframework.test.context.ActiveProfiles;
import org.springframework.test.context.jdbc.Sql;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.MockMvc;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.ResultActions;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockHttpServletRequestBuilder;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.setup.MockMvcBuilders;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.context.WebApplicationContext;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
import static org.springframework.security.test.web.servlet.request.SecurityMockMvcRequestPostProcessors.user;
import static org.springframework.security.test.web.servlet.setup.SecurityMockMvcConfigurers.springSecurity;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.*;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result.MockMvcResultMatchers.*;

@SpringBootTest
@ActiveProfiles("test")
@Transactional
@Sql("/sql/week42-test-data.sql")
class LearningContentIntegrationTest {

    private static final long COURSE_ID = 9101L;
    private static final int TEST_ORDER = 900;

    @Autowired
    private WebApplicationContext context;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;

    @Autowired
    private UserDetailsService userDetailsService;

    @Autowired
    private EntityManager entityManager;

    private MockMvc mockMvc;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        mockMvc = MockMvcBuilders
                .webAppContextSetup(context)
                .apply(springSecurity())
                .build();
    }

    private ResultActions call(
            String username,
            MockHttpServletRequestBuilder request
    ) throws Exception {
        return mockMvc.perform(
                request.with(user(
                        userDetailsService.loadUserByUsername(username)
                ))
        );
    }

    private int id(ResultActions result) throws Exception {
        String json = result.andReturn()
                .getResponse()
                .getContentAsString();

        Number value = JsonPath.read(json, "$.id");
        return value.intValue();
    }

    private int count(String sql, Object... args) {
        entityManager.flush();

        Integer value = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                sql, Integer.class, args
        );

        return value == null ? 0 : value;
    }

    private String chaptersUrl() {
        return "/api/courses/" + COURSE_ID + "/chapters";
    }

    private String lessonsUrl(long chapterId) {
        return chaptersUrl() + "/" + chapterId + "/lessons";
    }

    private String materialsUrl(long chapterId, long lessonId) {
        return lessonsUrl(chapterId)
                + "/" + lessonId + "/materials";
    }

    private int createChapter(int order) throws Exception {
        ResultActions result = call(
                "lecturer_a",
                post(chaptersUrl())
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content("""
                                {
                                  "title": "Test Chapter",
                                  "orderIndex": %d
                                }
                                """.formatted(order))
        ).andExpect(status().isCreated());

        return id(result);
    }

    private int createLesson(long chapterId, int order)
            throws Exception {
        ResultActions result = call(
                "lecturer_a",
                post(lessonsUrl(chapterId))
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content("""
                                {
                                  "title": "Test Lesson",
                                  "contentType": "VIDEO",
                                  "orderIndex": %d
                                }
                                """.formatted(order))
        ).andExpect(status().isCreated());

        return id(result);
    }

    private int createMaterial(long chapterId, long lessonId)
            throws Exception {
        ResultActions result = call(
                "lecturer_a",
                post(materialsUrl(chapterId, lessonId))
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content("""
                                {
                                  "title": "Test Material",
                                  "fileUrl": "https://example.com/file.pdf",
                                  "fileType": "PDF"
                                }
                                """)
        ).andExpect(status().isCreated());

        return id(result);
    }

    // ============================
    // CHAPTER
    // ============================

    @Test
    void lecturerCanCreateChapter() throws Exception {
        int chapterId = createChapter(TEST_ORDER);

        assertEquals(
                1,
                count(
                        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chapters WHERE id = ?",
                        chapterId
                )
        );
    }

    @Test
    void lecturerCanUpdateChapter() throws Exception {
        int chapterId = createChapter(TEST_ORDER);

        call(
                "lecturer_a",
                put(chaptersUrl() + "/" + chapterId)
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content("""
                                {
                                  "title": "Updated Chapter",
                                  "orderIndex": 901
                                }
                                """)
        ).andExpect(status().isOk());

        assertEquals(
                1,
                count(
                        """
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM chapters
                        WHERE id = ?
                          AND title = 'Updated Chapter'
                          AND order_index = 901
                        """,
                        chapterId
                )
        );
    }

    @Test
    void lecturerCanDeleteChapter() throws Exception {
        int chapterId = createChapter(TEST_ORDER);

        call(
                "lecturer_a",
                delete(chaptersUrl() + "/" + chapterId)
        ).andExpect(status().isNoContent());

        assertEquals(
                0,
                count(
                        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chapters WHERE id = ?",
                        chapterId
                )
        );
    }

    @Test
    void duplicateChapterOrderReturnsConflict() throws Exception {
        createChapter(TEST_ORDER);

        call(
                "lecturer_a",
                post(chaptersUrl())
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content("""
                                {
                                  "title": "Duplicate",
                                  "orderIndex": 900

package com.smartcampus.backend.notification;

import com.smartcampus.backend.common.exception.ApiException;
import com.smartcampus.backend.notification.dto.NotificationResponse;
import com.smartcampus.backend.notification.entity.Notification;
import com.smartcampus.backend.notification.entity.NotificationType;
import com.smartcampus.backend.notification.repository.NotificationRepository;
import com.smartcampus.backend.notification.service.NotificationService;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.mockito.ArgumentCaptor;
import org.mockito.InjectMocks;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.test.util.ReflectionTestUtils;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.any;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.anyLong;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.never;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verify;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class NotificationServiceTest {

    private static final Long USER_ID = 1L;

    @Mock private NotificationRepository repository;
    @InjectMocks private NotificationService service;

    @Test
    void notify_savesNotificationForRecipient() {
        when(repository.save(any(Notification.class))).thenAnswer(inv -> inv.getArgument(0));

        service.notify(USER_ID, NotificationType.SYSTEM, "Title", "Message", "/x");

        ArgumentCaptor<Notification> captor = ArgumentCaptor.forClass(Notification.class);
        verify(repository).save(captor.capture());
        assertEquals(USER_ID, captor.getValue().getRecipientId());
        assertEquals(NotificationType.SYSTEM, captor.getValue().getType());
        assertEquals("/x", captor.getValue().getLink());
    }

    @Test
    void getMyNotifications_usesDefaultAndMaxLimit() {

        assertTrue(service.getMyNotifications(USER_ID, true, 5000).isEmpty());
    }

    @Test
    void markRead_ownNotification_returnsItAsRead() {
        Notification unread = notification(7L);
        Notification read = notification(7L);
        ReflectionTestUtils.setField(read, "read", true);
        when(repository.findByIdAndRecipientId(7L, USER_ID)).thenReturn(Optional.of(unread), Optional.of(read));

        NotificationResponse response = service.markRead(USER_ID, 7L);

        assertTrue(response.read());
        verify(repository).markRead(7L, USER_ID);
    }

    @Test
    void markRead_notificationOfAnotherUser_isRejectedWith404() {
        when(repository.findByIdAndRecipientId(7L, USER_ID)).thenReturn(Optional.empty());

        ApiException ex = assertThrows(ApiException.class, () -> service.markRead(USER_ID, 7L));

        assertEquals(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, ex.getStatus());
        assertEquals("NOTIFICATION_NOT_FOUND", ex.getCode());
        verify(repository, never()).markRead(anyLong(), anyLong());
    }

    @Test
    void markAllRead_returnsNumberOfUpdatedRows() {
        when(repository.markAllRead(USER_ID)).thenReturn(3);

        assertEquals(3, service.markAllRead(USER_ID).marked());
    }

    @Test
    void countUnread_delegatesToRepository() {
        when(repository.countByRecipientIdAndReadFalse(USER_ID)).thenReturn(4L);

        assertEquals(4L, service.countUnread(USER_ID).unread());
    }

    private static Notification notification(Long id) {
        Notification n = new Notification(USER_ID, NotificationType.SYSTEM, "t", "m", null);
        ReflectionTestUtils.setField(n, "id", id);
        return n;
    }
