import { useEffect, useState, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react'
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next'
import { FontAwesomeIcon } from '@fortawesome/react-fontawesome'
import {
  faArrowRight,
  faEnvelope,
  faEye,
  faEyeSlash,
  faIdCard,
  faLock,
  faSpinner,
  faUser,
  type IconDefinition,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons'
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router'
import { useLogin, useRegister } from '../services/auth.query'
import { useToast } from '~/components/Toast'
import { getErrorMessage } from '~/utils/getErrorMessage'

type FieldName = 'username' | 'fullName' | 'email' | 'password' | 'confirmPassword'
type Values = Record<FieldName, string>
type Errors = Partial<Record<FieldName, string>>

const emptyValues: Values = {
  username: '',
  fullName: '',
  email: '',
  password: '',
  confirmPassword: '',
}

const EMAIL_REGEX = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/

const inputClass = (hasError: boolean) =>
  `h-11 w-full rounded-xl border bg-surface-muted pl-10 pr-10 text-sm text-fg outline-none placeholder:text-fg-subtle focus:ring-2 ${
    hasError
      ? 'border-danger focus:border-danger focus:ring-danger/30'
      : 'border-border focus:border-primary focus:ring-primary/30'
  }`

interface FieldProps {
  id: FieldName
  label: string
  icon: IconDefinition
  required?: boolean
  error?: string
  children: React.ReactNode
}

function Field({ id, label, icon, required, error, children }: FieldProps) {
  return (
    <div>
      <label htmlFor={id} className="mb-1.5 block text-sm font-medium">
        {label} {required && <span className="text-danger">*</span>}
      </label>
      <div className="relative">
        <FontAwesomeIcon
          icon={icon}
          className="absolute top-1/2 left-3.5 -translate-y-1/2 text-fg-subtle"
        />
        {children}
      </div>
      {error && (
        <p id={`${id}-error`} className="mt-1 text-xs text-danger">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

export default function AuthForm({ isLogin }: { isLogin: boolean }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation('auth')
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const toast = useToast()

  const { mutate: login, isPending: loggingIn } = useLogin()
  const { mutate: registerUser, isPending: registering } = useRegister()
  const isBusy = loggingIn || registering

  const [values, setValues] = useState<Values>(emptyValues)
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Errors>({})
  const [remember, setRemember] = useState(false)
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false)
  const [showConfirmPassword, setShowConfirmPassword] = useState(false)

  // Äá»•i giá»¯a Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p <-> Ä‘Äƒng kÃ½ thÃ¬ reset form
  useEffect(() => {
    setValues(emptyValues)
    setErrors({})
    setShowPassword(false)
    setShowConfirmPassword(false)
  }, [isLogin])

  const handleChange = (name: FieldName, value: string) => {
    setValues((v) => ({ ...v, [name]: value }))
    // XoÃ¡ lá»—i cá»§a Ã´ Ä‘ang gÃµ
    if (errors[name]) setErrors((e) => ({ ...e, [name]: undefined }))
  }

  const validate = (): Errors => {
    const errs: Errors = {}
    const username = values.username.trim()
    const fullName = values.fullName.trim()
    const email = values.email.trim()
    const { password, confirmPassword } = values

    if (!username) errs.username = t('validation.required')
    if (!password) errs.password = t('validation.required')

    // ÄÄƒng nháº­p chá»‰ cáº§n kiá»ƒm tra khÃ´ng Ä‘á»ƒ trá»‘ng
    if (isLogin) return errs

    if (username && (username.length < 3 || username.length > 100)) {
      errs.username = t('validation.usernameLength', { min: 3, max: 100 })
    }

    if (!fullName) errs.fullName = t('validation.required')
    else if (fullName.length > 150) errs.fullName = t('validation.maxLength', { max: 150 })

    if (!email) errs.email = t('validation.required')
    else if (!EMAIL_REGEX.test(email)) errs.email = t('validation.emailInvalid')
    else if (email.length > 255) errs.email = t('validation.maxLength', { max: 255 })

    if (password && (password.length < 8 || password.length > 72)) {
      errs.password = t('validation.passwordLength', { min: 8, max: 72 })
    }

    if (!confirmPassword) errs.confirmPassword = t('validation.required')
    else if (confirmPassword !== password) {
      errs.confirmPassword = t('validation.confirmMismatch')
    }

    return errs
  }

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    if (isBusy) return

    const errs = validate()
    setErrors(errs)
    if (Object.keys(errs).length > 0) return

    const username = values.username.trim()

    if (isLogin) {
      login(
        { username, password: values.password },
        {
          onSuccess: () => {
            toast.success(t('login.success'))
            navigate('/')
          },
          onError: (err) => toast.error(getErrorMessage(err, t('login.failed'))),
        },
      )
    } else {
      registerUser(
        {
          username,
          fullName: values.fullName.trim(),
          email: values.email.trim(),
          password: values.password,
        },
        {
          onSuccess: (message) => {
            toast.success(message || t('signin.success'))
            navigate('/login')
          },
          onError: (err) => toast.error(getErrorMessage(err, t('signin.failed'))),
        },
      )
    }
  }

  const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const target = e.target as HTMLInputElement
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && target.tagName === 'INPUT' && target.type !== 'checkbox') {
      e.preventDefault()
      handleSubmit()
    }
  }

  const toggleLabel = (visible: boolean) =>
    visible ? t('common.hidePassword') : t('common.showPassword')

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col" onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}>
      <div className="space-y-4">
        {/* Username */}
        <Field
          id="username"
          label={isLogin ? t('login.id') : t('signin.id')}
          icon={faUser}
          required={!isLogin}
          error={errors.username}
        >
          <input
            id="username"
            name="username"
            autoComplete="username"
            placeholder="user.name"
            className={inputClass(!!errors.username)}
            value={values.username}
            onChange={(e) => handleChange('username', e.target.value)}
            aria-invalid={!!errors.username}
            aria-describedby={errors.username ? 'username-error' : undefined}
          />
        </Field>

        {/* Há» tÃªn + Email: chá»‰ khi Ä‘Äƒng kÃ½ */}
        {!isLogin && (
          <>
            <Field
              id="fullName"
              label={t('signin.fullName')}
              icon={faIdCard}
              required
              error={errors.fullName}
            >
              <input
                id="fullName"
                name="fullName"
                autoComplete="name"
                placeholder="Nguyen Van A"
                className={inputClass(!!errors.fullName)}
                value={values.fullName}
                onChange={(e) => handleChange('fullName', e.target.value)}
                aria-invalid={!!errors.fullName}
                aria-describedby={errors.fullName ? 'fullName-error' : undefined}
              />
            </Field>

            <Field
              id="email"
              label={t('signin.email')}
              icon={faEnvelope}
              required
              error={errors.email}
            >
              <input
                id="email"
                name="email"
                type="email"
                autoComplete="email"
                placeholder="name@example.com"
                className={inputClass(!!errors.email)}
                value={values.email}
                onChange={(e) => handleChange('email', e.target.value)}
                aria-invalid={!!errors.email}
                aria-describedby={errors.email ? 'email-error' : undefined}
              />
            </Field>
          </>
        )}

        {/* Máº­t kháº©u */}
        <Field
          id="password"
          label={isLogin ? t('login.password') : t('signin.password')}
          icon={faLock}
          required={!isLogin}
          error={errors.password}
        >
          <input
            id="password"
            name="password"
            type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
            autoComplete={isLogin ? 'current-password' : 'new-password'}
            placeholder="â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢"
            className={inputClass(!!errors.password)}
            value={values.password}
            onChange={(e) => handleChange('password', e.target.value)}
            aria-invalid={!!errors.password}
            aria-describedby={errors.password ? 'password-error' : undefined}
          />
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setShowPassword((v) => !v)}
            aria-label={toggleLabel(showPassword)}
            className="absolute top-1/2 right-3 -translate-y-1/2 text-fg-subtle hover:text-fg"
          >
            <FontAwesomeIcon icon={showPassword ? faEyeSlash : faEye} />
          </button>
        </Field>

        {/* Nháº­p láº¡i máº­t kháº©u */}
        {!isLogin && (
          <Field
            id="confirmPassword"
            label={t('signin.confirmPassword')}
            icon={faLock}
            required
            error={errors.confirmPassword}
          >
            <input
              id="confirmPassword"
              name="confirmPassword"
              type={showConfirmPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
              autoComplete="new-password"
              placeholder="â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢"
              className={inputClass(!!errors.confirmPassword)}
              value={values.confirmPassword}
              onChange={(e) => handleChange('confirmPassword', e.target.value)}
              aria-invalid={!!errors.confirmPassword}

            />

        {/* TODO: Remember login */}
        {isLogin && (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">

import { postApi } from '~/config/axiosClient'
import { accessTokenStorage } from '~/config/accessTokenStorage'

interface LoginPayload {
  username: string
  password: string
}

interface RegisterPayload {
  username: string
  fullName: string
  password: string
  email: string
}

interface LoginResponse {
  accessToken: string
  tokenType: string
  expiresIn: number
  userId: number
  username: string
}

interface RegisterResponse {
  message?: string
}

export const login = async (payload: LoginPayload) => {
  const res = await postApi<LoginResponse>('/auth/login', payload)
  accessTokenStorage.setAccessToken(res.accessToken)
  accessTokenStorage.setUserId(res.userId)
  return res.username
}

export const register = async (payload: RegisterPayload) => {
  const res = await postApi<RegisterResponse>('/auth/register', payload)
  return res?.message
}

export const logout = () => {
  accessTokenStorage.clearAccessToken()
}

import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'

export const useLogin = () => {
  const qc = useQueryClient()
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: login,
    // TODO
    onSuccess: (username) => {
      qc.setQueryData(['me'], username)
    },
  })
}

export const useRegister = () => {
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: register,
  })
}

export const useLogout = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const qc = useQueryClient()
  return () => {
    logout()
    qc.clear()
    void navigate("/login");
  }
}

import {
  faDownload,
  faFile,
  faFileExcel,
  faFileImage,
  faFileLines,
  faFilePdf,
  faFilePowerpoint,
  faFileWord,
  faFileZipper,
} from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons'
import type { IconDefinition } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons'
import { FontAwesomeIcon } from '@fortawesome/react-fontawesome'
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next'
import type { IMaterial } from '../services/courseDetail.type'

type Kind = 'pdf' | 'word' | 'ppt' | 'excel' | 'zip' | 'text' | 'image' | 'other'

const STYLES: Record<Kind, { icon: IconDefinition; tone: string; label: string }> = {
  pdf: { icon: faFilePdf, tone: 'bg-red-500/15 text-red-500', label: 'PDF' },
  word: { icon: faFileWord, tone: 'bg-blue-500/15 text-blue-500', label: 'Word' },
  ppt: { icon: faFilePowerpoint, tone: 'bg-orange-500/15 text-orange-500', label: 'PowerPoint' },
  excel: { icon: faFileExcel, tone: 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-500', label: 'Excel' },
  zip: { icon: faFileZipper, tone: 'bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-500', label: 'ZIP' },
  text: { icon: faFileLines, tone: 'bg-slate-500/15 text-slate-400', label: 'Text' },
  image: { icon: faFileImage, tone: 'bg-pink-500/15 text-pink-500', label: 'Image' },
  other: { icon: faFile, tone: 'bg-primary-soft text-primary', label: '' },
}

const EXT_KIND: Record<string, Kind> = {
  pdf: 'pdf', doc: 'word', docx: 'word', ppt: 'ppt', pptx: 'ppt',
  xls: 'excel', xlsx: 'excel', csv: 'excel', zip: 'zip', rar: 'zip', '7z': 'zip',
  txt: 'text', md: 'text', png: 'image', jpg: 'image', jpeg: 'image', gif: 'image',
  webp: 'image', svg: 'image',
}

const kindOf = (m: IMaterial): Kind => {
  const type = (m.fileType ?? '').toLowerCase()
  if (type.includes('word')) return 'word'
  if (type.includes('powerpoint') || type.includes('presentation')) return 'ppt'
  if (type.includes('excel') || type.includes('spreadsheet')) return 'excel'
  const typeExt = type.split(/[/.]/).pop() ?? ''
  const urlExt = m.fileUrl.split(/[?#]/)[0].split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase() ?? ''
  return EXT_KIND[typeExt] ?? EXT_KIND[urlExt] ?? 'other'
}

export default function AttachmentCard({ material }: { material: IMaterial }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation('courseDetail')
  const { icon, tone, label } = STYLES[kindOf(material)]

  return (
    <a
      href={material.fileUrl}
      target="_blank"
      rel="noreferrer noopener"
      download
      aria-label={t('download', { name: material.title })}
      className="group flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl bg-surface-muted p-3 transition hover:bg-primary-soft focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-primary"
    >
      <span className={`grid h-11 w-11 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg ${tone}`}>
        <FontAwesomeIcon icon={icon} className="text-lg" aria-hidden />
      </span>
      <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <span className="block truncate text-sm font-semibold text-fg">{material.title}</span>
        <span className="block truncate font-label text-xs text-fg-muted">
          {label || material.fileType}
        </span>
      </span>
      <FontAwesomeIcon
        icon={faDownload}
        className="shrink-0 text-primary transition group-hover:scale-110"
        aria-hidden
      />
    </a>
  )
}

import { faPen } from "@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons";
import { FontAwesomeIcon } from "@fortawesome/react-fontawesome";
import { useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import {
    useAddNewChapter,
    useDeleteChapter,
    useUpdateChapter,
} from "../services/courseDetail.mutation";
import { useToast } from "~/components/Toast";
import { getErrorMessage } from "~/utils/getErrorMessage";
import FormModal from "./FormModal";

interface Props {
    courseId?: number;
    courseTitle?: string;
    nextOrderIndex?: number;
    isEdit?: boolean;
    chapter?: { id: number; title: string; orderIndex: number };
}

export default function ChapterFormButton({
    courseId,
    courseTitle,
    nextOrderIndex = 0,
    isEdit = false,
    chapter,
}: Readonly<Props>) {
    const toast = useToast();
    const { t } = useTranslation("courseDetail");
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const [title, setTitle] = useState("");

    const add = useAddNewChapter(courseId);
    const update = useUpdateChapter(courseId, chapter?.id);
    const remove = useDeleteChapter(courseId, chapter?.id);

    const pending = add.isPending || update.isPending || remove.isPending;
    const canEdit = isEdit && !!chapter;

    const openModal = () => {
        // sá»­a: Ä‘iá»n sáºµn tÃªn hiá»‡n táº¡i; thÃªm: Ä‘á»ƒ trá»‘ng
        setTitle(canEdit ? chapter.title : "");
        setOpen(true);
    };
    const close = () => setOpen(false);

    const onError = (err: unknown) =>
        toast.error(getErrorMessage(err, t("notFound")));

    const handleSubmit = () => {
        const value = title.trim();
        if (!value) return;

        if (canEdit) {
            update.mutate(
                { title: value, orderIndex: chapter.orderIndex },
                {
                    onSuccess: () => {
                        toast.success(t("editChapter.success"));
                        close();
                    },
                    onError,
                },
            );
            return;
        }

        add.mutate(
            { title: value, orderIndex: nextOrderIndex },
            {
                onSuccess: () => {
                    toast.success(t("addCourse.success"));
                    close();
                },
                onError,
            },
        );
    };

    const handleDelete = () => {
        remove.mutate(undefined, {
            onSuccess: () => {
                toast.success(t("editChapter.deleted"));
                close();
            },
            onError,
        });
    };

    return (
        <>
            {canEdit ? (
                <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={openModal}
                    aria-label={t("editChapter.button")}
                    title={t("editChapter.button")}
                    className="cursor-pointer rounded-lg p-1 text-xs text-fg-muted hover:bg-surface hover:text-primary"
                >
                    <FontAwesomeIcon icon={faPen} />
                </button>
            ) : (
                <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={openModal}
                    className="w-full cursor-pointer rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border px-3 py-2 text-sm text-link hover:bg-surface"
                >
                    {t("addCourse.button")}
                </button>
            )}

            {open && (
                <FormModal
                    title={
                        canEdit
                            ? t("editChapter.title")
                            : t("addCourse.addChapterTitle")
                    }
                    subtitle={courseTitle}
                    submitLabel={canEdit ? t("editChapter.save") : t("add")}
                    submitDisabled={
                        !title.trim() ||
                        (canEdit && title.trim() === chapter.title)
                    }
                    pending={pending}
                    confirmDeleteText={t("editChapter.confirmDelete")}
                    onClose={close}
                    onSubmit={handleSubmit}
                    onDelete={canEdit ? handleDelete : undefined}
                >
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                        <label
                            htmlFor="chapter-title"
                            className="text-sm text-fg-muted"
                        >
                            {t("addCourse.chapterName")}
                        </label>
                        <input
                            id="chapter-title"
                            value={title}
                            onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
                            placeholder={t("addCourse.chapterPlaceholder")}
                            className="w-full rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface px-3 py-2 text-sm text-fg outline-none focus:border-primary"
                        />
                    </div>
                </FormModal>
            )}
        </>
    );
}

import { faCheck, faCopy } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons'
import { FontAwesomeIcon } from '@fortawesome/react-fontawesome'
import { useState } from 'react'
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next'

interface Props {
  filename: string
  content: string
}

export default function CodeBlock({ filename, content }: Props) {
  const { t } = useTranslation('courseDetail')
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false)

  const handleCopy = async () => {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(content)
    setCopied(true)
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1500)
  }

  return (
    // Code block luÃ´n tá»‘i á»Ÿ cáº£ light/dark theme (giá»‘ng Figma)
    <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-[#1e293b] text-slate-200 shadow-sm">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/10 px-4 py-2.5">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <span className="flex gap-1.5">
            <i className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-red-400" />
            <i className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-amber-400" />
            <i className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-green-400" />
          </span>
          <span className="font-mono text-xs text-slate-400">{filename}</span>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleCopy}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md bg-primary px-2.5 py-1 font-label text-xs font-medium text-on-primary transition hover:bg-primary-hover"
        >
          <FontAwesomeIcon icon={copied ? faCheck : faCopy} />
          {copied ? t('copied') : t('copy')}
        </button>
      </div>
      <pre className="overflow-x-auto p-4 font-mono text-[13px] leading-6">
        {content.split('\n').map((line, i) => (
          <div key={i} className={line.trim().startsWith('#') ? 'text-emerald-400' : undefined}>
            {line || '\u00A0'}
          </div>
        ))}
      </pre>
    </div>
  )
}

const formatTime = (seconds: number) => {
    const m = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
    const s = Math.floor(seconds % 60);
    return `${m}:${String(s).padStart(2, "0")}`;

function ProgressRing({
    done,
    total,
    label,
    size = 18,
}: {
    done: number;
    total: number;
    label: string;
    size?: number;
}) {
    const stroke = 2.5;
    const r = (size - stroke) / 2;
    const c = 2 * Math.PI * r;
    const ratio = total ? Math.min(done / total, 1) : 0;

    return (
        <svg
            width={size}
            height={size}
            viewBox={`0 0 ${size} ${size}`}
            role="img"
            aria-label={label}
            className="shrink-0 -rotate-90 text-primary"
        >
            <circle
                cx={size / 2}
                cy={size / 2}
                r={r}
                fill="none"
                strokeWidth={stroke}
                className="stroke-primary/20"
            />
            <circle
                cx={size / 2}
                cy={size / 2}
                r={r}
                fill="none"
                strokeWidth={stroke}
                strokeLinecap="round"
                stroke="currentColor"
                strokeDasharray={c}
                strokeDashoffset={c * (1 - ratio)}
                className="transition-[stroke-dashoffset] duration-300"
            />
        </svg>
    );
}

function LessonRow({
    lesson,
    active,
    completed,
    showProgress = true,
    onClick,
    children
}: {
    lesson: ILessonWithProgress | ILesson;
    active: boolean;
    completed: boolean;
    showProgress?: boolean;
    onClick: () => void;
    children?: any;
}) {
    const { t } = useTranslation("courseDetail");
    const contentType = "contentType" in lesson ? lesson.contentType : undefined;
    const lastPosition = showProgress && "lastPosition" in lesson ? (lesson.lastPosition ?? 0) : 0;
    const isDocument = contentType === "DOCUMENT";
    const isVideo = contentType === "VIDEO";
    const typeLabel = contentType
        ? t(`contentType.${contentType}`, {
              defaultValue: isDocument ? "TÃ i liá»‡u" : isVideo ? "Video" : "",
          })
        : "";
    const ref = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);

    // Cuá»™n bÃ i Ä‘ang há»c vÃ o táº§m nhÃ¬n trong vÃ¹ng cuá»™n cá»§a má»¥c lá»¥c
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!active) return;
        const frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            const el = ref.current;
            const box = el?.closest<HTMLElement>("[data-toc-scroll]");
            if (!el || !box) return;
            const b = box.getBoundingClientRect();
            const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
            if (r.top < b.top)
                box.scrollBy({ top: r.top - b.top - 8, behavior: "smooth" });
            else if (r.bottom > b.bottom)
                box.scrollBy({
                    top: r.bottom - b.bottom + 8,
                    behavior: "smooth",
                });
        });
        return () => cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
    }, [active]);

    if (active) {
        return (
            <button
                ref={ref}
                type="button"
                onClick={onClick}
                className="w-full rounded-xl border border-primary/30 bg-surface p-3 text-left shadow-sm flex justify-between"
            >
                <div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <FontAwesomeIcon
                            icon={isDocument ? faFileLines : faCirclePlay}
                            className="text-primary"
                        />
                        <span className="rounded bg-primary px-1.5 py-0.5 font-label text-[10px] font-bold text-on-primary">
                            {t("status.current")}
                        </span>
                        {isVideo && lastPosition > 0 && (
                            <span className="font-label text-xs text-fg-muted">
                                {formatTime(lastPosition)}
                            </span>
                        )}
                    </div>
                    <p className="mt-2 text-sm font-semibold text-primary">
                        {lesson.title}
                    </p>
                </div>
                {children}
            </button>
        );
    }

    return (
        <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClick}
            className="flex w-full items-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl p-3 text-left transition hover:bg-surface"
        >
            <span className="mt-0.5 w-4 text-center">
                {completed ? (
                    <FontAwesomeIcon
                        icon={faCircleCheck}
                        className="text-tertiary"
                    />
                ) : isDocument ? (
                    <FontAwesomeIcon
                        icon={faFileLines}
                        className="text-primary"
                    />
                ) : (
                    <span className="inline-block h-3.5 w-3.5 rounded-full border-2 border-fg-subtle" />
                )}
            </span>
            <span className="min-w-0">
                <span className="block text-sm text-fg">{lesson.title}</span>
                <span
                    className={`mt-0.5 block font-label text-xs ${
                        isDocument ? "text-primary" : "text-fg-subtle"
                    }`}
                >
                    {completed
                        ? `${typeLabel} â€¢ ${t("status.completed")}`
                        : typeLabel}
                </span>
            </span>
        </button>
    );
}

export default function CurriculumPanel({
    chapters,
    currentLessonId,
    completedIds,
    completedCount = 0,
    totalLessons,
    defaultOpenChapterId,
    onSelectLesson,
    isStudent,
    courseId,
    courseTitle
}: Props) {
    const { t } = useTranslation("courseDetail");
    const [openId, setOpenId] = useState<number | undefined>(
        defaultOpenChapterId,
    );

    const percent = totalLessons
        ? Math.round((completedCount / totalLessons) * 100)
        : 0;

    useEffect(() => {
        setOpenId(defaultOpenChapterId);
    }, [currentLessonId, defaultOpenChapterId]);

    // Gá»™p bÃ i Ä‘Ã£ hoÃ n thÃ nh tá»« server vÃ  bÃ i vá»«a báº¥m "Ä‘Ã£ hiá»ƒu" á»Ÿ FE
    const isDone = (l: ILesson) =>
        isStudent &&
        (("completed" in l && Boolean(l.completed)) ||
            Boolean(completedIds?.has(l.id)));

    return (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface-muted p-4">
            <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
                <h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 font-semibold text-fg">
                    <FontAwesomeIcon
                        icon={faBookOpen}
                        className="text-primary"
                    />
                    {t("toc")}
                </h2>
                <span className="rounded-full bg-surface px-2.5 py-0.5 font-label text-xs text-fg-muted">
                    {t("lessonsCount", { count: totalLessons })}
                </span>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
                {chapters.map((chapter) => {
                    const total = chapter.lessons.length;
                    const done = isStudent
                        ? chapter.lessons.filter(isDone).length
                        : 0;
                    const allDone = isStudent && total > 0 && done >= total;
                    const open = openId === chapter.id;

                    return (
                        <div
                            key={chapter.id}
                            className={`rounded-xl ${open ? "bg-primary-soft" : ""}`}
                        >
                            <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() =>
                                    setOpenId(open ? undefined : chapter.id)
                                }
                                className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-left text-sm font-medium text-fg"
                            >
                                {isStudent &&
                                    (allDone ? (
                                        <FontAwesomeIcon
                                            icon={faCircleCheck}
                                            className="text-tertiary"
                                            aria-hidden
                                        />
                                    ) : (
                                        <ProgressRing
                                            done={done}
                                            total={total}
                                            label={t("chapterProgress", {
                                                done,
                                                total,
                                            })}
                                        />
                                    ))}
                                <span className="flex-1 truncate">
                                    {chapter.title}
                                </span>
                                <span className="font-label text-xs text-fg-muted">
                                    {isStudent
                                        ? t("chapterProgress", { done, total })
                                        : t("lessonsCount", { count: total })}
                                </span>
                                <FontAwesomeIcon
                                    icon={open ? faChevronUp : faChevronDown}
                                    className="text-xs text-fg-muted"
                                />
                                {!isStudent && <ChapterFormButton courseId={courseId} courseTitle={courseTitle} nextOrderIndex={chapters.length} isEdit={true} chapter={chapter}/>}
                            </button>

                            {open && (
                                <div className="space-y-1 px-1 pb-2">
                                    {chapter.lessons.map((lesson) => (
                                        <LessonRow
                                            key={lesson.id}
                                            lesson={lesson}
                                            active={
                                                lesson.id === currentLessonId
                                            }
                                            showProgress={isStudent}
                                            completed={isDone(lesson)}
                                            onClick={() =>
                                                onSelectLesson(lesson.id)
                                            }
                                        >
                                            {!isStudent && <LessonFormButton courseId={courseId} chapterId={chapter.id} chapterTitle={chapter.title} nextOrderIndex={chapter.lessons.length} isEdit={true} lesson={lesson}/>} 
                                        </LessonRow>
                                    ))}
                                    {!isStudent && <LessonFormButton courseId={courseId} chapterId={chapter.id} chapterTitle={chapter.title} nextOrderIndex={chapter.lessons.length} />}
                                </div>
                            )}
                        </div>
                    );
                })}
            </div>

            {isStudent ? (
                <div className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl bg-surface px-3 py-2.5">
                    <span className="font-label text-xs font-semibold text-fg">
                        {percent}%
                    </span>
                    <div className="h-1.5 flex-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-primary-soft">
                        <div
                            className="h-full rounded-full bg-primary"
                            style={{ width: `${percent}%` }}
                        />
                    </div>
                    <span className="font-label text-xs text-fg-muted">
                        {completedCount}/{totalLessons}
                    </span>
                </div>
            ) : (
                <ChapterFormButton courseId={courseId} courseTitle={courseTitle} nextOrderIndex={chapters.length} />
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

import { useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

interface Props {
    title: string;
    subtitle?: string;
    submitLabel: string;
    submitDisabled?: boolean;
    pending?: boolean;
    confirmDeleteText?: string;
    onClose: () => void;
    onSubmit: () => void;
    onDelete?: () => void;
    children: ReactNode;
}

export default function FormModal({
    title,
    subtitle,
    submitLabel,
    submitDisabled,
    pending,
    confirmDeleteText,
    onClose,
    onSubmit,
    onDelete,
    children,
}: Props) {
    const { t } = useTranslation("courseDetail");
    const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(false);

    useEffect(() => {
        const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => e.key === "Escape" && onClose();
        window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
        return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    }, [onClose]);

    const handleSubmit = (e: any) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!pending && !submitDisabled) onSubmit();
    };

    return createPortal(
        <div
            className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4"
            role="dialog"
            aria-modal="true"
        >
            <div
                className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/20 backdrop-blur-xs transition-opacity"
                onClick={onClose}
            />
            <form
                onSubmit={handleSubmit}
                className="relative w-full max-w-md space-y-4 rounded-2xl bg-surface p-5 shadow-xl"
            >
                <div>
                    <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-fg">{title}</h2>
                    {subtitle && (
                        <p className="truncate text-sm text-fg-muted">{subtitle}</p>
                    )}
                </div>

                {children}

                {onDelete && confirming && (
                    <div className="space-y-2 rounded-lg border border-red-300 bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-700">
                        <p>{confirmDeleteText}</p>
                        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
                            <button
                                type="button"
                                disabled={pending}
                                onClick={() => setConfirming(false)}
                                className="cursor-pointer rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-fg-muted hover:bg-surface"
                            >
                                {t("close")}
                            </button>
                            <button
                                type="button"
                                disabled={pending}
                                onClick={onDelete}
                                className="cursor-pointer rounded-lg bg-red-600 px-3 py-1.5 font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-50"
                            >
                                {t("editChapter.confirm")}
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                )}

                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                    {onDelete && !confirming ? (
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            disabled={pending}
                            onClick={() => setConfirming(true)}
                            className="cursor-pointer rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-sm text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50"
                        >
                            {t("editChapter.delete")}
                        </button>
                    ) : (
                        <span />
                    )}
                    <div className="flex gap-2">
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={onClose}
                            disabled={pending}
                            className="cursor-pointer rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-sm text-fg-muted hover:bg-surface-muted"
                        >
                            {t("close")}
                        </button>
                        <button
                            type="submit"
                            disabled={pending || submitDisabled}
                            className="cursor-pointer rounded-lg bg-primary px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-on-primary disabled:opacity-50"
                        >
                            {submitLabel}
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </form>
        </div>,
        document.body,
    );
}

import { faPen } from "@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons";
import { FontAwesomeIcon } from "@fortawesome/react-fontawesome";
import { useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useToast } from "~/components/Toast";
import { getErrorMessage } from "~/utils/getErrorMessage";
import {
    useAddNewLesson,
    useDeleteLesson,
    useUpdateLesson,
} from "../services/courseDetail.mutation";
import type { ILesson } from "../services/courseDetail.type";
import FormModal from "./FormModal";

interface Props {
    courseId?: number;
    chapterId: number;
    chapterTitle?: string;
    nextOrderIndex?: number; // dÃ¹ng khi thÃªm
    isEdit?: boolean;
    lesson?: ILesson;
    onDeleted?: (lessonId: number) => void;
}

export default function LessonFormButton({
    courseId,
    chapterId,
    chapterTitle,
    nextOrderIndex = 0,
    isEdit = false,
    lesson,
    onDeleted,
}: Readonly<Props>) {
    const { t } = useTranslation("courseDetail");
    const toast = useToast();
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const canEdit = isEdit && !!lesson;

    const [title, setTitle] = useState("");

    const add = useAddNewLesson(courseId, chapterId);
    const update = useUpdateLesson(courseId, chapterId, lesson?.id);
    const remove = useDeleteLesson(courseId, chapterId, lesson?.id);
    const pending = add.isPending || update.isPending || remove.isPending;

    const openModal = () => {
        setTitle(canEdit ? lesson.title : "");
        setOpen(true);
    };
    const close = () => setOpen(false);

    const onError = (err: unknown) =>
        toast.error(getErrorMessage(err, t("notFound")));

    const handleSubmit = () => {
        const value = title.trim();
        if (!value) return;

        if (canEdit) {
            update.mutate(
                {
                    title: value,
                    orderIndex: lesson.orderIndex,
                },
                {
                    onSuccess: () => {
                        toast.success(t("lesson.updated"));
                        close();
                    },
                    onError,
                },
            );
            return;
        }

        add.mutate(
            { title: value, orderIndex: nextOrderIndex },
            {
                onSuccess: () => {
                    toast.success(t("lesson.added"));
                    close();
                },
                onError,
            },
        );
    };

    const handleDelete = () => {
        if (!lesson) return;
        remove.mutate(undefined,
            {
                onSuccess: () => {
                    toast.success(t("lesson.deleted"));
                    close();
                    onDeleted?.(lesson.id);
                },
                onError,
            },
        );
    };

    const unchanged = canEdit && title.trim() === lesson.title

    return (
        <>
            {canEdit ? (
                <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={openModal}
                    title={t("lesson.edit")}
                    aria-label={t("lesson.edit")}
                    className="cursor-pointer rounded-lg p-1 text-xs text-fg-muted hover:bg-surface hover:text-primary"
                >
                    <FontAwesomeIcon icon={faPen} />
                </button>
            ) : (
                <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={openModal}
                    className="w-full cursor-pointer rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border px-3 py-2 text-sm text-link hover:bg-surface"
                >
                    {t("lesson.addButton")}
                </button>
            )}

            {open && (
                <FormModal
                    title={canEdit ? t("lesson.editTitle") : t("lesson.addTitle")}
                    subtitle={chapterTitle}
                    submitLabel={canEdit ? t("editChapter.save") : t("add")}
                    submitDisabled={!title.trim() || unchanged}
                    pending={pending}
                    confirmDeleteText={t("lesson.confirmDelete")}
                    onClose={close}
                    onSubmit={handleSubmit}
                    onDelete={canEdit ? handleDelete : undefined}
                >
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                        <label htmlFor="lesson-title" className="text-sm text-fg-muted">
                            {t("lesson.name")}
                        </label>
                        <input
                            id="lesson-title"
                            value={title}
                            onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
                            placeholder={t("lesson.placeholder")}
                            className="w-full rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface px-3 py-2 text-sm text-fg outline-none focus:border-primary"
                        />
                    </div>
                </FormModal>
            )}
        </>
    );
}

import { faPen } from "@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons";
import { FontAwesomeIcon } from "@fortawesome/react-fontawesome";
import { useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useToast } from "~/components/Toast";
import { getErrorMessage } from "~/utils/getErrorMessage";
import {
    useAddMaterial,
    useDeleteMaterial,
    useUpdateMaterial,
} from "../services/courseDetail.mutation";
import FormModal from "./FormModal";
import type { IMaterial } from "../services/courseDetail.type";

const FILE_TYPES = ["PDF", "VIDEO", "DOCX", "IMAGE", "PPTX"];

interface Props {
    courseId?: number;
    chapterId?: number;
    lessonId?: number;
    lessonTitle?: string;
    isEdit?: boolean;
    material?: IMaterial;
}

export default function MaterialFormButton({
    courseId,
    chapterId,
    lessonId,
    lessonTitle,
    isEdit = false,
    material,
}: Readonly<Props>) {
    const { t } = useTranslation("courseDetail");

    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const canEdit = isEdit && !!material;

    const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
    const [fileUrl, setFileUrl] = useState("");
    const [fileType, setFileType] = useState(FILE_TYPES[0]);

    const add = useAddMaterial(courseId, chapterId, lessonId);
    const update = useUpdateMaterial(courseId, chapterId, lessonId, material?.id);
    const remove = useDeleteMaterial(courseId, chapterId, lessonId, material?.id);

    const openModal = () => {
        setTitle(canEdit ? material.title : "");
        setFileUrl(canEdit ? material.fileUrl : "");
        setFileType(canEdit ? material.fileType : FILE_TYPES[0]);
        setOpen(true);
    };
    const close = () => setOpen(false);

    const onError = (err: unknown) =>
        toast.error(getErrorMessage(err, t("notFound")));

    const payload = { title: title.trim(), fileUrl: fileUrl.trim(), fileType };

    const handleSubmit = () => {
        if (canEdit) {
            update.mutate(payload,
                {
                    onSuccess: () => {
                        toast.success(t("material.updated"));
                        close();
                    },
                    onError,
                },
            );
            return;
        }

        add.mutate(payload,
            {
                onSuccess: () => {
                    toast.success(t("material.added"));
                    close();
                },
                onError,
            },
        );
    };

    const handleDelete = () => {
        if (!material) return;
        remove.mutate(undefined,
            {
                onSuccess: () => {
                    toast.success(t("material.deleted"));
                    close();
                },
                onError,
            },
        );
    };

    const unchanged =
        canEdit &&
        payload.title === material.title &&
        payload.fileUrl === material.fileUrl &&
        fileType === material.fileType;

    const inputCls =
        "w-full rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface px-3 py-2 text-sm text-fg outline-none focus:border-primary";

    return (
        <>

                <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={openModal}
                    title={t("material.edit")}
                    aria-label={t("material.edit")}
                    className="cursor-pointer rounded-lg p-2 text-xs text-fg-muted hover:bg-surface-muted hover:text-primary"
                >
                    <FontAwesomeIcon icon={faPen} />
                </button>
            ) : (
                <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={openModal}
                    className="cursor-pointer w-full rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border px-3 py-2 text-sm text-link hover:bg-surface"
                >
                    {t("material.addButton")}
                </button>
            )}

            {open && (
                <FormModal
                    title={canEdit ? t("material.editTitle") : t("material.addTitle")}
                    subtitle={lessonTitle}
                    submitLabel={canEdit ? t("editChapter.save") : t("add")}
                    submitDisabled={!payload.title || !payload.fileUrl || unchanged}
                    pending={pending}
                    confirmDeleteText={t("material.confirmDelete")}
                    onClose={close}
                    onSubmit={handleSubmit}
                    onDelete={canEdit ? handleDelete : undefined}
                >
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                        <label htmlFor="material-title" className="text-sm text-fg-muted">
                            {t("material.name")}
                        </label>
                        <input
                            id="material-title"
                            value={title}
                            onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
                            className={inputCls}

export default function MaterialsTab({

                role="tablist"

const TOKEN =
    /(`[^`]+`|\*\*[^*]+\*\*|__[^_]+__|\*[^*]+\*|\[[^\]]+\]\(https?:\/\/[^)\s]+\)|https?:\/\/[^\s<>"]*[^\s<>".,!?;:)\]])/g;
const LINK = /^\[([^\]]+)\]\((https?:\/\/[^)\s]+)\)$/;
const BARE_URL = /^https?:\/\/\S+$/;

const linkClass = "break-all text-link underline hover:opacity-80";

export default function RichText({ text }: { text: string }) {
    return (
        <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words text-sm leading-6 text-fg">
            {text.split(TOKEN).map((part, i) => {
                if (
                    part.startsWith("`") &&
                    part.endsWith("`") &&
                    part.length > 2
                ) {
                    return (
                        <code
                            key={i}
                            className="rounded bg-primary-soft px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[0.85em] text-primary"
                        >
                            {part.slice(1, -1)}
                        </code>
                    );
                }
                if (
                    part.startsWith("**") &&
                    part.endsWith("**") &&
                    part.length > 4
                ) {
                    return <strong key={i}>{part.slice(2, -2)}</strong>;
                }
                if (
                    part.startsWith("__") &&
                    part.endsWith("__") &&
                    part.length > 4
                ) {
                    return <u key={i}>{part.slice(2, -2)}</u>;
                }
                if (
                    part.startsWith("*") &&
                    part.endsWith("*") &&
                    part.length > 2
                ) {
                    return <em key={i}>{part.slice(1, -1)}</em>;
                }
                const link = LINK.exec(part);
                if (link) {
                    return (
                        <a
                            key={i}
                            href={link[2]}
                            target="_blank"
                            rel="noreferrer noopener"
                            className={linkClass}
                        >
                            {link[1]}
                        </a>
                    );
                }
                if (BARE_URL.test(part)) {
                    return (
                        <a
                            key={i}
                            href={part}
                            target="_blank"
                            rel="noreferrer noopener"
                            className={linkClass}
                        >
                            {part}
                        </a>
                    );
                }
                return part;
            })}
        </p>
    );
}

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'

const DONE_RATIO = 0.9 // xem Ä‘á»§ 90% thÃ¬ tÃ­nh lÃ  xong
const SEEK_TOLERANCE = 2 // giÃ¢y: sai sá»‘ cho phÃ©p khi so vá»›i vá»‹ trÃ­ xa nháº¥t
const TICK_MS = 250
const EMIT_EVERY_MS = 5000

export interface VideoProgress {
  position: number // vá»‹ trÃ­ Ä‘ang xem (giÃ¢y)
  furthest: number // vá»‹ trÃ­ xa nháº¥t Ä‘Ã£ xem há»£p lá»‡ (giÃ¢y)
  duration: number // tá»•ng thá»i lÆ°á»£ng (giÃ¢y)
  percent: number // 0..1, theo furthest
}

interface YTPlayerEvent {
  data: number
}

interface YTPlayer {
  getCurrentTime(): number
  getDuration(): number
  getPlaybackRate(): number
  seekTo(seconds: number, allowSeekAhead: boolean): void
  destroy(): void
}

declare global {
  interface Window {
    YT?: {
      Player: new (el: HTMLElement, options: Record<string, unknown>) => YTPlayer
    }
    onYouTubeIframeAPIReady?: () => void
  }
}

let apiPromise: Promise<void> | null = null
const loadYouTubeApi = (): Promise<void> => {
  if (window.YT?.Player) return Promise.resolve()
  apiPromise ??= new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
    const prev = window.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady
    window.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady = () => {
      prev?.()
      resolve()
    }
    const script = document.createElement('script')
    script.src = 'https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api'
    document.head.appendChild(script)
  })
  return apiPromise
}

const getYoutubeId = (url?: string) => {
  if (!url) return ''
  const m = url.match(/(?:v=|youtu\.be\/|embed\/)([\w-]{11})/)
  return m?.[1] ?? ''
}

interface Props {
  videoUrl?: string
  title: string
  startAt?: number // giÃ¢y, Ä‘á»ƒ xem tiáº¿p tá»« chá»— Ä‘Ã£ dá»«ng
  onOpenToc: () => void
  onProgress?: (p: VideoProgress) => void
  onDone?: () => void // gá»i má»™t láº§n khi xem Ä‘á»§ 80%
}

export default function VideoPlayer({
  videoUrl,
  title,
  startAt = 0,
  onProgress,
  onDone,
}: Readonly<Props>) {
  const id = getYoutubeId(videoUrl)

  const hostRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const startAtRef = useRef(startAt)
  const onProgressRef = useRef(onProgress)
  const onDoneRef = useRef(onDone)
  onProgressRef.current = onProgress
  onDoneRef.current = onDone

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id || !hostRef.current) return

    let disposed = false
    let timer: number | undefined
    let player: YTPlayer | undefined
    let mount: HTMLDivElement | undefined
    let furthest = startAtRef.current
    let lastEmit = 0
    let lastTickAt = Date.now()
    let doneFired = false

    const ready = () => !!player && typeof player.getCurrentTime === 'function'

    const emit = () => {
      if (!player || !ready()) return
      const total = player.getDuration() || 0
      onProgressRef.current?.({
        position: player.getCurrentTime(),
        furthest,
        duration: total,
        percent: total ? furthest / total : 0,
      })
    }

    const tick = () => {
      if (!player || !ready()) return
      const now = Date.now()
      const elapsed = (now - lastTickAt) / 1000
      lastTickAt = now

      const time = player.getCurrentTime()
      const total = player.getDuration() || 0
      const rate = player.getPlaybackRate?.() || 1

      // PhÃ¡t bÃ¬nh thÆ°á»ng (ká»ƒ cáº£ tá»‘c Ä‘á»™ 2x, tab bá»‹ trÃ¬nh duyá»‡t lÃ m cháº­m timer)
      // chá»‰ tiáº¿n Ä‘Æ°á»£c khoáº£ng elapsed * rate. Nháº£y xa hÆ¡n tháº¿ = tua tá»›i trÆ°á»›c.
      const allowed = furthest + SEEK_TOLERANCE + elapsed * rate
      if (time > allowed) {
        player.seekTo(furthest, true)
        return
      }

      furthest = Math.max(furthest, time)

      if (now - lastEmit > EMIT_EVERY_MS) {
        lastEmit = now
        emit()
      }

      if (!doneFired && total && furthest / total >= DONE_RATIO) {
        doneFired = true
        emit()
        onDoneRef.current?.()
      }
    }

    loadYouTubeApi().then(() => {
      if (disposed || !hostRef.current || !window.YT) return

      // YouTube thay pháº§n tá»­ Ä‘Æ°á»£c truyá»n vÃ o báº±ng iframe, nÃªn táº¡o node riÃªng Ä‘á»ƒ dá»n dáº¹p dá»…
      mount = document.createElement('div')
      hostRef.current.appendChild(mount)

      player = new window.YT.Player(mount, {
        videoId: id,
        playerVars: {
          controls: 1, // giá»¯ thanh Ä‘iá»u khiá»ƒn gá»‘c: tá»‘c Ä‘á»™, cháº¥t lÆ°á»£ng, toÃ n mÃ n hÃ¬nh...
          fs: 1,
          rel: 0,
          modestbranding: 1,
          playsinline: 1,
          start: Math.floor(startAtRef.current),
        },
        events: {
          onStateChange: (e: YTPlayerEvent) => {
            // 1: Ä‘ang phÃ¡t, 2: táº¡m dá»«ng, 3: Ä‘ang Ä‘á»‡m. Kiá»ƒm tra ngay sau khi tua
            if (e.data === 1 || e.data === 2 || e.data === 3) tick()
            if (e.data !== 1) emit()
          },
        },
      })
      lastTickAt = Date.now()
      timer = window.setInterval(tick, TICK_MS)
    })

    return () => {
      disposed = true
      window.clearInterval(timer)
      emit() // lÆ°u vá»‹ trÃ­ cuá»‘i trÆ°á»›c khi rá»i bÃ i
      player?.destroy()
      mount?.remove()
    }
  }, [id])

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="relative aspect-video w-full overflow-hidden bg-black">
        {id && (
          <div
            ref={hostRef}
            title={title}
            className="absolute inset-0 [&_iframe]:h-full [&_iframe]:w-full"
          />
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

import { deleteApi, getApi, postApi, putApi } from "~/config/axiosClient";
import type { ILessonPayload, IChapter, ILesson, IMaterial, ICourseToc, ICourseProgress, IPostCompleteLesson, IChapterPayload, ICourse } from "./courseDetail.type";

const getChapters = (courseId: number) => getApi<IChapter[]>(`/courses/${courseId}/chapters`);

const getLessons = (courseId: number, chapterId: number) => getApi<ILesson[]>(`/courses/${courseId}/chapters/${chapterId}/lessons`);

export const getCourse = (courseId: number) => getApi<ICourse>(`/courses/${courseId}`)

export const getMyProgress = (courseId: number) => getApi<ICourseProgress>(`/courses/${courseId}/progress/me`);

const byOrder = <T extends { orderIndex: number }>(a: T, b: T) =>
  a.orderIndex - b.orderIndex

export const fetchCourseToc = async (courseId: number): Promise<ICourseToc[]> => {
    const chapters = await getChapters(courseId)

    const result = await Promise.all(
    chapters.map(async (ch) => {
        const lessons = await getLessons(courseId, ch.id)
        return { ...ch, lessons: [...lessons].sort(byOrder) }
    })
    )

    return result.sort(byOrder)
}

export const postCompleteLesson = (lessonId: number) => postApi<IPostCompleteLesson>(`/lessons/${lessonId}/complete`)

FILE: C:\Users\Dat\IdeaProjects\DATH_17\frontend\src\pages\CourseDetail\services\progress.api.ts

import { putApi } from "~/config/axiosClient";
import type { IPostCompleteLesson } from "./courseDetail.type";

// Vá»‹ trÃ­ cuá»‘i Ä‘Ã£ gá»­i theo tá»«ng bÃ i trong phiÃªn lÃ m viá»‡c nÃ y
const lastSent = new Map<number, number>();

// DÃ¹ng lÃ m startAt khi quay láº¡i bÃ i vá»«a xem (dá»¯ liá»‡u server chÆ°a ká»‹p refetch)
export const getSentPosition = (lessonId: number) =>
  lastSent.get(lessonId) ?? 0;

export const saveProgress = async (
  lessonId: number,
  furthest: number,
  duration: number,
): Promise<IPostCompleteLesson | undefined> => {
  const totalLength = Math.floor(duration);
  // ceil + floor Ä‘á»ƒ 90% phÃ­a client luÃ´n >= 90% phÃ­a server
  const position =
    totalLength > 0
      ? Math.min(Math.ceil(furthest), totalLength)
      : Math.ceil(furthest);

  const prev = lastSent.get(lessonId);
  if (position <= (prev ?? 0)) return undefined; // chÆ°a cÃ³ tiáº¿n triá»ƒn
  lastSent.set(lessonId, position);

  try {
    return await putApi<IPostCompleteLesson>(`/lessons/${lessonId}/progress`, {
      position,
      ...(totalLength > 0 && { totalLength }),
    });
  } catch (err) {
    // lá»—i thÃ¬ tráº£ vá» má»‘c cÅ© Ä‘á»ƒ láº§n sau (5 giÃ¢y) gá»­i láº¡i
    if (prev === undefined) lastSent.delete(lessonId);
    else lastSent.set(lessonId, prev);
    throw err;
  }
};
export const resetProgressCache = () => lastSent.clear();

FILE: C:\Users\Dat\IdeaProjects\DATH_17\frontend\src\pages\CourseDetail\services\useCourseProgress.ts

import { useMemo } from 'react'

import { useGetCourseToc, useGetCourseProgress } from './courseDetail.query'
import type {
  IChapterWithProgress,
  ILessonWithProgress,
  ICourseTocWithProgress,
  ICourseToc,
} from './courseDetail.type'

export interface ICourseTocData {
  chapters: Array<ICourseToc | IChapterWithProgress>
  progressSummary?: ICourseTocWithProgress['progressSummary']
}

export interface ICourseTocWithProgressReturn {
  data: ICourseTocData | undefined
  isLoading: boolean
  isError: boolean
}

export const useCourseTocWithProgress = (
  courseId?: number,
  isStudent?: boolean
): ICourseTocWithProgressReturn => {
  const tocQuery = useGetCourseToc(courseId)
  const progressQuery = useGetCourseProgress(courseId, isStudent)

  const data = useMemo<ICourseTocData | undefined>(() => {
    if (!tocQuery.data) return undefined

    if (!isStudent) return { chapters: tocQuery.data }

    if (!progressQuery.data) return undefined

    const { lessons, ...progressSummary } = progressQuery.data
    const progressMap = new Map(lessons.map((l) => [l.lessonId, l]))

    const chapters = tocQuery.data.map((ch): IChapterWithProgress => {
      const chLessons: ILessonWithProgress[] = ch.lessons.map((l) => {
        const p = progressMap.get(l.id)
        return {
          ...l,
          completed: p?.completed ?? false,
          lastPosition: p?.lastPosition ?? 0,
        }
      })

      const completedLessons = chLessons.filter((l) => l.completed).length

      return {
        ...ch,
        lessons: chLessons,
        totalLessons: chLessons.length,
        completedLessons,
        isCompleted: chLessons.length > 0 && completedLessons === chLessons.length,
      }
    })

    return { chapters, progressSummary }
  }, [isStudent, tocQuery.data, progressQuery.data])

  return {
    data,
    isLoading: tocQuery.isLoading || (!!isStudent && progressQuery.isLoading),
    isError: tocQuery.isError || (!!isStudent && progressQuery.isError),
  }
}

export default function CourseDetailPage() {
    const { t } = useTranslation("courseDetail");
    const navigate = useNavigate();
    const params = useParams();
    const { data: me, isLoading: isMeLoading } = useMe();

    const courseId = params.courseId ? Number(params.courseId) : undefined;
    const lessonId = params.lessonId ? Number(params.lessonId) : undefined;

    const isStudent = me?.role === "STUDENT";
    const { data, isLoading } = useCourseTocWithProgress(courseId, isStudent);
    const { data: course } = useGetCourse(courseId, isStudent);

    // --- State (pháº£i khai bÃ¡o trÆ°á»›c má»i early return) ---
    const [tocOpen, setTocOpen] = useState(false);
    const [completedIds, setCompletedIds] = useState<Set<number>>(new Set());
    const { mutate: completeLesson } = usePostCompleteLesson();

    const chapters = data?.chapters;
    const progressSummary = data?.progressSummary; // undefined vá»›i non-student

    // Danh sÃ¡ch bÃ i há»c pháº³ng; chuáº©n hÃ³a `completed`, `lastPosition` Ä‘á»ƒ khÃ´ng lá»—i kiá»ƒu
    const flat = useMemo(
        () =>
            chapters?.flatMap((c) =>
                c.lessons.map((l) => ({
                    ...l,
                    completed: "completed" in l ? Boolean(l.completed) : false,
                    lastPosition:
                        "lastPosition" in l ? Number(l.lastPosition) : 0,
                    chapter: c,
                })),
            ) ?? [],
        [chapters],
    );

    // BÃ i hiá»‡n táº¡i: URL -> bÃ i há»c dá»Ÿ (resume) -> bÃ i chÆ°a hoÃ n thÃ nh Ä‘áº§u tiÃªn -> bÃ i Ä‘áº§u
    const current =
        flat.find((l) => l.id === lessonId) ??
        flat.find((l) => l.id === progressSummary?.resumeLessonId) ??
        flat.find((l) => !l.completed) ??
        flat[0];

    const { data: materials, isLoading: materialsLoading } = useGetMaterials(
        courseId,
        current?.chapterId,
        current?.id,
    );

    const { canUnderstoodClick, videoUrl, videoTitle } = useMemo(() => {
        const video = materials?.find(isVideoMaterial);
        // BÃ i video (theo contentType hoáº·c cÃ³ file video) pháº£i xem Ä‘á»§ má»›i Ä‘Æ°á»£c hoÃ n thÃ nh
        const isVideoLesson = !!video;
        return {
            canUnderstoodClick: !isVideoLesson,
            videoUrl: video?.fileUrl,
            videoTitle: video?.title,
        };
    }, [materials]);

    // Má»¥c lá»¥c desktop: Ä‘á»©ng yÃªn theo mÃ n hÃ¬nh
    const asideRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
    const [asideTop, setAsideTop] = useState(16);

    useLayoutEffect(() => {
        const measure = () => {
            const el = asideRef.current;
            if (!el || el.offsetParent === null) return;
            setAsideTop(
                Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY),
            );
        };
        measure();
        window.addEventListener("resize", measure);
        return () => window.removeEventListener("resize", measure);
    }, [data]);

    // --- Early returns (sau táº¥t cáº£ hooks) ---
    if (isMeLoading || isLoading || !data || !chapters) {
        return <div className="p-8 text-center text-fg-muted">...</div>;
    }

    if (!current) {
        return (
            <div className="p-8 text-center text-fg-muted">{t("notFound")}</div>
        );
    }

    const index = flat.findIndex((l) => l.id === current.id);

    const goTo = (id: number) => {
        navigate(`/courses/${courseId}/lessons/${id}`);
        setTocOpen(false);
    };

    // BÃ i vá»«a báº¥m "Ä‘Ã£ hiá»ƒu" á»Ÿ FE nhÆ°ng server chÆ°a ghi nháº­n
    const extraDone = [...completedIds].filter(
        (id) => !flat.find((l) => l.id === id)?.completed,
    ).length;
    const completedCount = (progressSummary?.completedLessons ?? 0) + extraDone;
    const totalLessons = progressSummary?.totalLessons ?? flat.length;

    const panel = (
        <CurriculumPanel
            chapters={chapters}
            currentLessonId={current.id}
            completedIds={completedIds}
            completedCount={completedCount}
            totalLessons={totalLessons}
            defaultOpenChapterId={current.chapter.id}
            onSelectLesson={goTo}
            isStudent={isStudent}
            courseId={courseId}
            courseTitle={course?.title}
        />
    );

    const handleUnderstood = () => {
        completeLesson(current.id);
        setCompletedIds((prev) => new Set(prev).add(current.id));
    };

    return (
        <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1280px] px-0 pb-28 sm:px-4 lg:pb-8">
            {/* Breadcrumb */}
            <nav className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 px-4 py-3 text-sm sm:px-0">
                <Link
                    to="/my-courses"
                    className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-medium text-link"
                >
                    <FontAwesomeIcon icon={faChevronLeft} className="text-xs" />
                    {progressSummary?.courseTitle || course?.title}
                </Link>
                <span className="hidden h-4 w-px bg-border sm:block" />
                <span className="text-fg-muted">
                    {current.chapter.title.split(":")[0]}
                </span>
                <span className="truncate font-semibold text-fg">
                    {current.title}
                </span>
            </nav>

            <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_340px]">
                {/* Cá»™t chÃ­nh */}
                <section className="overflow-hidden border-border bg-surface lg:rounded-2xl lg:border lg:shadow-sm">
                    {videoUrl && (
                        <VideoPlayer
                            key={current.id}
                            videoUrl={videoUrl}
                            title={videoTitle ?? current.title}
                            startAt={Math.max(
                                current.lastPosition,
                                getSentPosition(current.id),
                            )}
                            onOpenToc={() => setTocOpen(true)}
                            onProgress={(p) => {
                                // Chá»‰ há»c viÃªn má»›i lÆ°u tiáº¿n Ä‘á»™ xem
                                if (!isStudent) return;
                                const id = current.id;
                                saveProgress(id, p.furthest, p.duration)
                                    .then((res) => {

                                            setCompletedIds((prev) =>
                                                prev.has(id)
                                                    ? prev
                                                    : new Set(prev).add(id),
                                            );
                                        }
                                    })
                                    .catch(() => {
                                        // lá»—i máº¡ng: bá» qua, 5 giÃ¢y sau sáº½ gá»­i láº¡i
                                    });
                            }}
                        />

                    <div className="flex justify-end px-4 pt-3 sm:px-6 lg:hidden">
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setTocOpen(true)}
                            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-surface-muted px-3 py-1.5 font-label text-xs font-medium text-fg"
                        >
                            <FontAwesomeIcon icon={faBookOpen} aria-hidden />
                            {t('toc')}

                            lessonId={current.id}
                            lessonTitle={current.title}
                            isStudent={isStudent}
                            materials={materials}
                            loading={materialsLoading}
                        />

                        {/* Action bar: cá»‘ Ä‘á»‹nh Ä‘Ã¡y á»Ÿ mobile, náº±m cuá»‘i card á»Ÿ desktop */}

        </div>
    );

interface Props {
  value: number
  tone?: 'primary' | 'success'
  label?: string
}

export default function ProgressBar({ value, tone = 'primary', label }: Props) {
  const v = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, value))
  const track = tone === 'success' ? 'bg-tertiary-soft' : 'bg-primary-soft'
  const fill = tone === 'success' ? 'bg-tertiary' : 'bg-primary'
  return (
    <div
      role="progressbar"
      aria-label={label}
      aria-valuemin={0}
      aria-valuemax={100}
      aria-valuenow={v}
      className={`h-1.5 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full ${track}`}
    >
      <div className={`h-full rounded-full transition-[width] duration-500 ${fill}`} style={{ width: `${v}%` }} />
    </div>
  )
}

import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { FontAwesomeIcon } from "@fortawesome/react-fontawesome";
import {
    faChevronDown,
    faList,
    faMagnifyingGlass,
    faTableCellsLarge,
} from "@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons";
import type { CourseSort, CourseToolbarProps, CourseTab } from "../services/myCourses.type";

export default function CourseToolbar({
    tab,
    onTabChange,
    learningCount,
    completedCount,
    keyword,
    onKeywordChange,
    sort,
    onSortChange,
    view,
    onViewChange,
}: Readonly<CourseToolbarProps>) {
    const { t } = useTranslation("myCourses");

    const tabs: { key: CourseTab; count: number }[] = [
        { key: "learning", count: learningCount },
        { key: "completed", count: completedCount },
    ];

    return (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface p-3 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
            {/* Tabs */}
            <div
                role="tablist"
                className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1 rounded-xl bg-surface-muted p-1 lg:flex"
            >
                {tabs.map(({ key, count }) => {
                    const active = tab === key;
                    return (
                        <button
                            key={key}
                            role="tab"
                            type="button"
                            aria-selected={active}
                            onClick={() => onTabChange(key)}
                            className={`cursor-pointer rounded-lg px-4 py-1.5 text-sm font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-primary ${
                                active
                                    ? "bg-surface text-primary shadow-sm"
                                    : "text-fg-muted hover:text-fg"
                            }`}
                        >
                            {t(`tabs.${key}`)}{" "}
                            <span
                                className={`ml-1 rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] ${
                                    active
                                        ? "bg-primary-soft text-primary"
                                        : "bg-border text-fg-muted"
                                }`}
                            >
                                {count}
                            </span>
                        </button>
                    );
                })}
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-center lg:justify-end">
                {/* Search */}
                <label className="relative flex-1 lg:max-w-xs">

                    />

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { FontAwesomeIcon } from "@fortawesome/react-fontawesome";
import { faChevronRight } from "@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons";

import CourseCard from "./components/CourseCard";
import CourseToolbar from "./components/CourseToolbar";
import { useGetMyCourses } from "./services/myCourses.query";
import type {
    CourseSort,
    CourseView,
    ICourse,
    CourseTab
} from "./services/myCourses.type";

const normalize = (s: string) =>
    s
        .normalize("NFD")
        .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
        .replace(/Ä‘/g, "d")
        .toLowerCase();

const sortCourses = (list: ICourse[], sort: CourseSort) =>
    [...list].sort((a, b) => {
        const byName = a.title.localeCompare(b.title, "vi");

        if (sort === "name") return byName;

        if (sort === "progress") {
            return (b.progressPercent - a.progressPercent) || byName;
        }

        // recent: Æ°u tiÃªn lastAccessedAt, náº¿u chÆ°a há»c thÃ¬ dÃ¹ng enrolledAt
        // const ta = toTime(a.lastAccessedAt) || toTime(a.enrolledAt);
        // const tb = toTime(b.lastAccessedAt) || toTime(b.enrolledAt);
        // return (tb - ta) || byName;
        return byName;
    });

export default function MyCoursesPage() {
    const { t } = useTranslation("myCourses");
    const { data, isLoading, isError, refetch } = useGetMyCourses({
        staleTime: 30_000
    });

    const [tab, setTab] = useState<CourseTab>("learning");
    const [keyword, setKeyword] = useState("");
    const [sort, setSort] = useState<CourseSort>("name");
    const [view, setView] = useState<CourseView>("grid");

    const { learning, completed } = useMemo(() => {
        const courses = Array.isArray(data) ? data : [];
        return {
            learning: courses.filter((c) => c.progressPercent !== 100),
            completed: courses.filter((c) => c.progressPercent === 100),
        };
    }, [data]);

    const visible = useMemo(() => {
        const source = tab === "learning" ? learning : completed;
        const q = normalize(keyword.trim());
        const filtered = q
            ? source.filter((c) =>
                  normalize(
                      `${c.title} ${c.instructorName}`,
                  ).includes(q),
              )
            : source;
        return sortCourses(filtered, sort);
    }, [tab, learning, completed, keyword, sort]);

    return (
        <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-6xl flex-col gap-6 px-4 py-6 md:px-6">
            {/* Breadcrumb */}
            <nav
                aria-label="breadcrumb"
                className="hidden items-center gap-1 text-xs text-fg-subtle md:flex"
            >
                <span>{t("breadcrumb.study")}</span>
                <FontAwesomeIcon
                    icon={faChevronRight}
                    className="text-[12px]"
                    aria-hidden
                />
